article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية بدأت كل من كينيا ونيجيريا عدًّا تنازليًا لمدة 42 يومًا لإعلان انتهاء تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization has begun a 42-day countdown for Kenya and Nigeria to declare the end of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization has begun a 42-day countdown for Kenya and Nigeria to declare the end of the Ebola outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the latest update (as of 17 November 2026, following a report on 6 November 2026) shows ongoing transmission with 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%). The outbreak spans 68 health zones across 8 provinces, with active transmission in 48 zones. Ituri and North Kivu remain the hardest-hit provinces; South Kivu and South Ubangi have not reported a case for more than 42 days. A high proportion of deaths occur in communities outside treatment centers, especially among young children, underscoring challenges in early detection and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）が、ケニアとナイジェリアにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク終息宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,613例の確定症例、5,678人の死亡（致死率48.9%）と大規模かつ継続的なエボラ出血熱の流行があり、既にケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは記事中で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCにおける大規模・長期化するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが主題であり、致死率の高さとコミュニティ内死亡の多さから早期検知・医療アクセスの課題が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com mpox relata despreparo em unidade de saúde no Ceará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with mpox reports lack of preparedness at a health facility in Ceará.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (MPXV, Orthopoxvirus) cases are rising in Ceará, Brazil, with 175 confirmed infections in the year and 145 in Fortaleza. A 30-year-old Fortaleza videomaker reported lack of preparedness at a UPA emergency unit, prompting him to seek care at Hospital São José, a regional infectious-disease center. He first experienced influenza-like symptoms in early November—fever, body aches, sore throat—before skin lesions appeared four days later. Most cases involve men aged 24–51. Caucaia, in the metropolitan region, rose from one to seven cases within a week, while Sobral has four. Authorities, via the Sesa epidemiological coordinator Ana Cabral, note mpox is transmitted mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, mucous membranes, or secretions, and that illness typically lasts 2–4 weeks and is usually mild to moderate.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州の医療機関でMpox患者が準備不足を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でMpox症例が急増（カウカイアで1週間に1→7例）しており、医療現場の対応不備も報告されているため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: 症例は軽度〜中等度とされ死亡報告はないが、地域的な急増と医療現場の準備不足指摘があり、続報での重症度・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: کشف ویژگی‌های تازه گونه نادر ایبولا در کنگو؛ مرگ ۷۰ درصد کودکان مبتلا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of new features of a rare Ebola strain in the Congo; 70% mortality among infected children.
article.articleSummary: Rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 5,500 people and infected over 11,000 since its April emergence, six months into the crisis. The spread is nearly twice as fast as the 2013–2015 West Africa outbreak. Bleeding occurs in only 5–10% of Bundibugyo cases, contradicting common Ebola expectations, and early diagnostics often miss Bundibugyo because assays target other Ebola species. About 70% of patients die outside treatment centers. Children under five (1,207 cases) suffer a 70% fatality (844 deaths); adults’ fatality rate around 50%. Gastrointestinal symptoms predominate in children, complicating rapid diagnosis and care. Genomic analyses show Bundibugyo does not rapidly mutate nor increase transmissibility. No approved vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo. Trials include Merck's Ervebo for Zaire ebolavirus and Bundibugyo-specific vaccines, plus antivirals from Gilead Sciences and Map Biopharmaceuticals. Researchers hope these efforts help contain the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける希少なエボラ株の新たな特徴の発見；感染児童の70%が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は感染者11,000人超、死者5,500人超と大規模で、小児致死率70%、診断困難、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行のみを主題としているため除外した。史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行とされ、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないため国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nanopartículas de prata se mostraram eficazes contra o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silver nanoparticles proved effective against Aedes aegypti
article.articleSummary: Green-synthesized silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) show high efficacy against Aedes aegypti larvae and schistosome cercariae in water. In a Butantan Institute study led by Luiz Gustavo Ribeiro and Ana Olivia de Souza, AgNPs produced via fungal extracts from Aspergillus tubingensis (isolated from a mangrove) kill Schistosoma cercariae at low concentrations within two hours, preventing transmission from contaminated rivers and lakes. The same nanoparticles blocked the progression of Aedes aegypti larvae to adults 48 hours after application, reducing dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risk. Unlike chemical molluscicides, the approach does not kill snails, fish, or microcrustaceans in tested conditions, due to gradual release. Patented by INPI in July 2026, the technology is ready for industrial scaling and licensing. Dengue affects up to 400 million annually (WHO); Brazil logged over 1 million cases in 2025 and 6.6 million in 2024, while schistosomiasis affects over 200 million globally and remains endemic in parts of Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 銀ナノ粒子がネッタイシマカに対して有効であることが示された
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング・ジカ・チクングニア等の媒介蚊やシュードソーマに対する新規ナノ粒子殺虫技術の研究報告であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの発生情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究・技術開発（防除技術）に関するもので、具体的な疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、地域の疫学的事象としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Century of Newcastle Disease Virus Research Traces Evolution and Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease virus (NDV) is a notifiable avian pathogen (Paramyxoviridae, Avulavirinae, Orthoavulavirus javaense) with economic impact from high flock mortality, reduced egg production, and trade embargoes. A centennial retrospective traces its identification in 1926 after outbreaks in Java, Indonesia and Newcastle-upon-Tyne, England. NDV comprises Class II genotypes and a Class I lineage; genomes are about 15.2 kb. The virion carries HN and F glycoproteins; V and W proteins arise via translational frameshifts and antagonize host interferon signaling (STAT1, MDA5). Infection starts with HN binding sialic acids and a pH-independent F protein fusion after proteolytic cleavage. Pathotypes span viscerotropic velogenic (up to 100% mortality in naive birds within 3–9 days), neurotropic velogenic, and mesogenic forms. US eradication efforts (1971–73, 2002–03) depopulated millions of birds and cost hundreds of millions. Since the 1920s, NDV has caused at least four major panzootics with persistent endemicity in wildlife and poultry.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病ウイルス研究100年の歩み:進化とワクチンの課題
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は鳥類感染症(ニューカッスル病)の歴史的・科学的レビューであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は1926年のジャワ(インドネシア)とニューカッスル(英国)での発生に関する歴史的回顧であり、現在の発生国ではない。動物疾患(家禽)で人獣共通感染症としての言及もなく、ヒト公衆衛生イベントではないため対象国該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov Papua Pegunungan perkuat penanganan penyakit ATM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papua Highlands Provincial Government Strengthens Management of Acute Transverse Myelitis.
article.articleSummary: On 21 November 2026, the Papua Highlands Provincial Government, via the Health Office in Wamena, strengthened management of AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria (ATM) in the region. Four strategic steps guide the effort: data-driven policy based on the latest surveillance or real-time data; cross-sector integration; strengthening the regional partnership forum; and concrete actions in six focus districts. Programs must be aligned with real-time data to ensure targeted interventions and be incorporated into RPJMD, RKPD, and APBD at provincial and district levels. The initiative also emphasizes a strengthened forum for government, partners, academia, business, and civil society to coordinate efforts. The six districts designated as ATM loci are Jayawijaya, Mamberamo Tengah, Nduga, Pegunungan Bintang, Yalimo, and Yahukimo. An integrated ATM action plan for these districts should be drafted and implemented promptly.

triage.headline_ja: パプア山岳州政府、ATM（AIDS・結核・マラリア）対策の管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の慢性感染症（結核・マラリア等）に対する行政の対策強化を報じる定例的な内容であり、新規・異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: ATM（AIDS, Tuberculosis, Malaria）は既知の風土病対策プログラムであり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。行政の政策発表レベルの内容。

article.articleHeadline: 'A variante parece ter maior transmissibilidade', diz infectologista sobre alta da covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'The variant seems to have greater transmissibility,' says an infectious disease specialist about the rise in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: Stratus (XFG), a SARS-CoV-2 variant descended from Omicron, is driving renewed COVID-19 transmission in Brazil, representing about 90% of samples in Ministry of Health genomic surveillance. Seventeen states and the Federal District report significant case growth; test positivity rose 1% to 17% over three months, the year’s high. Fiocruz notes increased hospitalizations for COVID-19–related severe acute respiratory syndrome. Experts attribute the surge to higher transmissibility and climate factors, with São Paulo’s rainy, cooler days promoting indoor spread. A study found Stratus does not cause more severe disease or immune escape. As of November 9, 2026, Brazil recorded 118,920 cases, 3,641 severe, and 445 deaths, lower than pandemic peaks. Vaccination remains the main protection, especially for older adults (68% of deaths were ≥65); boosters are advised for those never vaccinated or at high risk.

triage.headline_ja: 「この変異株はより高い感染力を持つようだ」と感染症専門医がCOVID-19感染増加について語る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでSARS-CoV-2新変異株Stratus(XFG)による感染再拡大が確認され、入院増加と社会的関心の高まりが見られるためフルRRAでの確認を推奨する。
triage.notes: 新変異株Stratus(XFG)はより重症化や免疫逃避を引き起こさないとの研究結果があり、死亡・重症者数もパンデミックピーク時より低い水準。ワクチン接種（特に高齢者）が引き続き主要な予防策とされている。

article.articleHeadline: 裂解、亚单位、鼻喷有何区别？上海流感疫苗接种全攻略来了，支持医保个账支付
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the differences between split, subunit, and nasal spray influenza vaccines? The complete guide to influenza vaccination in Shanghai is here, with medical insurance personal-account payments accepted.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination drive underway in Shanghai for the 2026–2027 season. Three vaccine types are available: inactivated split vaccines, inactivated subunit vaccines, and intranasal live-attenuated vaccines. Inactivated vaccines are approved for individuals 6 months and older; the nasal spray is for ages 3–17. Contraindications include immunosuppressive therapy; children/teens on long-term aspirin or salicylates; 2–4 year-olds with asthma; pregnant women; and those with a history of Guillain-Barré syndrome. Antibody protection typically develops 2–4 weeks after vaccination; early vaccination is advised before the flu season. Shanghai offers online scheduling through the SuiShenBan app, Health Cloud apps/miniprograms, or the Shanghai CDC WeChat with the 'Smart Vaccination' module; select vaccine, manufacturer, and nearby clinic. Since Sept 15, basic medical insurance can cover non-immunization vaccines and injection fees at designated clinics, easing costs.

triage.headline_ja: 裂解、亚単位、鼻スプレーの違いとは？上海インフルエンザワクチン接種完全ガイド、医療保険個人口座払いにも対応
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種に関する一般的な広報・案内記事であり、感染症の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は上海市における季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内であり、疾病発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: First phase of bird flu containment completed in Alappuzha
article.articleSummary: First phase of avian influenza containment completed in Alappuzha district, Kerala. Disinfection within a one-kilometre radius of epicentres at Ambalappuzha North and Chennithala-Thripperunthura gram panchayats followed culling and incineration of birds, led by four Rapid Response Teams using flame treatment, sodium hypochlorite spraying and lime spreading. A 10-kilometre surveillance zone surrounds the epicentres, with samples collected biweekly and sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. The area will be declared bird flu–free only if testing remains negative for a three-month period.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザ地区で鳥インフルエンザ封じ込め措置の第一段階が完了
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザのルーティンな封じ込め・消毒作業の進捗報告であり、ヒト感染例や異常な拡大は報告されていないため、現時点でのシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽の殺処分・消毒・監視活動に関する進捗報告であり、ヒトへの感染や新規の異常事態は言及されていない。継続的なモニタリングのみで十分と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Three leptospirosis deaths reported in Ernakulam in November
article.articleSummary: Three leptospirosis deaths were reported in Ernakulam in November, the highest in Kerala. In the district, deaths occurred in Chittoor, Mattancherry and Karumalloor. As of November 19, 2026, the district tallied 3 suspected and 21 laboratory-confirmed leptospirosis cases. Dengue cases reached 481 (367 suspected, 114 confirmed), while influenza cases in November totaled 126. Dr. Rajany Jose, PEID Cell coordinator, cautions that fever should not be dismissed as a viral illness and urges seeking medical help early, since fever is a key symptom of leptospirosis and timely treatment is critical. High-risk groups include people with soil or water contaminated by rodent or domestic animal urine, and gardeners. Dengue and leptospirosis are presenting with atypical symptoms; delays and self-medication narrow the window for treatment. Corporation source-reduction activities, including fogging and spraying, are being intensified.

triage.headline_ja: 11月にエルナクラムでレプトスピラ症による死亡3例が報告
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州の季節性感染症（レプトスピラ症・デング熱・インフルエンザ）に関する定例的な地域報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の公衆衛生対応（防疫活動）で管理可能なレベル。
triage.notes: ケーララ州エルナクラム地区における季節性のレプトスピラ症・デング熱・インフルエンザの定例的な症例報告。死亡例はあるが地域内の既知の疾患であり、地方当局（防疫活動・燻蒸等）で対応中。国際的な懸念材料は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Penanganan Kasus Tuberkulosis di Palembang Jadi Prioritas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Case Management in Palembang Becomes a Priority.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) cases in Palembang, Indonesia, remained a priority for 2026, with 2025 data showing 6,706 TB cases in the city and 6,098 patients having started treatment as part of targeted care. City health authorities emphasize early detection and rapid treatment, aligning with a national program aiming to reduce TB by 50% within five years. Beyond TB, Palembang is tackling stunting, with the number of affected children under five dropping from 157 in 2025 to 119 by October 2026. A new Public Health Laboratory (Labkesmas) at Jalan Pajak Permai, Lorong Basoka 49, Alang-Alang Lebar District, supports sample testing, disease monitoring, and environmental health surveillance, inaugurated by Mayor Ratu Dewa on 19 November during National Health Day (HKN) celebrations. The city also funds JKN participation at about Rp146 billion annually, with active enrollment reaching 91.08% by December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: パレンバンにおける結核症例対応が優先事項に
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行病である結核の通常の行政対応・公衆衛生プログラムに関する内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の通常の行政的対策（検査施設開設、治療プログラム、JKN加入率等）を報告する内容で、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ಮಾರಕ 'ಬರ್ಡ್ ಫ್ಲೂ'ಗೆ ಭಾರತದ ಬ್ರೇಕ್: H5N1 ವೈರಸ್ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲ ಸ್ವದೇಶಿ ಲಸಿಕೆ ಲೋಕಾರ್ಪಣೆ! Bird Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's breakthrough against deadly 'Bird Flu': First domestically developed vaccine against H5N1 virus launched! Bird Flu.
article.articleSummary: India launches its first domestically developed H5N1 avian influenza vaccine, unveiled in Bhopal by ICAR-NIHSAD. Eight scientists led by Dr. S. Nagarajan developed the vaccine targeting the Clade 2.3.2.1a strain responsible for major poultry losses. Initiated in September 2025, the single-dose vaccine protects chickens for six months, benefiting layers and brood stock. Historically, outbreaks forced mass culling with near-total mortality on affected farms and massive financial losses. By immunizing flocks, transmission within poultry is curtailed, reducing spillover risk to humans. The government program, inaugurated by Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal, underscores India's veterinary strength and aims to shield poultry farmers and public health from Bird Flu.

triage.headline_ja: インドが致死的な『鳥インフルエンザ』に歯止め：H5N1ウイルスに対抗する初の国産ワクチンを発売！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規の感染症発生事例ではなく、インドが開発したH5N1家禽用ワクチンの発売を伝える政策・科学ニュースであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既存のH5N1クレード2.3.2.1a対策としての国産ワクチン開発・発売に関する内容。家禽向けワクチンでありヒト感染拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من ارتفاع وفيات الأطفال جراء تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of a rise in child deaths due to Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns of rising child deaths from a Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Latest data show 844 pediatric deaths among 1,207 confirmed cases in children under five, as total fatalities exceed 5,500 out of more than 11,000 cases reported over six months. Mortality is approximately 70% among under-fives, versus about 50% in adults. Early diagnosis is hampered by the rarity of bleeding symptoms, observed in only 5–10% of cases, leading to confusion with malaria and contributing to about 70% of deaths occurring in communities outside healthcare facilities. Field research continues to understand the strain and improve response; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo virus. Public health efforts face humanitarian and environmental challenges in controlling the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行による子どもの死亡増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,000例超・死亡5,500例超、5歳未満の致死率約70%と深刻で、WHOが警告しており複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患タグは『Malaria』となっているが、記事内容は実際にはエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のアウトブレイクであり、マラリアとの症状混同が診断遅延の一因として言及されている。疾患タグの誤りに注意。

article.articleHeadline: UW releases 'breakthrough' malaria vaccine trial results
article.articleSummary: UW researchers report 87% efficacy for the PfSPZ-LARC2 malaria vaccine in a Phase 1 trial of 22 participants enrolled in summer 2025. Efficacy was tested via controlled exposure to live parasites 12–16 weeks after vaccination; all 7 placebo recipients were infected, while 2 of 15 vaccinated participants developed malaria. The vaccine uses a genetically attenuated live parasite that halts growth during the liver stage after two deletions, eliciting protection with reduced disease severity. Cross-strain immunity was assessed using a West Africa–origin vaccine strain and a Brazil challenge strain, indicating durable, cross-strain protection. The vaccine was safe and well tolerated; findings were presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting near Washington, D.C. The global malaria burden (>600,000 deaths annually) underscores the drive for vaccines that block infection.

triage.headline_ja: UW、マラリアワクチン臨床試験で『画期的』な結果を発表
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発に関する研究成果報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや流行発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は米ワシントン大学によるマラリアワクチン臨床試験結果の発表であり、ブラジルやアンゴラは試験で使用した寄生虫株の起源地として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ASF strikes 4 Quezon villages; hog raisers urged to stay vigilant
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever strikes four barangays in Macalelon, Quezon (Mabini Ibaba, Amontay, Candangal, Pinagbayanan). Lab results confirmed on Nov 11. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic and wild pigs; it does not affect humans, and pork from infected animals is not safe for consumption. Immediate response by the Municipal Agriculture Office includes surveillance and testing, plus depopulation or controlled culling of affected pigs in the identified barangays. Biosecurity measures are intensified in barangays with no reported cases. Hog raisers are urged to monitor for weakness, loss of appetite, fever, skin redness, or other symptoms, and to avoid transporting pigs without permits; pigpens should be kept clean and secured, with unauthorized persons and vehicles blocked. The Department of Agriculture posts vaccination programs and stricter livestock-movement controls, with ASF checkpoints to inspect vehicles and health certificates, plus restrictions on traders, breeders, and shipments of frozen pork. At least four additional ASF vaccines are eyed by next year (2027). Published 2026-11-21.

triage.headline_ja: ASFがケソン州4つの村を直撃、豚飼育者に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は豚のみに影響し人への健康被害はなく、フィリピンでは既知の継続的な家畜疫病であり、社会的・国際的関心も限定的なため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ASFは人獣共通感染症ではなく、豚肉の安全性にも影響しないと明記されている。国内農業当局による通常の防疫対応（検査・殺処分・移動制限）であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai viêm dạ dày - ruột do virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy with viral gastroenteritis.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, a 21‑month‑old boy with viral gastroenteritis presented with vomiting, abdominal distension, and 3–4 loose stools daily. Leukocytosis and elevated CRP were noted; glucose, electrolytes, and calcium were normal. Ultrasound showed mesenteric lymphadenopathy and small free fluid in the right iliac fossa. No focal neurological signs; meningitis was excluded. Brain MRI found bilateral occipital subcortical white‑matter abnormalities, interpreted as post‑ictal. Rotavirus, Norovirus, and Adenovirus were negative. Diagnosed with a seizure after acute viral gastroenteritis of unknown etiology, with concurrent acute upper respiratory infection. Treatment included seizure control, rehydration and electrolyte management, and symptomatic GI/respiratory care, plus nasal irrigation with 0.9% saline. After 3 days, vomiting stopped, seizures did not recur, and the child was discharged. Prevention: handwashing, safe food/water, Rotavirus vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性胃腸炎の男児
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児症例報告であり、病原体はロタウイルス・ノロウイルス・アデノウイルスいずれも陰性で原因不明。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、検査でロタウイルス・ノロウイルス・アデノウイルスは陰性。公衆衛生イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh truyền nhiễm gia tăng, cảnh báo nguy cơ lây lan trong trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious diseases on the rise, warning of transmission risk in schools.
article.articleSummary: Rising respiratory infections in Hai Phong and Hai Duong, Vietnam, driven by Influenza A, Adenovirus, RSV, hand-foot-mouth disease, and mumps. Cold weather and crowded schools are fuelling transmission, with pediatric hospitalizations increasing. In Hai Duong, the pediatric wards see about 80 admissions daily, and the Hai Duong General Hospital pediatric unit averages 50 inpatients per day. In Hai Phong, the Children's Hospital reports roughly 300 outpatient visits daily and over 500 inpatients, up about 10% from earlier, with Adenovirus and RSV most common; at the International Treatment Center, about one-third of respiratory inpatients test positive for Adenovirus. From January–November 2026, Hai Phong recorded 6,055 influenza cases and 5,445 hand-foot-mouth cases; the International Pediatric Hospital Hai Phong treated 2,994 hand-foot-mouth cases in 10 months. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, and sore throat, with risks of bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and respiratory failure in young children. Vaccination (annual influenza; MMR) and hygiene are emphasized to mitigate spread.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症が増加、学校内での拡大リスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・手足口病の増加であり既知の病原体によるものだが、小児入院数の増加傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の流行であり、既存の病原体（インフルエンザA、RSV、アデノウイルス、手足口病、ムンプス）による学童・幼児の感染増加。重症度は中等度（気管支炎・肺炎リスク）で、ワクチン接種と衛生対策が呼びかけられている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Transferable Superbug Genes Identified in Gut Bacteria from Healthy
article.articleSummary: In 2025, a targeted survey in Yunnan Province, southwestern China, screened 1000 non-duplicate intestinal samples from healthy individuals at the People's Hospital of Jingdong Yi Autonomous County and found 7.2% carried blaNDM-positive Escherichia coli (72 participants). Of these, five isolates (6.9% of the resistant group) also harbored additional determinants: three with blaNDM+tet(X4) and two with blaNDM+mcr-1, conferring resistance to carbapenems plus either tigecycline or colistin. Phenotypic testing confirmed multidrug resistance. In vitro conjugation showed horizontal transfer of blaNDM, tet(X4), and mcr-1 to a recipient E. coli J53 under selective conditions. Whole-genome sequencing revealed diverse lineages (ST48, ST69, ST12468, ST567, ST19107, ST10) and an IncHI2A blaNDM-bearing plasmid in LL104 with a conserved mobile element. The study indicates resistance determinants circulate in healthy gut microbiota, highlighting risks for dissemination of last-resort resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 健康な個人の腸内細菌から伝達可能なスーパーバグ遺伝子を同定
triage.triage_reason: 健康人の腸内細菌における多剤耐性遺伝子保有の学術的サーベイランス報告であり、現時点で疾病発生やアウトブレイクではないが、薬剤耐性拡散リスクの観点から継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病アウトブレイクではなく、健康な被験者を対象とした薬剤耐性遺伝子の保有率調査（研究報告）。症例や臨床的影響の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する段階ではないが、カルバペネム・チゲサイクリン・コリスチン耐性遺伝子の水平伝播可能性は将来的なリスク要因として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழ்நாட்டில் நாளை இந்த 6 மாவட்டங்களில் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்.. எங்கெல்லாம் தெரியுமா?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Tamil Nadu, tomorrow in these six districts there will be polio drops vaccination camps. Do you know where they are?
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination camps will be held tomorrow in Tamil Nadu's six districts — Chengalpattu, Mayiladuthurai, Sivaganga, Thanjavur, Tirunelveli and Virudhunagar — as part of National Polio Drops Day. Although Tamil Nadu has remained polio-free for 22 years, the Indian Polio Virus Expert Advisory Group identified 272 districts across 21 states at risk due to poliovirus circulation in neighboring countries. In Tamil Nadu, 6,647 vaccination centers—including government primary health centers, hospitals, Anganwadi and nutrition centers, schools and other sites—will operate from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. All children under five will receive polio drops; even those previously vaccinated will be re-dosed on camp day, and newly born infants should also receive the dose. The campaign aims to vaccinate about 916,000 children.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州で明日、6地区にてポリオ経口ワクチン接種キャンプ開催…場所はどこ？
triage.triage_reason: 記事はポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、タミル・ナードゥ州は22年間ポリオフリーを維持しているため、実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、実際のポリオ症例報告ではない。近隣国でのポリオウイルス circulation を理由にしたリスク地域指定への対応策として実施されている。タミル・ナードゥは感染事例の発生地ではないため、対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Backyard Animals in Rural China Harbor Diverse Drug-Resistant Escherichia
article.articleSummary: ESBL-producing Escherichia coli were widely carried in backyard livestock and domestic environments in twelve rural villages of Shandong, China, based on July 2015 fecal and environmental sampling of 1,044 specimens, with an overall carriage rate of 44.7%. Species-specific colonization was highest in pigs (78.7%), followed by cattle (61.5%), sheep (50.0%), ducks (28.6%), dogs (14.1%), chickens (11.5%), and cats (5.3%). Houseflies in yards yielded 74 resistant isolates from 180 specimens. The study, part of the Sino-Swedish IMPACT project, highlights backyard farming as a substantial reservoir outside industrial facilities, with pig-rearing duration being the sole independent risk factor for herd colonization (OR 1.2 per unit increase). Phenotypic resistance showed 100% to cefotaxime, 95.9% to tetracycline, 92.7% to TMP-SMX; colistin resistance observed in 23.8% (mcr-1 detected in 83 isolates, highest in swine at 23.5%). All isolates remained susceptible to meropenem and tigecycline. Whole-genome sequencing revealed dominant phylogroup A (83.5%) and multiple sequence types, notably ST10 and ST48.

triage.headline_ja: 中国農村部の裏庭家畜に多様な薬剤耐性大腸菌が保有されている
triage.triage_reason: 2015年実施の研究論文に基づく学術報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 2015年の過去データに基づく学術研究報告であり、薬剤耐性菌の環境リザーバーに関する基礎研究。急性の感染症アウトブレイクではないため経過観察の対象ともしがたい。

article.articleHeadline: لقاح تجريبي للملاريا يحقق فعالية 87% في منع العدوى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An experimental malaria vaccine achieves 87% efficacy in preventing infection.
article.articleSummary: PfSPZ-LARC2 malaria vaccine demonstrated 87% efficacy in preventing infection in a controlled human malaria infection trial. The West Africa-derived live, genetically attenuated parasite vaccine was tested against a Brazil-derived parasite strain, suggesting cross-strain protection. In the trial, 7 participants received placebo and all were infected, while 15 vaccinated participants had only 2 infections (13 protected) after exposure 12–16 weeks post-final dose. The vaccine was safe and well tolerated, with infected participants receiving prompt treatment. PfSPZ-LARC2 primes immunity by exposing the immune system to a live, attenuated parasite and blocks liver-stage development. Results were presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting in Washington. Malaria causes over 600,000 deaths annually, underscoring the importance of vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 実験的マラリアワクチン、感染予防効果87%を達成
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン治験の研究結果報告であり、実際の疾病発生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は臨床試験（治験）の学会発表結果であり、米国ワシントンでの学会発表に関する内容。発生地域として挙げられた国々（米国、ブラジル、アンゴラ）は、ワクチン開発の背景説明（西アフリカ由来株、ブラジル由来株との比較試験）に過ぎず、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。対象国リストに該当する実発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: UoH students fall ill after consuming mess food
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, around 50 University of Hyderabad (UoH) students fell ill after consuming mess food on campus. Most cases were from M Hostel; symptoms included nausea and diarrhoea, with at least one student later reporting high fever. Between midnight and early morning, 38 students were treated at the university health centre; several others sought care off-campus or returned to hostels, with some avoiding treatment due to Friday examinations. An emergency medical camp was set up near Men's Hostel; a university official noted that food samples and ingredients have been sent for testing and that all campus messes were inspected. A committee is investigating. Officials acknowledged potential contribution from outside food consumed at a protest programme and highlighted limited on-campus medical staff, including a campus ambulance driven by a research scholar. Students demanded regular inspections and separate mess facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード大学の学生が食堂の食事摂取後に体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一の大学食堂における食中毒疑いの集団発生であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低く、局地的な食品衛生事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いの集団発生で、大学内の食堂食品が原因と推定される。感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）の性質ではなく、食品衛生問題として大学・地域当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵致死率近百禽流感 印度發表首款國產H5N1疫苗 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curbing the nearly 100% fatality rate of avian influenza; India launches its first domestically produced H5N1 vaccine.
article.articleSummary: India launched its first domestically developed vaccine against highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1, unveiled by Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal. Developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, the vaccine targets HPAI H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a. H5N1, an influenza A virus subtype, causes near-100% mortality in infected poultry, threatening the poultry industry. Chouhan touted the vaccine as a demonstration of India’s self-sufficiency in biotech R&D. Attendees included Vishwas Sarang and BJP MP Alok Sharma. With global avian influenza outbreaks rising, the Indian program aims to protect poultry, stabilize domestic supply chains, and advance public health and animal vaccine autonomy through domestically produced solutions.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの致死率ほぼ100%を抑制、インドが初の国産H5N1ワクチンを発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は家禽用H5N1ワクチンの開発・発表に関するニュースであり、新規の感染拡大やヒト感染事例の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽向けH5N1ワクチンの国産化発表であり、ヒトへの新規感染や症例急増を示す情報は含まれていない。感染症危機管理の観点からは動物衛生分野の技術開発ニュースとして扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya Mengintai, Kenali Gejala yang Kerap Disangka DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Lurks: Recognize Symptoms Often Mistaken for Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: On 21 November 2026, Pontianak, West Kalimantan, Indonesia, health authorities warn of chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. While mortality is very low, the infection can cause debilitating joint pain that disrupts daily life and can make walking difficult for some time. Dr. Fujiyanto, SpPD, explains the illness presents with sudden fever, joint pain, muscle aches, headache, and a red skin rash; most patients recover, though joint pain can persist and affect quality of life. Chikungunya and dengue share vectors and several symptoms, yet dengue is caused by dengue virus while chikungunya is due to the chikungunya virus. Because symptoms overlap, diagnosis cannot rely on presentation alone; medical examination and laboratory testing are needed to distinguish the two and guide appropriate management.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱に注意、デング熱と誤認されやすい症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発・症状鑑別に関する記事であり、具体的な症例数増加やアウトブレイクの報告がなく、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性を示す情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は医療啓発目的の内容で、具体的な感染者数や発生規模の報告はない。蚊媒介感染症としての流行可能性は一般論として存在するが、本記事単独では続報を要する段階にも至らない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: MSF appelle à élargir l'accès au vaccin Ervebo dans l'est du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF calls for expanding access to the Ervebo vaccine in the eastern part of the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-21, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 11,680 confirmed cases and 5,700 deaths, the deadliest in the country’s history. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) calls for rapid expansion of access to Ervebo, the only Ebola vaccine widely available, currently administered only within the Tumaini clinical trial. Ervebo is approved against the Ebola Zaire strain and is given to frontline healthcare workers; the trial seeks efficacy against Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization notes two additional vaccines joining the trial by end of November: ChAdOx1 (Oxford University with an Indian pharmaceutical partner) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna). Two other candidates—Minapharm (Egypt) and IAVI—are still in earlier stages. Expanding access aims to broaden protection beyond trial participants amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 コンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団（MSF）が東部地域でのエルベボ・ワクチンのアクセス拡大を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行は11,680人の確定症例・5,700人の死亡者数に達し同国史上最悪の規模で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: エジプト（Minapharm社）はワクチン候補開発拠点として言及されているのみで、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in R.D. Congo: morti oltre 1.700 bambini in 6 mesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: more than 1,700 children have died in six months.
article.articleSummary: Six months after the Ebola outbreak began in eastern DR Congo, 2,959 confirmed cases among under-18s and 1,737 deaths were reported as of Nov 4. Children are 28% of confirmed cases but 35% of fatalities; under-five children account for 14% of cases, 21% of deaths, and about 72% CFR in this group. Many children lack access to specialized care; about 80% of child deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers, and late presentation is common; one under-five admitted dies within 24 hours. Women and girls exceed 53% of cases; among 10–17-year-olds, girls 15–17 represent two-thirds of cases and three-fifths of deaths. UNICEF and partners are expanding targeted responses in priority zones, reinforcing surveillance, early diagnosis, infection prevention, and continued access to health, nutrition, WASH, protection, and education, while urging governments and donors to bolster pediatric care and family support and protect frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：6か月間で1,700人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が6か月継続し、子どもを中心に高い致死率（特に5歳未満で約72%のCFR）を示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行（発生から6か月時点）に関する小児・女性への影響を詳述。UNICEFをはじめとする国際機関が対応を拡大中であり、国境を越えた拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記載なし（不明）。

article.articleHeadline: Shivraj Singh Chouhan launches India's first homegrown H5N1 bird flu vaccine
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-21, Union minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan unveiled India's first indigenously developed H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from bird flu. Developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, it is described as the first-of-its-kind vaccine in India against the H5N1 virus of Clade 2321a within the highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) group. The vaccine targets poultry to reduce transmission and safeguarding commercial and backyard flocks. The report does not provide any case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information on infection sources, imports, or exports. This milestone underscores India’s domestic vaccine capabilities for avian influenza and may influence future surveillance and control measures.

triage.notes: 本記事は家禽用ワクチンの発表に関するものであり、ヒトへの感染事例や症例数、死亡者数などの疫学的情報は含まれていない。動物衛生分野のニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛醫藥最新進展　美麻疹疫情升溫與新藥研發動態 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Developments in Global Public Health and Medicine: The U.S. Measles Outbreak Intensifies and Updates on New Drug Development - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-19, the United States faces its most severe measles outbreak in decades, with 5,838 cases reported by the CDC and one death of a Virginia toddler. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is spreading, with infections exceeding 10,000 and deaths over 5,500, as scientists work to understand its unusually rapid transmission. These infectious-disease updates underscore ongoing public health surveillance and outbreak containment efforts, and highlight the substantial burdens of measles in the US and Ebola in DRC on health systems, underscoring the imperative for vaccination, rapid diagnosis, and strengthened response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 全世界の公衆衛生・医薬最新動向　米国の麻疹流行拡大と新薬開発の動き - 民視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の感染者が1万人超、死者5500人超に達し、異常に急速な伝播が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の麻疹流行とDRCのエボラ流行の2件を並列で報じているが、米国（Virginia含む）は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのエボラ（感染者10,000人超、死亡5,500人超、異常な速い伝播）が深刻なためPICKUP判定とした。続報でDRCの国際支援要請や渡航制限の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: العلماء يكثفون أبحاثهم لفهم سلالة بونديبوجيو لاحتواء تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists intensify their research to understand the Bundibugyo strain to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths, with spread roughly twice as fast as the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak. No vaccine or approved therapy is available. Diagnostics are challenging: tests for other Ebola strains may miss Bundibugyo, and hemorrhagic symptoms occur in only 5–10% of confirmed cases. About 70% of patients die in communities rather than in health facilities, complicating surveillance. Children under five show diarrhea as a prominent symptom rather than fever; 1,207 confirmed cases in under-fives with 844 deaths (about 70%). Ongoing research includes roughly 700 survivors joining studies and support programs to understand long-term effects. The outbreak is exacerbated by conflict, displacement, and weak health services in several areas.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行封じ込めに向けブンディブジョ株の理解のため研究を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が1万1000人以上の感染・5500人以上の死亡に達し、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ紛争・避難民により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRCでの流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの言及はないため除外。ワクチン・治療法が存在せず、致死率も高いため極めて深刻な事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: நாளை போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்.. தமிழகத்தின் இந்த 6 மாவட்ட குழந்தைகளுக்கு கட்டாயம் போடணும்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drop vaccination camp tomorrow.. Mandatory for the children in these six districts of Tamil Nadu!
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination camp to be held tomorrow across six districts of Tamil Nadu (Chengalpattu, Mayiladuthurai, Thanjavur, Sivagangai, Tirunelveli, Virudhunagar) targeting 9.16 lakh children under five with oral polio vaccine doses. The campaign runs from 7:00 am to 5:00 pm on Sunday, November 22, at 6,647 centers. Tamil Nadu has been polio-free for 22 years, and India is declared polio-free, yet cross-border spread in neighboring countries has prompted the Polio Virus Expert Advisory Group to identify 272 districts across 21 states as potentially polio-affected. In the six districts, children will receive OPV at health facilities, schools, colleges, private hospitals, and mobile camps, including at bus stands, railway stations, testing checkpoints, wedding venues, and travel hubs. About 27,000 personnel are deployed. Even with prior routine immunization, vaccines will be re-administered on the camp day.

triage.headline_ja: 明日、ポリオ経口ワクチン接種キャンプ開催…タミルナードゥ州の6地区の子どもたちに必須接種！
triage.triage_reason: これはルーチンの予防的ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、タミルナードゥ州はポリオフリーを22年間維持し、インドもポリオフリー宣言済みで、実際の症例報告や異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。周辺国でのポリオ拡大を受けた予防的措置として271地区が注意対象とされているが、タミルナードゥ州やインドでの症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: प्रत्येक बालकाला २२ नोव्हेंबरला पोलिओचे डोस; मुंबईत रविवारी पल्स पोलिओ मोहीम; २३ ते २७ नोव्हेंबरदरम्यान लसीकरण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio doses for every child on 22 November; Pulse Polio campaign in Mumbai on Sunday; Vaccination from 23 to 27 November.
article.articleSummary: Mumbai will launch Pulse Polio on 22 November to keep India polio-free, providing two doses of polio vaccine to every child under five under a Sub-National Immunization Day. From 23 to 27 November, a house-to-house special immunization drive will be conducted. Even children who have previously received doses are to be given two doses during this campaign. The drive aims to identify unvaccinated or partially immunized children and ensure no child is left out, with planning involving WHO, UNICEF, UNDP, medical colleges, Integrated Child Development Services, Army, Navy, Indian Academy of Pediatrics, NGOs, and city health officials. Mumbai's municipal corporation emphasizes post-vaccination follow-up, community meetings, and parental counseling, with Anganwadi workers, volunteers, police, mohalla committees, and religious leaders coordinating awareness efforts. The campaign seeks to maintain polio-free status after India was declared polio-free in 2014, despite neighboring countries still having transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 全ての子供に11月22日ポリオ投与；ムンバイで日曜日にパルスポリオ運動；11月23日から27日にかけて予防接種
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ発生事例ではなく、インドのポリオフリー状態維持のための定期予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規感染報告は見られない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever at Udupi Police Station: Dengue fever among 11 police officers in three months.
article.articleSummary: Udupi, Karnataka: Dengue fever has resurfaced at the Udupi City Police Station, infecting 11 officers, including an inspector, over the past three months. Monthly cases have ranged from two to three police personnel needing treatment. In response, city authorities have fumigated the station interior and surrounding premises to curb transmission. The report offers no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, fatalities, infection source, or imported/exported cases. This outbreak underscores ongoing dengue activity in the area and prompts targeted vector-control efforts around public-facing law-enforcement facilities to prevent further spread.

article.articleHeadline: Measles resurgence puts young children at greatest risk as global
article.articleSummary: Measles resurges worldwide, hitting mostly children under five as vaccination coverage remains below the 95% needed for herd immunity. In 2024 an estimated 11 million measles cases occurred globally, causing about 95,000 deaths, per WHO. Transmission is airborne for up to two hours; up to 90% of unvaccinated exposed individuals become infected. Waning vaccination rates in 2025 left global first-dose coverage at 84% and second-dose at 77%. Several countries have lost measles-free status, including the United States, Mexico and Bolivia, with Britain, Canada, Austria, Armenia, Spain, Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan also affected. Bangladesh reported nearly 240,000 suspected cases and 1,282 deaths since March; the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a measles surge amid an Ebola outbreak. Uganda reports a return of measles after years of absence, underscoring gaps in vaccine access and misinformation.

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനിക്ക് വിട; ആദ്യ തദ്ദേശീയ പ്രതിരോധ വാക്സിൻ വികസിപ്പിച്ച് ഇന്ത്യൻ ശാസ്ത്രജ്ഞർ, കോഴി കർഷകർക്ക് ആശ്വാസം | India Develops First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farewell to poultry; Indian scientists develop the first indigenous preventive vaccine, bringing relief to poultry farmers
article.articleSummary: India-developed indigenous preventive vaccine against H5N1 avian influenza in poultry, created by scientists at NIHSAD under ICAR in Bhopal. The immunization program was unveiled by Union Agriculture Minister Shivaraj Singh Chouhan; each vaccine dose costs 1–2 Indian rupees. The research team includes Dr. S. Nagarajan, Dr. Manoj Kumar, Dr. C. Tosh, Dr. H.V. Murugkar, Dr. Aniket Sanyal, Dr. Senthil Kumar D, Dr. Naveen Kumar, and Dr. Yogisharadhya R. The scientists followed stringent biosafety norms. A new, advanced veterinary disease research laboratory in Bhopal is to cost Rs 300 crore. The minister highlighted national scientific self-reliance, noting two indigenous COVID vaccines were developed within nine months. Economically, animal husbandry contributes about 14% of GDP and poultry about 1%; major animal diseases cause roughly Rs 56,000 crore in annual losses, with affordable vaccination expected to aid small-scale poultry farmers.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザに別れを：インド人科学者が初の国産H5N1ワクチンを開発、養鶏農家に朗報

article.articleHeadline: Pulmonary Tuberculosis Patients Show Altered Gut Viral Diversity and Phage
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis in a China-based cohort (46 patients vs 31 healthy controls) shows altered gut virome composition. TB patients exhibit significantly reduced gut viral alpha-diversity, with a modest overall compositional shift; multivariate dispersion differed between groups. Viruses enriched in healthy controls belonged to Fervensviridae and Phycodnaviridae, while TB-enriched OTUs were dominated by Microviridae and Winoviridae. TB-associated viruses more frequently linked to Bacteroides and Parabacteroides; control-associated viruses linked to butyrate-producing Gemmiger, Lachnospira, and Roseburia. Cross-kingdom networks revealed 1,182 significant bacterium–virus co-abundance relationships in TB vs 922 in controls, with distinct topology. Functionally, the LexA repressor (KEGG K01356) was more prevalent among TB-associated viral OTUs, suggesting stress-response roles. Diagnostic models: virus-only AUC 91.5% (discovery); external 89.4%; bacteria-only 90.6% (discovery) and 95.0% external; combined ~89.5% external. Conclusion: gut virome alterations and phage–host dynamics characterize pulmonary TB.

triage.headline_ja: 肺結核患者では腸内ウイルス多様性とファージネットワークが変化している

article.articleHeadline: qPCR Outperformed Serological Tests in Screening Asymptomatic Dogs for
article.articleSummary: Yangquan City, Shanxi Province, China, hosted a field comparison of four diagnostic assays for Leishmania infection in 175 asymptomatic dogs from an endemic area. Quantitative PCR detected Leishmania kinetoplast DNA in 54 dogs (30.9%), far higher than serology: IFAT 28/175 (16%), multi-antigen rapid diagnostic strips (MARD) 15/175 (8.6%), and rK39 strips 12/175 (6.9%). The findings underscore a large gap between molecular detection and antibody-based screening on peripheral blood in field surveillance. Canines are the main reservoir for zoonotic visceral leishmaniasis, transmitted to humans by Phlebotomus sandflies. In China, the disease comprises three types; Shanxi lies on the eastern Loess Plateau where Yangquan’s transmission intensified after 2015, with 258 human cases (2006–2021). Prior canine seropositivity was 7.4% in domestic dogs and 20% in tested strays. Blood samples were collected April–July 2024; serology and qPCR were performed in September 2025, with qPCR targeting kinetoplast DNA minicircles via a TaqMan probe.

triage.headline_ja: 無症状犬のリーシュマニア感染スクリーニングにおいて、qPCRが血清学的検査を上回る性能を示した
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断手法の学術的比較研究であり、人への急性アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。既知の風土病地域における通常の疫学的サーベイランス情報に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は犬を対象とした診断法比較研究であり、ヒト感染拡大の報告ではない。既知の風土病地域（山西省陽泉市）における既存のサーベイランスデータに基づく内容。

article.articleHeadline: DOH urges public to observe precautions vs. flu, respiratory infections
article.articleSummary: Influenza (trangkaso) and other respiratory infections are a focus as weather changes and crowded indoor gatherings raise transmission risk in the Philippines. The Department of Health clarifies that heat, cold, or rain do not cause influenza; the illness is caused by a virus presenting with cough, colds, and fever. The virus spreads via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces, with higher risk in enclosed spaces such as homes, schools, and offices. Preventive measures include wearing face masks, especially when symptomatic or in crowds; regular handwashing; avoiding crowded, poorly ventilated areas; practicing proper cough etiquette; and staying home with flu-like symptoms to prevent spread. Seek early medical consultation if symptoms worsen. Filipino patients can access PhilHealth YAKAP clinics for checkups and labs, and PhilHealth GAMOT facilities for affordable medications.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、季節性インフルエンザ・呼吸器感染症への注意喚起

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue orienta moradores do Boqueirão e da Boa Vista - Curitiba | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control drive guides residents of Boqueirão and Boa Vista, Curitiba | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: Boqueirão and Boa Vista in Curitiba host a dengue-control drive under the Curitiba sem Mosquito program, ongoing since Nov 16, 2026. Health agents educate residents on dengue prevention and proper disposal of bulky waste, with recyclable items collected later by municipal trucks. By Nov 19, agents had covered 15 blocks around the Eucaliptos Health Unit in Alto Boqueirão and 20 blocks around Vila Esperança Health Unit in Atuba. Final collection of sorted materials is planned for Nov 24 in Boqueirão and Nov 26 in Boa Vista. Residents should place waste outside on collection days, with small items bagged. Recyclables such as bottles, plastics, metal containers, tires (max two per household), and vegetative scraps are accepted; construction debris, toxic waste, furniture, appliances, and vehicles are excluded. The effort targets Aedes aegypti, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza infection in Kattiyanguppam: Central Public Health Committee members conduct on-site inspection
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak being investigated in Kattiyanguppam, Krishnankuppam panchayat, Cuddalore district. Central Public Health Committee members conducted an on-site inspection to assess the situation, visiting local poultry farms and engaging with residents to gauge infection status and overall health conditions. They are documenting the outbreak's transmission dynamics, evaluating measures to prevent further spread, including farm controls and community surveillance. As of 21 November 2026, findings and recommended actions are being reviewed by authorities. Emphasis remains on farm-level containment and community engagement, with ongoing monitoring and reporting planned. The inspection is part of routine surveillance to curb avian influenza in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Five Critical Infant Pertussis Cases Survived After Exchange Transfusion
article.articleSummary: Five infants under six months with critical pertussis survived to hospital discharge after multimodal therapy combining anti-infective treatment, mechanical ventilation, and therapeutic exchange transfusion at Xiamen Maternal and Child Health Hospital, College of Medicine, Xiamen University, analyzing cases from 2022–2024. The median age at admission was 80 days. All cases presented with severe tachycardia, tachypnea, cyanosis, acute respiratory failure, and hyperleukocytosis. Despite critical illness, each patient improved and was discharged; three-month post-discharge follow-up showed no lingering respiratory sequelae. The study highlights Bordetella pertussis as the etiological agent and notes a global resurgence with infants under six months at highest risk due to incomplete DTaP vaccination. The small retrospective series cannot determine the independent contribution of exchange transfusion relative to other interventions. Published in Frontiers in Medicine (Intensive Care Medicine and Anesthesiology section); authors Huifen Zhang, Xiaoqing Yang, and Jiming Li from Xiamen University-affiliated institution.

article.articleHeadline: 11月仍是手足口病发病小高峰 家长别松劲防护指南请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: November still sees a small peak in Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease incidence; parents, don't let your guard down—please keep these protective guidelines.
article.articleSummary: In Fuzhou, November remains a small HFMD peak; national data rank HFMD, influenza, and other infectious diarrhoea among October’s top Class C diseases, accounting for 99.2% of reports. Since 2026, HFMD activity has been higher nationwide, with a southern peak. Circulating pathogens are CVA6, CVA16, CVA10, and EV-A71, with EV-A71 most linked to severe disease; no cross-immunity among serotypes, so reinfection is possible. Children under 5 are most affected; adults can be asymptomatic carriers. Early symptoms resemble a cold, followed by mouth ulcers and a rash on hands, feet, or buttocks; most recover in 7–10 days, though CVA6/CVA10 may cause nail shedding 2–4 weeks later. Seek care for high fever >3 days, seizures, vomiting, lethargy, or rapid breathing. Preventive measures: handwashing, vaccination, ventilation, avoiding shared utensils, and limiting crowded indoor places. EV-A71 inactivated vaccine is recommended for 6 months–5 years, with full course ideally before 12 months.

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. تحذيرات من ارتفاع وفيات الأطفال جراء تفشي "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo... Warnings of rising child deaths due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with escalating child mortality. WHO reports 844 deaths among 1,207 confirmed Ebola cases in children under five, part of a total of over 5,500 deaths from more than 11,000 cases over more than six months. Early diagnosis is hindered by the scarcity of hemorrhagic symptoms (only 5-10%), causing misclassification with malaria and high community mortality (about 70% die outside health facilities). There is currently no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. Ongoing field research seeks to understand Bundibugyo's nature and to strengthen the response amid humanitarian and environmental challenges that hamper containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ…エボラ出血熱の流行による子どもの死亡増加への警告
triage.triage_reason: 希少なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で5,500人超の死者、承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認された治療法・ワクチンが存在しない希少株（Bundibugyo）であり、致死率・誤診率の高さから公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: New Malaria Vaccine Shows 87% Protection Against Infection
article.articleSummary: PfSPZ-LARC2, a malaria vaccine candidate using genetically weakened whole Plasmodium falciparum parasites that can reach the liver but cannot enter the bloodstream, showed 87% protection in a Phase 1 trial of 22 healthy adults in Seattle. Fifteen vaccinated and seven given placebo; after controlled exposure to live parasites 12–16 weeks post-vaccination, two vaccinated volunteers were infected versus all seven in the placebo group. The vaccine was safe and well tolerated. Challenge strains included West Africa for the vaccine parasite and Brazil for exposure, suggesting potential cross‑strain protection. Findings were presented on 19 November 2026 at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting. Globally, malaria caused about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024 (WHO), with ~95% of cases in Africa and children under five accounting for ~75% of deaths. Existing vaccines RTS,S and R21 offer partial protection; next steps include larger trials in African adults and children.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいマラリアワクチン、感染に対して87%の予防効果を示す

triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン臨床試験（米シアトル実施）の学会発表に関する報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。発生地域にBrazil・Angolaが含まれるが、これはチャレンジ株の由来地として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue | TN | வேகமாக பரவும் டெங்கு - இந்த ஒரே மாதத்தில் நடுங்கும் மாவட்டம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue | Tamil Nadu | Rapidly spreading dengue — the district that trembles this month.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading rapidly in Ramanathapuram district, Tamil Nadu. From November 1 to 21, 2026, 107 dengue cases have been diagnosed and treated in government and private hospitals in the district. Hundreds more have viral fever and are admitted to hospitals. With the onset of the rainy season across districts, dengue and other viral fevers are rising. Standing rainwater is aiding Aedes mosquito breeding, prompting calls from residents for intensified vector-control measures, including elimination of mosquito larvae and spraying insecticides in affected areas. The situation underscores the need for sustained public health interventions to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱 | タミル・ナードゥ州 | 急速に拡大するデング熱 — この1ヶ月で震撼する県
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州の一地域で季節性デング熱が増加しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念はなく、通常の季節的流行の範囲内とみられる。
triage.notes: 雨季に伴う季節性デング熱の増加で、インド国内の地方ニュースとして報道。107例という数字は限定的な地域規模であり、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低いが、拡大傾向のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 太脏了！青田人快自查！很多人最近在用，有人"高烧40℃，肺部感染"-青田网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's too dirty! Qingtian residents, check yourselves now! Many people have been using it recently; some have 'a fever of 40°C and a lung infection' — Qingtian Net.
article.articleSummary: Legionella pneumonia linked to unclean air-conditioning systems in Xi’an, Shaanxi Province, China. A 38-year-old man, previously healthy, developed high fever near 40°C, headache, and coughing after prolonged use of a hot-air heater with a poorly cleaned air conditioner. He then suffered severe pneumonia, respiratory failure, septicemia, and a concurrent Aspergillus infection, yet survived after intensive medical care. Legionella infection is not seasonal; it thrives in damp, water-filled environments, including inadequately maintained air-conditioning filters and moisture-bearing devices. The incubation period is 2–10 days, with early symptoms that can be non-specific, such as fatigue and muscle pains, soon followed by high fever. Early neurological signs—somnolence, confusion, delirium or hallucinations—can help distinguish Legionella pneumonia from common colds or flu. Authorities urge cleaning or replacing humid, moisture-laden equipment to reduce risk and to inspect cooling and ventilation systems.

triage.headline_ja: 汚すぎる！青田の皆さん今すぐ自己点検を！最近多くの人が使用、ある人は「高熱40℃、肺感染」に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際拡大リスクは認められない。レジオネラ症はエアコン設備由来の散発例であり社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者（38歳男性）の症例報告であり、エアコン設備の衛生管理に関する一般向け注意喚起記事。アウトブレイクやヒト-ヒト感染の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of high child death rate in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak shows alarmingly high child mortality: 1,207 confirmed cases in children under 5 with 844 deaths (about 70% fatality in this age group), versus roughly 50% among adults. Bleeding symptoms occur in only 5–10% of Bundibugyo cases, complicating early diagnosis and increasing misclassification as malaria; tests for other Ebola strains do not detect Bundibugyo. About 70% of patients die in the community rather than in healthcare facilities, hindering containment. Field research continues to characterize the strain; there are no licensed treatments or vaccines. Ongoing humanitarian and environmental challenges impede response. Globally, the outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases and over 5,500 deaths, with Bundibugyo spreading at roughly twice the pace of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ流行における高い小児死亡率を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(Bundibugyo株)流行は死亡率が極めて高く、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で、国際的拡大とさらなる公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのBundibugyo地域でのエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。ウガンダ・アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文での言及はなく除外。グローバルで11,000例超・5,500人超の死亡と記載されており、対象国以外の地域（西アフリカ等）にも拡大している可能性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി പ്രതിരോധം; പ്രഭവകേന്ദ്രങ്ങളുടെ പരിധിയിൽ അണുനശീകരണം | Bird Flu Prevention: Disinfection at Outbreak Hotspots
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu Prevention: Disinfection at Outbreak Hotspots
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, at Ambalappuzha North and the Chennithala–Thripunithura gram panchayats. The district Animal Husbandry Department disinfected one kilometer around the outbreak sites using four PPE-clad rapid-response teams, employing flame gas and sodium hypochlorite spray; this completes the first containment phase. A 10-km surveillance zone around the origin centers will yield samples every two weeks and be sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal for three months. If three months pass with negative results, the area will be declared bird-flu-free. Migratory birds are believed to have introduced HPAI to the state, spreading to local domestic birds via water bodies. To curb spread, poultry sales and transport within the 10-km zone are prohibited for one week. Surveillance covers Alappuzha, Harippad, Mavelikkara municipalities and numerous panchayats, including some in Pathanamthitta district.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ予防：発生拠点での消毒作業
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）が家禽に確認され、当局が封じ込め対応中だが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、渡り鳥由来の季節的発生とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例はケララ州Alappuzha郡の家禽（鳥）でのHPAI発生であり、ヒト感染の報告はない。動物衛生当局による消毒・サーベイランス・移動制限など通常の家禽感染症対応プロトコルが実施されている。検体送付先のBhopal（Madhya Pradesh）は検査機関所在地であり発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Antiviral activity of Clinacanthus siamensis Bremek ethanolic extract against dengue virus serotype 2 infection
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) infection remains without a specific antiviral therapy, with vaccines showing variable efficacy. An ethanolic extract of Thai medicinal herb Clinacanthus siamensis demonstrated potent anti-DENV activity in vitro, yielding an IC50 of 19.32 µg/mL. Time-of-addition experiments revealed the greatest inhibition under pre-treatment conditions, with viral protein levels reduced to 92.79±7.74%, 60.30±9.79%, and 12.52±10.18% at 15.625, 31.25, and 62.5 µg/mL, respectively, indicating action at early infection stages. Virus-binding assays showed pretreatment of virions with the extract impaired their ability to bind host cells, suggesting a direct effect on viral particles. LC-MS/MS identified two antiviral constituents, isoferulic acid and luteolin, that may contribute to the effect. Overall, Clinacanthus siamensis exhibits anti-DENV activity by reducing infectivity early and warrants further development as an affordable therapeutic candidate against DENV infection.

triage.headline_ja: Clinacanthus siamensis Bremekエタノール抽出物のデング熱ウイルス血清型2感染に対する抗ウイルス活性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（in vitro抗ウイルス活性の実験研究）であり、実際の疾患発生・アウトブレイク情報ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイの薬用植物を用いたデングウイルスに対する抗ウイルス薬開発の基礎研究であり、実際の感染症流行・発生事例を報告するものではない。発生地域としてタイが付与されているが、これは研究材料の原産地情報であり、疾患発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூரில் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதித்த பகுதிகளில் மத்திய குழுவினர் நேரில் ஆய்வு! - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuddalore: Central team conducts on-site inspection in areas affected by avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Central government authorities dispatched a field team to Kattiyanguppam in Cuddalore district to carry out on-site inspections of poultry farms affected by avian influenza. The visit underscores government attention to the outbreak as teams assess conditions firsthand. The report records severe poultry losses, with approximately 50,000 chickens dead in the preceding two weeks due to avian influenza. The inspections aim to document the extent of the outbreak and review the situation in the affected farms within this area. The article details the location and the scale of mortality linked to avian influenza as of November 21, 2026, as authorities monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: カダルール:鳥インフルエンザの影響を受けた地域で中央政府チームが現地視察を実施
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ大量死（約5万羽）が報告され中央政府が視察に入ったが、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、現時点では動物衛生事象としての継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽(養鶏場)の鳥インフルエンザ被害と政府の現地調査について述べており、ヒトへの感染事例は記載されていない。疾患名タグに'Human Infection'とあるが本文内容とは一致しない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: A febre baixou. Por que a dengue ainda pode piorar?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fever has dropped. Why could dengue fever still get worse?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever can worsen after fever subsides. Defervescence typically occurs days 3–7, and a critical phase (24–48 hours) may follow, due to capillary leakage and plasma loss leading to reduced blood volume and possibly shock, sometimes without fever. Alarm signs within 48 hours of the temperature drop include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, gum or nasal bleeding, dizziness or fainting, marked drowsiness, difficulty breathing, cold extremities, or greatly reduced urine. Laboratory indicators such as rising hematocrit with falling platelets support assessment, but decisions hinge on clinical context. Hydration is central; mild cases may be home-managed with fluids, while severe cases require intravenous hydration and hospital monitoring. Avoid acetylsalicylic acid and NSAIDs (ibuprofen, diclofenac) due to bleeding risk. A fever’s improvement does not guarantee recovery; care should follow medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: 熱は下がった。なぜデング熱はまだ悪化する可能性があるのか?
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の臨床経過・重症化サインに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の病態生理・臨床的警告サイン・治療ガイダンスに関する解説記事であり、ブラジルにおける具体的な発生状況や症例数の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: रायपुर में अगले 48 घंटे रहें सावधान! चक्रवात अकवान का दिखेगा असर, अस्पतालों में बढ़े वायरल के मरीज | Cyclone Akvan Raipur Weather Update Viral Fever Health Alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant in Raipur for the next 48 hours! The impact of Cyclone Akvan will be felt, with a rise in viral fever patients in hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Raipur, 21 November 2026 — Cyclone Akvan from the Bay of Bengal has changed Raipur’s weather, bringing rainfall, humidity (~89%) and a day-temperature drop from 28.4°C to 23.1°C within 48 hours. The system maintains yellow alerts across 11 districts including Balodabazar, Dhamtari, Gariaband, Mahasamund, Surguja, Jashpur, Balrampur, Korba, Raigarh and Janjgir-Champa. Viral fever, asthma and bronchitis risk rise with the cold-damp spell; dengue and malaria testing is up post-monsoon. Hospitals (AIIMS, Ambedkar, district and private) expect more patients than last year; Oct–Nov saw over 3 lakh seasonal illnesses, this year surpassing 4.5 lakh treated so far. Ambedkar’s three departments handle about 800 patients daily. Authorities have eight-point readiness: uninterrupted oxygen, power backup, 108 ambulances, and mobile medical teams for low-lying areas. Do not self-medicate; consult a doctor and use steam inhalation where advised. Relief anticipated from 22–23 November.

triage.headline_ja: ライプルで今後48時間は要警戒！サイクロン「アクワン」の影響で病院のウイルス性発熱患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: サイクロンに伴う気象変化により季節性のウイルス性発熱・デング・マラリア検査が増加しているが、これは例年の季節パターンに沿ったものであり、明確な異常発生や国際的拡大の兆候は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・チャッティースガル州ライプル周辺でのサイクロンによる気象変化とそれに伴う季節性疾患（ウイルス性発熱、喘息、気管支炎）の増加、及びデング・マラリア検査増加を報じている。現地当局は既に8項目の対応体制を整えており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。続報で患者数・重症度の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Standard Risk Model Outperforms Expanded Framework in Predicting COVID-19
article.articleSummary: In Wuhan, China, during the early COVID-19 outbreak, 822 local adults (March 3–5, 2020) completed an online survey testing PRISM against an expanded PRISM that added source beliefs, past information seeking, and outcome expectancies. The original five-factor, 21-indicator PRISM fit the data well, with perceived knowledge positively linked to knowledge insufficiency; however, perceived behavioral control and affective risk responses did not directly predict knowledge insufficiency, and attitudes toward seeking did not directly relate to seeking intention. The expanded model, comprising nine factors and 44 indicators, yielded poorer fit metrics, and after adding structural paths, remained inferior. It explained about 30 percent of the variance in information-seeking intentions, indicating diminished predictive power compared with the original framework. Conclusion: for predicting public COVID-19 risk information seeking in this Wuhan sample, the standard PRISM outperforms the expanded framework.

triage.headline_ja: 標準リスクモデルが拡張フレームワークを上回り、COVID-19情報探索行動を予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年のCOVID-19流行初期における情報探索行動に関する学術研究（心理モデル比較）であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の懸念を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年3月の過去データを用いた行動科学・心理測定モデルの研究報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため対象国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists intensify research into Bundibugyo Ebola strain amid Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugayo Ebola strain continues to drive the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, with more than 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths reported as of 2026-11-21. Scientists and WHO and Africa CDC urge intensified research to understand its spread and improve containment; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. Diagnostic challenges hinder early detection: standard tests for other Ebola strains do not identify Bundibugyo, and bleeding is uncommon (5–10% of confirmed cases). About 70% of patients die in communities rather than in healthcare facilities, complicating case detection and contact tracing. Children under five account for 1,207 confirmed cases and 844 deaths, nearly seven in ten pediatric cases, while adult mortality is around 50%. Gastrointestinal symptoms predominate in children, complicating diagnosis. About 700 survivors are enrolled in research studies and support programs, amid conflict and limited healthcare access in multiple areas.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがコンゴのアウトブレイクを受けてブンディブギョ・エボラ株の研究を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が継続し、11,000人超の感染・5,500人超の死亡、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ大陸全体ではなくDRC国内のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクを主題としているため、Africa（大陸）は除外しDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。渡航・貿易制限に関する直接の言及はないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus Found in Agricultural Irrigation Water Across China Shows Marked
article.articleSummary: Norovirus was detected in agricultural irrigation water across 27 Chinese cities, with 17 of 200 sampled sites testing positive. The study found a marked seasonal rise in detection during winter compared with spring. Water sources included rivers, lakes, groundwater, and municipal irrigation supplies, and samples were collected December 2023–April 2024 across northern and southern China, categorized by the Qinling-Huai River line (47 southern, 153 northern). Using tangential flow filtration and RT-qPCR, plus murine norovirus as a process control and GB 4789.42-2025-compliant spiking, the researchers quantified viral genomes and evaluated environmental reservoirs. Norovirus genogroups I and II were tracked; GI infects humans, GII has broader hosts including swine, suggesting potential cross-species transmission. Norovirus is a major global cause of acute gastroenteritis, with infectious dose <20 particles; contaminated irrigation water may transfer viruses to crops such as lettuce, strawberries, and tomatoes, impacting produce safety.

triage.headline_ja: 中国全土の農業用灌漑水からノロウイルスが検出、冬季に顕著なピークを示す
triage.triage_reason: 灌漑水からのノロウイルス検出という環境調査結果であり、ヒトの症例報告や集団発生は確認されていないが、食品安全・公衆衛生上の潜在リスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（環境水質調査）であり、ヒト感染症例の報告ではない。食品（レタス・イチゴ・トマト等）汚染経路としての潜在的リスクが指摘されているが、実際の健康被害の発生は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Belajar dari Penyakit Enzy Storia, Kenali Gejala Infeksi Virus & Parasit Amuba, Berawal Sakit Perut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learning from Entamoeba histolytica infection, recognize the symptoms of viral infections and amoebic parasite infections, starting with abdominal pain.
article.articleSummary: Indonesian actress and presenter Enzy Storia Leovarisa was hospitalized with severe abdominal pain and diagnosed with a viral infection and Entamoeba histolytica amoebic parasite infection. Therapy included stool testing, antiparasitic drugs, and fluids, supported by handwashing, boiled water, and sanitation. The article explains that viruses hijack host cells to replicate and spread via droplets, sexual contact, shared needles, insects, or animal contact. Risk factors include poor sanitation, crowded settings, age extremes, chronic illnesses, risky sexual behavior, and sharing items. Symptoms vary by system: respiratory infections cause cough, fever, and sore throat; CNS involvement can lead to fever, seizures, confusion; GI infections cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; skin infections cause rash and itching. Prevention emphasizes vaccination (varicella, shingles, influenza, HPV, hepatitis A/B, measles, mumps), hand hygiene, masking, avoiding close contact with the sick, and safe practices. Many viral illnesses resolve with supportive care; prevention remains key.

triage.headline_ja: エンジー・ストリアの病気から学ぶ、ウイルス・アメーバ寄生虫感染症の症状を知る―始まりは腹痛から

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak alert: Central team visits Cuddalore
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak confirmed in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with zero human infections to date. Lab confirmation occurred November 13, 2026, after initial bird deaths reported October 30 at Thamanampatti; Kattiyankuppam samples tested positive at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal. About 35,600 birds died across 15 farms before confirmation; roughly 100,000 chickens have died or been culled. Affected areas include near Kullanchavadi, Kattiyankuppam, and coastal zones Nadukattu and Thyagavalli. Containment measures: culling within a 1-km radius, deep burial, sanitization, and a three-month ban on restocking/broiler breeding in the zone, plus movement restrictions on poultry/products. A central NCDC team is overseeing medical camps, swab testing for cough/fever, and prevention to avert human transmission. Smaller detections at Vandalur Zoo (Chennai) and in Tiruvallur; statewide surveillance extended to Namakkal.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ発生警戒：中央チームがクダロールを訪問
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でH5N1鳥インフルエンザが家禽に拡大し、約10万羽が死亡・殺処分される大規模発生。ヒト感染は未確認だが、NCDC中央チームがヒトへの伝播防止のため医療キャンプとサーベイランスを展開しており、人獣共通感染症としての警戒が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例は報告されていないが、NCDC中央チームが咳・発熱のスワブ検査と医療キャンプを実施しており、ヒトへの伝播リスクを監視中。複数地域（クダロール、チェンナイ・ヴァンダルー動物園、ティルヴァッルール、ナマッカル）での検出が報告されており、州全体での監視が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: 流感季出现新特点 这些防护要点请收好 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Characteristics in the Flu Season: Take Note of These Protective Measures
article.articleSummary: China reports rising influenza activity in November, with three strains circulating—A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and influenza B—marking a shift from pattern of single-dominant strain. National surveillance shows about 65.4% of positive samples are A(H1N1) or A(H3N2) and 34.6% are B; cross-protection between strains is weak, so infection with one does not guarantee protection against others. The season is arriving earlier: southern provinces recorded rising positivity from late September, northern areas from late October. High-risk groups—65 years and older, children under 5, pregnant or perinatal women, immunocompromised individuals, chronic diseases and obesity—are more prone to severe disease; elderly may have less fever but more lung signs. Persistent fever, poor response to antipyretics, or symptoms beyond 5 days warrant caution. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention; it is a timely window. Antivirals are prescription-only and influenza-specific; avoid self-medication. Recovery (1–3 weeks post-fever) includes myocarditis risk with vigorous exercise; seek care for chest symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザシーズンに新たな特徴 これらの予防ポイントを押さえよう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況と予防啓発に関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
