article.articleHeadline: 诺如病毒难杀灭？医生警告呕吐物勿用地拖　揭全屋消毒正确4步骤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus hard to eradicate? Doctors warn against mopping up vomit; four proper steps for whole-house disinfection
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreaks peak in autumn–winter. This virus persists over two weeks on hard and soft surfaces. Viral shedding may continue for two weeks or more after symptoms end, so those who recover should avoid food preparation for others at least 48 hours. Do not mop vomit; use disposable towels to prevent aerosol spread. Four-step cleanup: wear disposable gloves and a surgical mask; blot from edge to center; seal contaminated waste in bags; disinfect and ventilate. Bleach solutions: general surfaces 1:99; heavily contaminated areas 1:49; CDC says contact time 5 minutes; CHP 15–30 minutes. Launder contaminated textiles by soaking in 1:49 for 30 minutes, wash at ≥60°C, and dry on high heat; steam-clean if not washable. After cleaning, soak reusable tools in 1:49 for 30 minutes. Handwash with running water for 20 seconds; avoid alcohol sanitizers. Cleveland Clinic physician Matthew Goldman emphasizes hygiene, bleach disinfection, and not handling food during illness.

triage.headline_ja: ノロウイルスは除去困難？医師が嘔吐物にモップを使わないよう警告　正しい全室消毒4ステップを解説
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な家庭衛生・消毒方法に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な発生地域・患者数・アウトブレイク事例の報告がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性ノロウイルスに関する一般的な衛生啓発情報であり、特定国でのアウトブレイク発生を報じたものではない。発生地域フィールドに米国・香港・中国が含まれるが、記事内容は特定地域の発生事例ではなく一般的な注意喚起のため、該当国なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: mãe que perdeu a filha e paciente que sobreviveu contam suas histórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: a mother who lost her daughter and a patient who survived tell their stories.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Brazilian Federal District (Distrito Federal, DF) is highlighted on National Dengue Combat Day (Nov 21, 2026) with two stark experiences. DF reported a 54% drop in probable dengue cases through epidemiological week 45 (by Nov 16, 2026): 4,540 cases this year vs 9,904 in 2025, and notifications declined from 21,544 to 13,060. In 2023, Camila Isaac, 40, lost her seven-year-old daughter Pietra Isaac de Carvalho to dengue hemorrhagic fever; the case is in court seeking accountability from a physician after an initial misdiagnosis and delayed hospitalization. Conversely, 61-year-old Alex Coelho Papeira of Ponte Alta survived dengue hemorrhagic fever in 2023, requiring ICU care and later recovery, attributing his illness to a neighbor’s contaminated pool and warning against self-medication. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; clinicians note the risk window around days 3–7 after fever onset, while El Niño may influence transmission but is not the sole cause.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：娘を亡くした母親と生還した患者が自身の体験を語る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦直轄区における啓発記念日に合わせた過去の患者体験談の特集記事であり、症例数はむしろ前年比54%減少しているため、新規または異常な公衆衛生イベントのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング撲滅全国デーに合わせた過去（2023年）の重症例の体験談と、2026年の症例数減少傾向を報じる内容であり、現在進行形の異常な発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: ਭਾਰਤ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲੀ ਮੁਰਗੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ Bird Flu ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਸਵਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਵੈਕਸੀਨ; ਕੀਮਤ, ਵਾਇਰਸ ਦਾ ਵੇਰੀਐਂਟ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੋ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਗੱਲਾਂ - India gets its first indigenous vaccine to protect chickens from Bird Flu know the price the virus variant and other key details | ਭਾਰਤ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲੀ ਮੁਰਗੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ Bird Flu ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਸਵਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਵੈਕਸੀਨ; ਕੀਮਤ, ਵਾਇਰਸ ਦਾ ਵੇਰੀਐਂਟ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੋ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਗੱਲਾਂ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India gets its first indigenous vaccine to protect chickens from avian influenza (Bird Flu); know the price, the virus variant, and other key details.
article.articleSummary: India launched its first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine on 20 November 2026. The inactivated-virus vaccine, developed by NIHSAD under ICAR, targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a—the dominant strain in Indian poultry outbreaks. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan called it the world’s first indigenous H5N1 vaccine. Priced at about 1–2 rupees per dose, it aims to be affordable for small poultry farmers. NIHSAD’s team includes Dr. S. Nagarajan, Dr. M. Kumar, Dr. C. Tosh, Dr. H.V. Murugkar and colleagues. Since 2006, India has faced recurring outbreaks (notably Maharashtra’s Nawapur first outbreak with ~1 million birds dead; 2021 losses ~900,000). In 2026, year-to-date losses total around 200,000. Recent incidents include Kerala’s Alappuzha district (18 Nov: 18,600 birds and 28,040 eggs destroyed) and Tamil Nadu’s Kurinjipadi taluk, where H5N1 was confirmed on 5 November; culling included thousands of birds and feed destruction. Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district outbreak occurred in October.

triage.headline_ja: インドが初の国産H5N1鳥インフルエンザワクチンを開発、鶏向けに導入—価格・ウイルス株などの詳細
triage.triage_reason: 鶏向けH5N1ワクチンの国産化という前向きな動物衛生ニュースであり、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、既知の継続的な家禽アウトブレイクに対しインド自身が対応能力を示している。
triage.notes: 記事はヒト感染ではなく家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ対策（ワクチン開発）に関する内容。ヒト症例の報告なし。ケララ、タミル・ナードゥ、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州での家禽アウトブレイクは既知かつ継続的事象として記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Jabalpur Rabies Scare: Around 250 Villagers Get Vaccinated After Cow Dies Following Dog Bite
article.articleSummary: Rabies scare in Chargawan village, Jabalpur district, Madhya Pradesh, after a cow died following a suspected rabid dog bite. About 200–250 villagers received rabies vaccines at Chargawan Primary Health Centre as a precaution. The cow, bitten while grazing, showed rabies symptoms and died around midnight; owner Nakul Patel buried the animal. Several villagers had consumed the cow’s milk and dairy products. Health officials emphasised there is no established evidence that rabies is transmitted through milk, curd, or buttermilk. Dr Indu Rajput, in-charge of Chargawan PHC, and CMHO Dr Naveen Kothari advised residents not to panic and to seek immediate medical attention after an animal bite or exposure to an animal’s saliva.

triage.headline_ja: ジャバルプール狂犬病騒動：犬に噛まれた牛が死亡後、約250人の村人がワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: インドでは狂犬病は風土病であり、本件は予防的ワクチン接種にとどまり人への感染確定例もないため、通常の地域対応事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 牛が狂犬病様症状で死亡し、咬傷歴のある犬との接触を受けた住民が予防的にワクチン接種を受けた事例。人への感染確定例は報告されておらず、乳製品からの感染エビデンスも否定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ 3 tuổi tử vong do sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 3-year-old child dies from dengue fever in Đắk Lắk.
article.articleSummary: Three-year-old H.S.N. from Ea Wi hamlet, Krông Pắc district, Đắk Lắk province, died of dengue fever. Onset 6 November with fever; NS1 antigen positive and dengue diagnosed. By 11 November the child developed liver injury and coagulopathy, was admitted to the ICU, and progressed to respiratory failure, dengue shock, multi-organ failure, pleural effusions and GI bleeding. Real-time RT-PCR from Tây Nguyên Institute confirmed Dengue virus type 1. Ea Wi hamlet comprises 651 households (3,443 residents); by 16 November there were 22 dengue cases and one outbreak. Krông Pắc commune reported 519 cases and 11 outbreaks, with 3 active. Control measures included indoor spraying of adult mosquitoes at the patient’s home and around 100 households, vector surveillance, and public guidance. Health messages urge seeking care for warning signs such as severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, lethargy, bleeding, or cold limbs; prevention via sanitation, water management, and mosquito bite prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省で3歳児がデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省における季節性デング熱流行の一環での小児死亡例であり、地域アウトブレイクは継続中だが国際的拡大や渡航制限等IHR基準には該当しない。重症度・流行継続性の観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ベトナムでは季節性にデング熱が流行しており、本件は地域内アウトブレイク（Krông Pắc郡519例・11アウトブレイク）の一部。死亡例はあるが異常な病原性変化や国際的拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ổ dịch cúm A và quai bị trong trường học tại Quảng Ninh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A and mumps outbreak detected in a school in Quảng Ninh
article.articleSummary: On 21 November 2026, Quảng Ninh health authorities reported two infectious disease clusters in Hải Ninh commune, Quảng Ninh Province, Vietnam, within local schools. Lý Thường Kiệt High School reported 50 cases of influenza A. Hải Tiến Primary and Secondary School reported 19 cases of mumps. To curb spread in classroom and community, Hải Ninh Commune Health Station, in coordination with school leaders, initiated environmental disinfection using Chloramine B across over 20,000 square meters, including classrooms and common areas. Public health messaging intensified: reinforce hand hygiene, ventilation, and avoidance of close contact; students with fever, cough, sore throat, or swelling in the parotid area should notify schools and health facilities for guidance. After one week of disinfection, local health workers will reassess risk and monitor cases to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省の学校でA型インフルエンザとおたふく風邪の集団発生が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 学校内でのインフルエンザA型とおたふく風邪の集団発生だが、季節性疾患であり重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局が消毒・監視対応を実施中であり、既知の季節性疾患（インフルエンザ・おたふく風邪）の学校内集団発生。国際的な懸念や重症例報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 營外五十步：圊、汲水與軍中癘疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifty Paces Outside the Camp: Latrines, Fetching Water, and the Plague in the Army
article.articleSummary: Historical military campaigns link sanitation to disease outcomes. Sunzi’s guidance to station camps on high, dry ground away from dampness foreshadows the idea that disease follows environment, not just enemy action, with military “no hundred diseases” only achievable by controlling the camp’s soil and water. The Red Cliffs episode (208 CE) is the classic example: Cao Cao’s forces faced a major epidemic after moving into new water and soils, undermining battle readiness; pre-battle warnings by Zhou Yu cautioned that Central Plains troops unfamiliar with local water and land would contract disease. Thus, plague there stemmed from transferring troops into unfamiliar ecologies, not merely camp hygiene. In Ming–Qing times, cleanliness routines persisted, yet epidemics returned (notably in Jiangnan around 1862–63). The text stresses a boundary: camp sanitation protects the interior but cannot guard against external environmental pathogens. It also notes weapon logistics—bow and crossbow materials—whose moisture sensitivity and seasonal production reveal how epidemics and wear simultaneously erode military capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 営外五十歩：便所、水汲みと軍中の疫病
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代中国の軍事史における衛生と疫病の関係を論じる歴史・文化的考察記事であり、現代の実際の感染症発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は赤壁の戦い（208年）や明清時代の疫病史を題材とした歴史コラムであり、現代の実際の発生事例に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: WIC Semarang Siapkan Program Perbaikan Rumah Tak Sehat Milik Penderita TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WIC Semarang Prepares a Program to Improve Unhealthy Housing Owned by TB Patients
article.articleSummary: WIC Semarang plans to expand humanitarian outreach by repairing substandard housing owned by tuberculosis (TB) patients in Bandarharjo, North Semarang. The initiative aims to improve living conditions for TB-affected residents and strengthen social support networks. President Christine Leksono says the organization, which marks its 51st year, will continue social and humanitarian programs alongside internal consolidation and member expansion. The program follows WIC Semarang's broader activities, including cleft lip surgery, foster-parent programs, disaster relief drives, Ramadan 'pasar murah' markets, and nutrition support for pregnant women to combat stunting. The 51st anniversary celebrations occurred on 20 November 2026 at Hotel Gumaya Semarang, with prior social programs carried out in Purwodadi and Blora. WIC emphasizes nonsectarian, apolitical community service and friendship across diverse backgrounds.

triage.headline_ja: WICスマラン、結核患者の不衛生な住宅改善プログラムを準備

triage.notes: 本記事は結核のアウトブレイクではなく、NGOによる住宅改善支援プログラムの紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Ấn Độ ra mắt vaccine giá rẻ đầu tiên cho gia cầm, phòng cúm H5N1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India Launches the First Low-Cost Poultry Vaccine to Prevent H5N1 Avian Influenza
article.articleSummary: India launches the first low-cost poultry vaccine to prevent H5N1 avian influenza. The domestically developed vaccine, created by NIHSAD under ICAR, costs about 1-2 rupees per dose and was unveiled by Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The vaccine’s price point aims to lower immunization costs and enable broad vaccination of poultry, safeguarding the livelihoods of millions of smallholder farmers. India’s poultry sector is a key rural income source, contributing roughly 1% to GDP, with livestock contributing about 14%. Avian disease outbreaks have caused substantial losses, including the 2006 Maharashtra outbreak that killed nearly one million chickens and led to widespread culling; since then India has faced more than 500 avian influenza outbreaks. H5N1 poses spillover risks to mammals and humans, underscoring the importance of domestic vaccine development and biosecurity.

triage.headline_ja: インドが鶏向け初の低価格H5N1鳥インフルエンザワクチンを発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事は家禽向け新規ワクチンの発表に関する内容であり、現時点での人・動物の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・発表のニュースであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。過去の2006年事例や500件以上の発生歴に言及しているが、現在の感染状況・新規症例情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Point Santé : une première usine africaine pour produire des vaccins contre le choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Update: Africa's first factory to produce cholera vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Zambia has launched ZAMVAX, Africa’s first cholera vaccine factory, with a $24.1 million investment and up to 20 million oral doses annually to curb reliance on external stockpiles amid recurring cholera in Africa, including Malawi’s Blantyre campaigns. WHO Africa and the European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) will strengthen African medical research, trials, and regulation to translate results into policy, aligning with the African Medicines Agency’s technical committees. In South Africa, anti-migrant protests disrupt care, risking interruptions for HIV, TB, pregnant women and children and potentially driving resistance. Eritrea’s elimination of trachoma as a public health problem was WHO-validated, making it the 11th African region country to reach the milestone, though surveillance continues. Ebola Bundibugyo remains Africa’s major challenge: the DRC reports over 11,600 confirmed cases and 5,600 deaths (CFR ~48.9%), with Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria reporting cases. Senegal’s Pasteur Institute of Dakar seeks to bolster local vaccine production. Date: 2026-11-21.

triage.headline_ja: 保健情報：コレラワクチンを製造するアフリカ初の工場
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコレラワクチン工場開設の話題を中心としつつ、DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,600例超・死亡5,600例（致死率約48.9%）に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにも拡大していると報告しており、IHR基準複数該当・重症度も極めて高いためフルRRAに進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラワクチン工場（ザンビア）、南アフリカの抗移民抗議によるHIV/TB医療中断、エリトリアのトラコーマ排除達成、DRCのエボラ大流行など複数トピックを含む複合記事。最も重大な公衆衛生シグナルはDRCのエボラ流行（高致死率・多国への拡大）であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外した。ザンビアはコレラワクチン生産拠点としての主題性から含めたが、現地での感染症発生そのものではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Gắn trách nhiệm người đứng đầu trong phòng, chống dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: Holding department heads accountable for dengue fever prevention and control
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, has reached 13,074 new cases and 3 deaths through November 20, 2026, with 81 active outbreaks. The surge is driven by alternating rain and sun and water-filled containers that sustain Aedes mosquito breeding; several localities show gaps in eradication efforts and surveillance. In response, Vice Chairman Ho Thi Nguyen Thao issued a directive to strengthen prevention and control, mandating that all agencies and local governments prioritize dengue, implement the four-at-site principle, and assign responsibility to communes and hamlets. The Department of Health leads weekly risk assessments, enhances epidemiological and vector surveillance, and oversees outbreak investigation, larviciding, insecticide spraying, and stockpiles of chemicals and equipment. Local centers will bolster staffing and coordinate with authorities to prevent healthcare overload. Very high-risk areas include Buon Ma Thuot wards, and localities such as Tan An, Tan Lap, Ea Kao, Krong Pac, Tan Tien, Ea Tul, Cu M’Gar, Ea Drong, and Hoa Phu.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省:デング熱の予防・対策における責任者の責任明確化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省でデング熱症例13,074件・死亡3例と流行が継続しているが、デング熱は同地域の風土病であり異常性は低く、既存の行政対応枠組みで管理されているためフルRRAには至らないが継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性・風土病的に流行しており、地方政府主導で対応中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da covid dispara no Brasil e causa sintoma curioso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant surges in Brazil and causes a curious symptom.
article.articleSummary: New COVID-19 variant Stratus (XFG), a descendant of Omicron, is driving a surge in Brazil, accounting for 90% of sequenced samples by the Ministry of Health and fueling growth in 17 states and the Federal District. Test positivity rose from 1% to 17% over three months, the highest in 2026. Fiocruz reports increased hospitalizations for SRAG. Symptoms include sore throat, hoarseness and voice changes, plus fever, malaise and nasal congestion; most cases resolve in about 7 days, though vulnerable patients may develop dyspnea and complications. Data indicate Stratus is a natural mutation with no greater clinical severity or significant vaccine escape. By Nov 9, 2026, Brazil had 118,920 cases, 3,641 severe cases and 445 deaths. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure, especially for those over 65 (68% of deaths). Adults under 60 without comorbidities and vaccinated may skip boosters; unvaccinated should seek vaccination at health posts.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジルで急増、奇妙な症状を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19新変異株Stratus(XFG)による陽性率急増・入院増加が報告されており、WPRO基準の複数該当とメディア・保健省の注目が見られるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 記事によれば変異株Stratus(XFG)は既知のオミクロン系統で、臨床的重症度増加やワクチン回避の顕著な証拠はないとされる。ただし陽性率急増・入院増加・17州への拡大が報告されており、国内保健当局（保健省・Fiocruz）が監視中。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman que llegó una nueva cepa más contagiosa del Covid a la Argentina y que ahora crecen los casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They confirm that a new, more contagious COVID-19 strain has arrived in Argentina and that cases are now increasing.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 Omicron lineage under WHO surveillance, has arrived in Argentina amid rising COVID-19/respiratory infections. Globally, PJ.2.1 is increasing in the Americas, with detections in Canada and the United States and new Brazilian cases across Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. In Argentina, three PJ.2.1 samples from hospitalized patients in Buenos Aires Province and the City of Buenos Aires were sequenced by the Public Health Laboratory’s Genomics and Molecular Area at La Plata’s National University of Exact Sciences; all were PJ.2.1. Two infants (1 and 2 months) and one 58-year-old adult were affected. Laboratory data indicate vaccines adapted to LP.8.1 and XFG (Frankenstein) can neutralize PJ.2.1, though virulence data are inconclusive. Symptoms mirror a cold/flu: fever, cough, sore throat, nasal discharge. Vaccination guidance emphasizes pregnant individuals, those 65+, and immunocompromised patients; Argentina offers US mRNA vaccines publicly and ARVAC, a recombinant protein subunit vaccine, in pharmacies. Formosa and others are expanding testing.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンに新たな感染力の強いCOVID-19株が到達、症例が増加していることを確認
triage.triage_reason: WHO監視下のOmicron系統PJ.2.1が南米複数国（アルゼンチン・ブラジル・カナダ・米国）で検出され症例増加中であり、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的関心（メディア報道・公衆衛生当局の対応）も認められるためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新株確認だが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル複数州（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、エスピリトサント、リオグランデドスル、サンタカタリーナ）での症例確認が明記されているため、ブラジルのみ対象国として列挙。症状は軽度（風邪様）で重症化報告は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Morcego transmite raiva? O que fazer após possível contato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can a bat transmit rabies? What to do after possible exposure.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure from bats in Curitiba, Brazil, requires immediate medical evaluation for any bite, scratch, or direct contact. Guidance from the city emphasizes washing the wound with soap and water before presenting to a health unit, where clinicians determine the appropriate treatment. Do not touch or handle the bat; isolate it and call 156 to arrange removal and laboratory testing by the Unidade de Vigilância de Zoonoses (UVZ). Contact near a child or in a bedroom warrants evaluation even without visible wounds. If dogs or cats contact a bat, take them to a veterinarian; isolate the bat if present and request removal. Vaccination against rabies is stressed, with UVZ offering free vaccination at Rua Lodovico Kaminski 1,381, CIC, Curitiba. Rabies is a Lyssavirus infection affecting the CNS, transmitted mainly by bat saliva via bites or saliva contacting wounds and mucous membranes; early treatment saves lives.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリは狂犬病を媒介するか？接触後の対処法
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、コウモリとの接触後の一般的な狂犬病予防ガイダンス記事であり、異常事態やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・クリチバ市の公衆衛生当局による狂犬病予防啓発情報であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行を報告するものではないため、対象国に該当する発生事例として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Chilanga Acting DC Calls For Combined Efforts In Cholera Fight
article.articleSummary: Chilanga district, Zambia, has recorded 146 cholera cases since August, with two deaths (one in the community and one at a health facility). On 19 November 2026, there were 5 new admissions and 4 discharges; 3 patients remain admitted in health facilities. The highest case numbers are in Kasupe and Chilanga wards. Four wards report relatively high locally acquired cases, indicating ongoing community transmission: Mt Makulu Ward (23), Nyemba Ward (16), New Farms Ward (13), and Mondegwa Ward (10). Other wards have smaller counts: Kalundu (1), Nakachenje (1), Chilongolo (3), Namalombwe (3), and Mwembeshi (4). District officials plan to strengthen surveillance and community-level interventions and will closely monitor the situation. Acting District Commissioner Maureen Chilende urged concerted efforts from all stakeholders to fight the disease, stressing the importance of healthy people for production and continued cholera response.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：チランガ地区代理コミッショナー、コレラ対策への協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア・チランガ地区で8月以降146例・死亡2例のコレラ発生が継続し、複数ワードで地域内感染（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）が確認されており、当局者も対応強化を呼びかけているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ行政の関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 地方紙の報道であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記載されていないが、複数ワードでの地域内感染継続と死亡例の発生から、続報を注視しつつ初期スクリーニングとしてPICKUP相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Changing seasonality and trends of other infectious diarrhea and norovirus across the pandemic era in Shenzhen China
article.articleSummary: OID (other infectious diarrhea) and norovirus trends in Shenzhen, China, from 1 Jan 2013 to 31 Jul 2025 analyzed across pre-, during-, and post-COVID-19 periods. The study uses 578,222 OID reports plus monthly norovirus GI-positive, GII-positive, and GI+GII-positive series. In a climate-adjusted ARMA(2,0) model, OID reports fell 48.1% in Feb 2020 and then rose 2.15% per month, with a slope-change of 1.13% per month (CI included zero). A Jan 2022 sensitivity model suggested a positive post-break trend of 3.28% per month, but its slope-change also included zero. A three-segment model found no additional acceleration in Jan 2022 relative to 2020–2021. Meteorological covariates (temperature, relative humidity, wet-day frequency) did not explain the later positive trend. Conclusion: changing surveillance dynamics during the COVID-19 era, not a unique or causal 2022 acceleration, drive observed patterns in Shenzhen.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・深圳におけるパンデミック期を通じた感染性下痢症およびノロウイルスの季節性・傾向の変化
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文であり、サーベイランス動態の分析が主題で、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常なアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去データ（2013-2025年）を用いた統計学的研究論文であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、地理的発生地域としての該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : Ebola gagne du terrain, le gouverneur accentue la mobilisation communautaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uele: Ebola gains ground, the governor steps up community mobilization.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, the Haut-Uélé territory of Watsa reports 19 Ebola positive cases, including 3 deaths, prompting a high-level mobilization drive. Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu led a community-sensitization meeting in Watsa, urging all segments of the population to engage in the outbreak response, trust health teams, and observe barrier measures, while countering rumors. The gathering, attended by the provincial security committee, deputies, the Kinshasa-based Incident Manager, technical and financial partners, health officials, administrative and customary authorities, and civil society, emphasized acceptance of the disease and rapid reporting of deaths. The Provincial Health Division's response lead outlined Ebola symptoms and risk behaviors, stressing swift collaboration with responders. Participants pledged to relay prevention messages across communities to boost vigilance; authorities underscored collective responsibility to curb transmission and protect residents of Haut-Uélé.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州：エボラが拡大、知事が地域社会動員を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCオート・ウエレ州ワツァでエボラ陽性19例・死亡3例が確認され、政府・国際パートナーが大規模対応を実施中であり、重大な公衆衛生リスクと国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)に基づき常に通報対象となりうる疾患であり、死亡例を伴う継続的な感染拡大が確認されているため、速やかなフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Des défis considérables pour endiguer l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC, selon Handicap International : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Significant challenges to stem the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, according to Handicap International: News.
article.articleSummary: Significant challenges to stem the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, described as the deadliest in the country's history. Handicap International identifies three hurdles: terrain and nature, with small Ebola foci scattered across vast forests; chronic insecurity, including jihadist-IS-affiliated groups; and community mistrust. In Ituri, epicenter, the outbreak has spread to eight provinces, with about 500 new cases per week. The WHO has begun testing two new vaccines; if confirmed, mass vaccination will require cold-chain delivery to electricity‑free zones. HI plans three advanced storage hubs in Ituri to secure vaccines and supplies. Logistical bottlenecks include convoys taking 2–4 weeks through crevasses and mud, plus last‑mile transfers on smaller vehicles and collapsed bridges. Security incidents total 80 since May; the ADF has killed at least 110 civilians in Ituri since early November. Cultural resistance to funeral practices necessitates educated, safe, dignified funerals with PPE for relatives and uninterrupted shipments.

triage.headline_ja: ハンディキャップ・インターナショナルによれば、DRCのエボラ流行を食い止めるには大きな課題がある
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪とされるエボラ流行が8州に拡大し週500例の新規感染があり、治安悪化・物流障壁・ワクチン展開の困難が重なるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: イツリ州を震源に8州へ拡大、週500例の新規感染、ADFなど武装勢力による治安悪化とワクチン物流の課題が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue nặng, bệnh nhân suy đa tạng phải hồi sức 45 ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Dengue fever, a patient with multiple organ failure required 45 days of intensive care.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-21, a 44-year-old woman with severe dengue fever developed dengue shock and multi-organ failure at Bình Dương General Hospital, Vietnam. After four days of fever and body aches, she presented with shock (BP 100/80 mmHg), cold extremities, and abdominal pain. Despite resuscitation, plasma leakage caused recurrent shock and multi-organ dysfunction including acute anemia, respiratory failure, metabolic acidosis, and acute kidney injury. She required intensive care with endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, and continuous renal replacement therapy combined with plasma exchange. Approximately 12 hours later her hemodynamics stabilized, but 24 hours later liver failure progressed. Two weeks into care she developed pneumonia due to multidrug-resistant bacteria, requiring targeted antibiotics. After about three weeks, liver and kidney function improved and she was extubated; after 45 days in intensive care, she was discharged with recovery. Clinicians emphasize early medical consultation and avoiding self-medication that can worsen bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 重症デング熱、多臓器不全の患者が45日間の集中治療を要する
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症デング熱に関する臨床報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な流行拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性・流行性疾患だが、本記事は個別患者の臨床経過報告であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す記述はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനിക്കെതിരെ വികസിപ്പിച്ച ആദ്യത്തെ തദ്ദേശീയ വാക്സിൻ (H5N1) കേന്ദ്ര കൃഷിമന്ത്രി ശിവരാജ് സിങ് ചൗഹാൻ പുറത്തിറക്കി. ഒരു ഡോസിന് ഒന്ന് മുതൽ രണ്ട് രൂപ വരെയാണ് വില. ഭോപ്പാലിലെ ICAR-NIHSAD ആണ് കോഴികളെയും താറാവുകളെയും സംരക്ഷിക്കാനുള്ള വാക്സിൻ വികസിപ്പിച്ചത്. കേരളം ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്ള സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി വ്യാപിക്കുന്ന സാഹചര്യത്തിൽ കർഷകർക്ക് വലിയ ആശ്വാസമാകുന്ന ചുവടുവെപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First indigenous vaccine developed against avian influenza (H5N1) released by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The price per dose ranges from ₹1 to ₹2. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal to protect chickens and ducks. A development that will bring significant relief to farmers as avian influenza spreads in states including Kerala.
article.articleSummary: First indigenous vaccine against avian influenza (H5N1) released in India, announced by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal to protect chickens and ducks; price per dose ₹1–₹2. Described as the world’s first vaccine against this H5N1 variant. With bird flu spreading in states including Kerala, the vaccine offers relief to farmers, though current control measures rely on culling. Official confirmation on sale remains pending. Since the 2006 Navapur, Maharashtra outbreak, India has reported over 500 outbreaks. In 2021, about 1 million chickens died; this year around 200,000 have died. WHO data since 2003 report 1,003 human infections and 479 deaths. Bird symptoms: bluish combs/patches, bloody beak discharge, greenish diarrhea, breathing difficulties. Human symptoms: fever, dehydration, headache, cough, throat pain, respiratory distress. Precautions: wear gloves and masks when handling affected birds, wash hands, bury or burn carcasses; fully cook poultry meat and eggs; report unusual bird illness to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1）対策として、インド初の国産ワクチンを連邦農業大臣シヴラージ・シン・チョウハンが発表。1回分の価格は1～2ルピー。ボパールのICAR-NIHSADが鶏・アヒル保護用に開発。ケララ州を含む複数州で鳥インフルエンザが拡大する中、農家への大きな支援となる見込み。
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザワクチンの開発・発表が主題であり、現時点で新規の重大な人への感染や国際的拡大の情報はないが、ケララ州など複数州で家禽への感染拡大が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にインド国産H5N1家禽用ワクチンの発表に関する内容。ケララ州など複数州で鳥インフルエンザが継続的に発生している点、2006年以降500件超の発生、2021年に約100万羽、今年約20万羽の鶏が死亡したとの既往データが記載されているが、現時点での新規ヒト感染報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨刷新认知！不灭蚊也能防登革热，控蚊有新路子了！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Rethink Your Understanding: Even if mosquitoes can't be eliminated, dengue fever can be prevented—new ways to control mosquitoes!
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and Zika, transmitted by mosquitoes, affect nearly 400 million people annually worldwide. Shenzhen-based researchers propose two green, non-lethal strategies to curb transmission in Asia-Pacific. First, introduce a natural gut bacterium, GD01, into wild mosquitoes; field deployment in Shenzhen’s Guangming District parks and residential areas since June 2026 shows over 80% gut colonization, aiming to block viruses inside mosquitoes and prevent spread. Plans include testing in Malaysia and Indonesia. Second, disable the mosquitoes’ ability to locate humans by targeting the odor-sensing pocket in their olfactory system, potentially using cryo-EM insights to develop blocking agents; this approach is still at the basic-research stage. The goal is environmental-ecological intervention toward a “green, long-acting” solution and a disease-transmission icepoint region, aligning with APAC dengue control Roadmap.

triage.headline_ja: 動画｜認識を刷新！蚊を根絶しなくてもデング熱予防は可能、蚊対策に新たな道が
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、深圳の研究機関によるデング熱・ジカウイルス媒介蚊対策技術（共生細菌・嗅覚阻害）に関する研究紹介記事であるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症対策の研究技術（腸内細菌GD01導入、嗅覚受容体阻害）を紹介するものであり、特定国での感染症流行・アウトブレイク事例ではない。マレーシア・インドネシアでの試験は将来計画であり現時点の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் எதிரொலி: தீவிர கண்காணிப்பில் கடலூர்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza aftermath: Cuddalore under intense surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) aftermath in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with about 80,000 birds dead and crows among casualties. A three-member central team, led by the National Institute of Disease Control Programme director Nidhi Saini, infectious disease expert Vinita Gupta, and a pulmonary physician from JIPMER, arrived to assess containment measures as of 21 November 2026. The delegation visited two poultry farms in Kattiyanguppam to screen for symptoms, queried whether cold-like tests were performed during prior COVID testing, and inspected the burial site of dead birds with photographs. This effort is part of ongoing surveillance initiated after India’s 2006 avian influenza outbreak. The team then went to Kulananjavadi Primary Health Centre to gather data on precautionary actions and patient lists, before surveying nearby poultry operations and moving on to Vadalur for further inspection.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの余波：カダルール県で厳重な監視体制
triage.triage_reason: 約8万羽の鳥が死亡し中央医療チームが派遣されるなど政府の関心は高いが、人への感染報告は記事中に見られず、現時点では動物衛生事案に留まるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽・野鳥(カラス含む)の大量死(約8万羽)に関する動物衛生事案で、中央政府の専門家チームが現地調査を実施。COVID検査との比較言及はあるが人への感染例は記載なし。人獣共通感染への進展有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Geography, violence, distrust hitting DR Congo Ebola fight:...
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is battling its deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, centered in Ituri with spread to eight provinces and more than 5,500 deaths to date. Ebola spreads by contact with infected bodily fluids. About 500 new cases per week are being reported. The outbreak, the 17th in the country and declared six months ago, involves the Bundibugyo species; the WHO is trialling two vaccines, but delivery to front lines will take weeks. Vaccines must be kept in a cold chain and transported through rugged, flooded terrain; convoys can take two to four weeks, with crevasses, bogs and collapsed bridges complicating access. Insecurity compounds response: 80 security incidents targeting healthcare workers have caused deaths; the Allied Democratic Forces have killed at least 110 civilians since November. Distrust and conspiracy theories impede communities; aid workers stress safe, dignified funerals while avoiding armed escorts.

triage.headline_ja: 地理、暴力、不信感がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策を阻害：ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,500人以上死亡、8州に拡大、週500例の新規症例）が継続しており、治安悪化・不信感によりワクチン配布や対応が著しく阻害されている深刻な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（第17次アウトブレイク、Bundibugyo種）。治安悪化（ADFによる民間人殺害、医療従事者への攻撃80件）と地理的障壁がワクチン配布・対応を著しく困難にしている。8州への拡大は国内での地理的拡大であり、国境を越えた国際拡大の明示的記述はないが、規模と継続期間からフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 é encontrada em 58% das amostras no Rio e entra no radar da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant is found in 58% of samples in Rio and enters the WHO's radar.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 lineage derived from Omicron, is circulating in Brazil and is being monitored by the WHO as a Variant Under Surveillance. In Rio de Janeiro, it was detected in 96 of 167 genomes (58%) from samples collected Oct 17–Nov 6, 2026, in a study by IOC/Fiocruz with the Municipal Health Secretariat. Brazil also traced RF.5 (22%) and XFG (11%) in the same set; PJ.2.1 was first identified in Canada in May 2026. Across Brazil, PJ.2.1 has been reported in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, the Federal District, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. A German study associates higher ACE2 receptor binding with PJ.2.1 and notes moderate/low immune escape, not solely explaining Rio’s predominance. InfoGripe shows rising Covid-19–related SRAG in early November (MG, SP, RJ, PR, DF; Bahia), with 11.5% of hospitalizations and 26.9% of SRAG deaths in the prior four weeks. Vaccination and boosters remain key public-health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株、リオの検体の58%から検出されWHOの監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: WHO監視対象となった新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル国内で急速に拡大し、SRAG入院・死亡率上昇も報告されており、WPRO基準で複数該当かつ社会的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: PJ.2.1はカナダで最初に確認されたが、現在主にブラジルで急速に拡大し監視されている。ドイツの研究はACE2結合性の違いを示唆するが免疫逃避は中等度/低度とされる。重症化・死亡率データ（SRAG関連）は一定の懸念材料だが、既存のCOVID-19対応の枠内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Les scientifiques en apprennent davantage sur le virus Ebola lors de l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists are learning more about the Ebola virus during the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 11,000 cases and over 5,500 deaths reported to date. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, and diagnostic challenges hinder containment as tests designed for other Ebola strains may fail to detect it. Bleeding is less common (5–10% of confirmed cases) than in past outbreaks. Symptoms overlap with malaria and other illnesses, delaying detection. Children are disproportionately affected: among Congolese Health Ministry/WHO data, 1,207 confirmed cases in children under 5 with 844 deaths (about 70%). Adult mortality is around 50%, higher than previous Bundibugro outbreaks but lower than Zaire strain outbreaks. Transmission appears twice as fast as the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Around 700 survivors have participated in follow-up studies and support programs. Research aims to improve understanding of transmission, clinical features, and long-term outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがDRCのエボラ流行から新たな知見を得る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,000例超・死者5,500人超と深刻で、ワクチン・治療法未承認、診断困難、伝播速度も過去の流行を上回っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの言及はないため除外。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: ठंड बढ़ते ही बच्चों पर मौसमी इंफेक्शन का हमला, निमोनिया का भी खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the cold sets in, seasonal infections strike children, with pneumonia also posing a risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, the pediatric department at Ranchi's Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) reports a surge in seasonal respiratory infections among infants and young children as temperatures drop. About 20–25 children visit daily with respiratory infections and other seasonal illnesses, up from 15–20 last year. Infants aged 3–7 months are presenting upper respiratory infections with wheezing, breathing difficulty, high fever, and sometimes red eyes and diarrhea. In 2–5-year-olds, ear pain and ear discharge are increasingly reported. Infections can spread to lower airways, raising pneumonia risk, with breathing trouble, wheeze and high fever as key signs. Sudden temperature changes and cold exposure are identified as risk factors. Parents are advised to monitor symptoms closely and seek medical advice; limit exposure to infected individuals and maintain hygiene.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Keeps Bundibugyo Ebola a Global Emergency -- CASRAI
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a public health emergency of international concern, per WHO after the 17 November 2026 Emergency Committee meeting. As of 17 November, 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality 48.9%) across 68 health zones in eight provinces, with 48 zones reporting new cases in the prior 21 days. Since 6 November, 945 new cases and 480 deaths have been reported. Transmission remains high, though some areas show declines; Sud-Kivu and Sud Ubangi have had no cases for over 42 days. Outside DRC, Kenya has nine confirmed cases (two deaths) linked to one imported case; Nigeria reports one imported case evacuated to Switzerland. France and Uganda outbreaks have been controlled since August. No approved vaccines or specific treatments exist; two candidate Bundibugyo vaccines will be added to ongoing trials, alongside Ervebo for Zaire strain. WHO risk: very high in DRC, high in Kenya and Nigeria; no travel restrictions advised.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはブンディブギョ・エボラをPHEICとして継続維持 -- CASRAI
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として維持している大規模エボラ流行であり、複数国への越境伝播も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・ウガンダ・スイスへの波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生地域であり継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por una nueva variante del Covid en Argentina: qué se sabe de la cepa que ya hace crecer los casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about a new COVID variant in Argentina: what is known about the strain that is already driving up cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, a new Omicron sublineage PJ.2.1 of COVID-19 began circulating in Argentina amid respiratory infections. The Public Health Laboratory at the National University of La Plata identified PJ.2.1 by genomic analysis in three hospitalized patients in Buenos Aires Province and Buenos Aires City: two infants aged 1 and 2 months, and a 58-year-old adult. PJ.2.1 descends from JN.1 and carries 25 mutations; its circulation has also been detected in the United States, Canada and Brazil. WHO is monitoring; some mutations may increase transmissibility, but data are insufficient to determine greater severity. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, congestion, and nasal discharge; pediatric cases are mild, though adults may be more severe. A rise in Formosa prompted renewed testing and masking for health workers; vaccination remains emphasized, especially during pregnancy, in older adults, and high-risk groups, with pregnant coverage below 10%. WHO continues to assess vaccine protection.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's first indigenous avian influenza vaccine launch, developed by scientists in Bhopal.
article.articleSummary: India launches its first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine, developed by scientists at the National Institute of High-Security Animals Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal (Anand Nagar). The vaccine, targeting clade 2.3.2.1a, is expected to protect chickens for about six months and is priced at 1–2 rupees per dose. Development began September 2025 and was completed August 2026, under NIHSAD Director Dr. Aniket Sanyal and Dr. S. Nagarajan; a BSL-4 facility costing around 300 crore rupees will be built. In trials, a vaccinated bird exposed to H5N1 did not transmit infection to a contact bird. Launched Friday by Union Agriculture Minister Shivaraj Singh Chouhan, the vaccine could benefit layers and breeding birds, addressing losses across India's roughly 851.8 million poultry population and an annual demand of 80–100 crore doses. ICAR DG calls it a One Health milestone.

article.articleHeadline: Científicos investigan la cepa Bundibugyo para frenar el brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists investigate the Bundibugyo strain to stem the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 11,000 confirmed infections and about 5,500 deaths. Scientists note its transmission is nearly twice as fast as the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak, but there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Diagnosis is hampered by non-specific symptoms and overlap with malaria; Bundibugyo-specific tests may miss cases. Bleeding is less common in this strain, occurring in roughly 5–10% of confirmed cases. About 70% of fatalities occur in patients' communities rather than in health facilities, complicating contact tracing. Children are disproportionately affected: 1,207 cases in children under five with 844 deaths (near 70% mortality) versus about 50% in adults. Around 700 survivors participate in studies; ongoing outbreaks intersect with conflict and displacement in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがコンゴのエボラ流行を食い止めるためブンディブギョ株を調査

article.articleHeadline: Clinical Klebsiella Pneumoniae Strain Combines Novel Resistance Genes on
article.articleSummary: CRKP140164, a carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolate, carries blaCTX-M-167 and the tet(A)-v tigecycline resistance determinant on a transferable fusion plasmid (IncFII(K)-IncQ1) with close homology to plasmids in Klebsiella and Shigella. Recovered from urine of a 30-year-old female with acute B-lymphoblastic leukemia in Hangzhou, China, during post-bilateral lung transplantation care in June 2025. The strain is ST15, a high-risk lineage linked to extended ICU stays and invasive procedures; colonization occurred amid prolonged antimicrobial therapy. CRKP was detected in urine mid-June; stool later yielded carbapenem-susceptible K. pneumoniae and ESBL-producing E. coli; blood cultures remained negative; discharge July 22, 2025, with outpatient stool colonization by susceptible K. pneumoniae on July 27. MICs showed high-level resistance to imipenem (4 μg/mL), meropenem (16 μg/mL), ertapenem (>128 μg/mL), and multiple β-lactams and fluoroquinolones; susceptible to polymyxin B, amikacin, and ceftazidime-avibactam; tigecycline MIC 1 μg/mL. Highlights risk of convergent beta-lactam and tetracycline resistance on conjugative plasmids in immunocompromised patients.

article.articleHeadline: Geography, violence, distrust hitting DR Congo Ebola fight: Handicap International
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in Ituri province about six months ago, is the deadliest in the country's history, with more than 5,500 deaths and spread across eight provinces. The weekly incidence is about 500 new cases. The World Health Organization is trialling two vaccines for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain behind the epidemic, but delivery to front lines will take weeks due to rugged terrain, crevasses, bogs in the rainy season, collapsed bridges, and unreliable electricity for cold-chain storage. Insecurity complicates response: 80 safety incidents targeting health workers since May, with deaths; the Allied Democratic Forces have killed at least 110 civilians in Ituri since November. Handicap International, with 130+ local staff, will not arm workers and relies on contacts to pass checkpoints, while distrust and conspiracy theories hinder safe protective practices and funeral rites.

triage.headline_ja: 地理的条件・暴力・不信感がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策を阻害：ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（死者5,500人超、8州に拡大、週500例の新規感染）のエボラ流行が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州における第17次エボラ流行を扱っており、安全保障上の問題（ADFによる民間人殺害、保健従事者への80件の襲撃）が対応を困難にしている。国際的な支援（WHOによるワクチン試験、Handicap Internationalの活動）が既に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: chá de mamão funciona? Confira 8 mitos e verdades sobre a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Does papaya tea work? Check out 8 myths and truths about the disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded over 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths in 2026, per ITpS. Dr. Vivian Lee debunks eight myths: 1) papaya leaf tea and yam juice do not cure dengue; treatment is hydration, rest, and medical follow-up. 2) Rapid tests are not fully reliable; a negative result does not rule out dengue. 3) Homemade repellents lack proven efficacy; use registered repellents with icaridine, DEET, or IR3535. 4) Avoid aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, and nimesulide; relief with dipyrone or paracetamol as advised. 5) Mosquitoes breed indoors as well as outside; check fridges, drains, and water containers. 6) Qdenga is quadrivalent (DENV-1 to DENV-4); two doses, 3 months apart; approved 4–60 years; SUS prioritizes 10–14-year-olds. 7) Aedes aegypti bites mainly by day. 8) Dengue serotypes differ; prior infection doesn’t guarantee protection against others; risk of severe disease with secondary infection. Warning signs: abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, dizziness, reduced urine, altered consciousness.

article.articleHeadline: Belém e Santarém concentram quase 60% das mortes por dengue no Pará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belém and Santarém account for nearly 60% of dengue deaths in Pará.
article.articleSummary: Pará reports 8,749 confirmed dengue cases through October 2026, with 17 deaths in the period. Belém and Santarém accounted for 10 deaths and 2,462 cases; Santarém had 1,101 cases, Belém 1,361. Castanhal, Conceição do Araguaia, and Mãe do Rio show high incidence (683, 364, 349) with no deaths. About 11,100 probable dengue cases in 2026 in Pará, down 43.6% from 2024; Brazil had 485,400 probable cases by October 2026, down 92.5% from the previous year. Federal actions include expanding larvicide dissemination stations, training around 100 Belém professionals (Nov 5), and donating 86 BRI-Aedes devices. Belém launched a citywide campaign (Nov 12–29) with 80 agents; dengue vaccination for ages 10–14 continues nationwide (17.6 million doses distributed since 2024; 10.9 million administered).

triage.headline_ja: ベレンとサンタレンでパラ州のデング熱死亡者の約60％を占める
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地域流行性の感染症であり、2026年の症例数は前年比43.6%減と減少傾向にある。政府による対策（殺虫剤散布、ワクチン接種、啓発キャンペーン）も既に実施されており、新規性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年発生するブラジルの地域流行性疾患であり、2026年は前年より症例数・死亡数ともに減少傾向。地方政府による対策（殺虫剤散布、ワクチン接種、キャンペーン）も進行中であり、特段の国際的懸念や異常事態は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Vijf uitbraken van vogelgriep in zeer korte tijd: komt het verplichte vaccin er bijna aan?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five outbreaks of avian influenza in a very short time: is the mandatory vaccine almost here?
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Gelderland records five outbreaks of avian influenza on three poultry farms in Hierden, Oosterwolde and Ermelo, prompting the culling of 169,500 birds over nine days. Dutch State Secretary for Agriculture Silvio Erkens is pushing to make vaccination mandatory, supplementing ongoing ophokplicht (confined housing) measures. Two vaccines have been approved and field trials completed; a third pilot runs until 2027. Vaccination is not yet mandatory, and authorities warn it will not completely prevent infections but should reduce transmission. A formal plan to start vaccination is to be sent to the Tweede Kamer by year-end, with extensive industry consultation. Trade concerns with non-EU partners (UK, United States, Japan, Mexico, China) over vaccine acceptability may delay rollout, though the government aims to proceed swiftly if barriers are resolved.

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện 2 ổ dịch cúm A, quai bị trong trường học ở Quảng Ninh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two outbreaks of influenza A and mumps detected in a school in Quang Ninh Province
article.articleSummary: Two infectious disease outbreaks were identified in Hai Ninh commune, Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam, as of November 21, 2026. Ly Thuong Kiet High School reported 50 influenza A cases; Hai Tien Primary and Secondary School reported 19 mumps cases. Local health authorities, in collaboration with the schools, implemented containment and environmental cleaning, spraying Cloramin B on November 17–18 across classrooms, common areas, and school grounds over more than 20,000 square meters. Preventive measures include improved hygiene, well-ventilated classrooms, and handwashing promotion. Symptoms to monitor: influenza A—fever, cough, sore throat; mumps—parotid gland swelling/tenderness. Families should inform schools and seek medical care for suspected cases. Health authorities will monitor the situation for a week to assess intervention effectiveness and adjust measures to prevent further spread.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue no Brasil em 2026, diagnóstico, vacina e manejo | Newslab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Brazil in 2026, diagnosis, vaccine, and management | Newslab.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s 2026 dengue outlook centers on summer readiness and the National Day to Combat Dengue (Nov 21). By Sept 26, about 470,500 probable cases were reported, with many municipalities at alert or risk for Aedes aegypti. OPAS data as of Nov 13 show ~1.91 million suspected dengue cases and 655 deaths in the Americas, with Brazil circulating DENV‑1 to DENV‑4; secondary infection with a different serotype raises the risk of severe dengue. Diagnosis depends on days since symptoms: NS1 antigen or RT‑PCR up to day 5; IgM ELISA from day 6; negative NS1/RT‑PCR does not rule out dengue due to timing and Zika cross‑reactivity. Management remains supportive, with hydration and avoidance of NSAIDs, plus re‑evaluation after defervescence for warning signs. Vaccines: Qdenga (Takeda) for ages 10–14 nationwide (two doses, 3 months); Butantan‑DV (12–59) with a safety pause. Phase 2 monoclonal antibody reduced viremia and fever in India; Phase 3 Nature Medicine reports 65% efficacy against symptomatic dengue and 80.5% for dengue with warning signs or severe; data for DENV‑3/4 limited due to low circulation. Vector control stresses removing standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ブラジルにおけるデング熱：診断・ワクチン・管理
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける季節性デング熱の年次状況まとめであり、診断・治療・ワクチンに関する解説記事。新規性・異常性はなく、既知の毎年の流行パターンの範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Is Your Body Ready For Winter? Common Infections Adults Over 50 Should Know About
article.articleSummary: Winter increases exposure to infections such as influenza and other respiratory illnesses. In adults over 50, immunosenescence heightens susceptibility to infections like influenza and pneumococcal pneumonia, with those over 50 nearly six times more likely to contract pneumococcal pneumonia than younger adults. Shingles (varicella zoster) also warrants attention in this age group, as it can cause severe pain and long-term complications such as postherpetic neuralgia beyond a rash. In India, Streptococcus pneumoniae is among the leading causes of community-acquired pneumonia. Preventive health for adults over 50 should combine lifestyle measures (diet, exercise, hand hygiene, avoiding smoking), management of chronic conditions, and vaccination. Seek medical advice for preventive vaccination and personalized risk reduction. The piece emphasizes that protection is not only about treatment after illness but reducing risk through proactive measures during winter.

triage.headline_ja: あなたの体は冬に備えられていますか？50歳以上の成人が知っておくべき一般的な感染症
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、50歳以上向けの一般的な冬季感染症予防に関する健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in TN's Cuddalore district; Central team inspects affected poultry farms - english.punjabkesari.com
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district after mass bird deaths on farms in Nochikadu, Thammanampettai, Thimmaravuthankuppam, Kullanchavadi and Kurinjipadi during Deepavali. Samples from deceased broilers sent to laboratories in Namakkal and Chennai; laboratory confirmation prompted containment. Dead chickens buried in pits; remaining birds culled; authorities imposed a three‑month ban on poultry farming and restrictions on purchasing/rearing new birds in affected areas. A central medical team inspected affected farms and the Kadiyakuppam medical camp; the National Centre for Disease Control provided technical guidance on surveillance and preventing human transmission. Residents were advised to avoid burial sites and seek care for cough, cold, or respiratory symptoms. Health authorities maintain continuous surveillance in affected villages to curb spread and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州クダロール県で鳥インフルエンザ発生、中央政府チームが被害養鶏場を視察
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での大量死・殺処分と3か月間の養鶏禁止措置が取られ、国立疾病管理センター(NCDC)がヒト感染防止の技術指導を行うなど政府の関与が高く、WPRO基準にも複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु के कुड्डालोर जिले में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप, केंद्रीय टीम ने किया निरीक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district, the central team conducted an inspection.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, confirmed an avian influenza outbreak in broiler poultry across Nochikadu, Thammanampettai, Thimmarvuthankuppam, Kulanchaavadi, Kurinjipadi and surrounding areas. A large number of broiler chickens died, prompting farm closures and three-month bans on poultry farming and restrictions on buying new birds. Dead-bird samples were sent to Namakkal and Chennai laboratories, with laboratory confirmation of avian influenza. Infected carcasses were buried in pits, and remaining birds on affected farms were culled to prevent spread. A central medical team visited medical camps at Kadiyakuppam and assessed preparedness, while the National Centre for Disease Control provided technical guidance to prevent human transmission. Authorities urged residents not to visit burial sites and to seek medical care if coughing, cold symptoms, or breathing difficulties occur. Ongoing surveillance and precautionary measures will continue.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州クッダロール県で鳥インフルエンザ発生、中央チームが視察
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ大規模感染による大量死・殺処分・家禽取引禁止措置が取られ、中央医療チームおよびNCDCが人への感染防止のため介入しており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒトへの感染は確認されていないが、NCDCが技術的ガイダンスを提供し、呼吸器症状がある住民に医療機関受診を呼びかけるなど、ヒトへの感染拡大防止策が取られている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: One invisible toll of war is worsening drug-resistant TB crisis
article.articleSummary: War and humanitarian emergencies fuel the burden of drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) by destroying health services and driving displacement. In 2024, nearly 300 million people needed humanitarian aid, with 83.4 million internally displaced (73.5 million from conflict/violence). Prolonged conflicts in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Lebanon, Palestine, Sudan, Ukraine, and ongoing crises in Afghanistan, Colombia, Syria and Yemen create poverty, malnutrition, overcrowding and disrupted diagnosis and treatment, increasing TB transmission and the emergence of drug resistance. A 2026 BMJ Global Health scoping review co-authored by Dr Ignacio Monedero Recuero found fewer than 20% of estimated DR-TB cases are notified in complex emergencies, leaving many undiagnosed. Globally, only 38% of estimated DR-TB cases were notified and treated in 2025 per the WHO Global TB Report 2026. The urgency: identify all DR-TB cases and link them to treatment and support; war-affected settings must be prioritized in the TB response, a theme at the Stop TB Partnership session during the 55th Union World Conference in Rio de Janeiro.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争による「見えない代償」の一つ、薬剤耐性結核危機の悪化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国における急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、紛争地域における薬剤耐性結核の過小診断・過小報告という構造的・慢性的課題を論じる啓発的記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は紛争地域（DRC、レバノン、パレスチナ、スーダン、ウクライナ、アフガニスタン、コロンビア、シリア、イエメン）全般における薬剤耐性結核の構造的問題を扱う国際会議（Rio de Janeiro開催のUnion World Conference）関連の論説記事。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが具体的に言及されている。Rio de Janeiroは会議開催地であり疾病発生地ではないため除外。特定の急性アウトブレイクイベントではなく、継続的な政策課題に関する記事のためDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana registra casos em 27 cidades de MS e mobiliza acompanhamento do Ministério da Saúde - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies cases reported in 27 municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul, prompting monitoring by the Ministry of Health - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã/MS and Pedro Juan Caballero, Paraguay.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul reported human scabies in 27 municipalities, with the Ministry of Health providing technical support. Highest counts: Nova Andradina ≥70; Dourados 74; Rio Brilhante 39; Itaporã 34; Amambai 18; Fátima do Sul 9; Santa Rita do Pardo 6; Deodápolis 5; Ponta Porã 2 (one case under investigation); Deodápolis also has a case under investigation. Campo Grande confirmed a case at Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil Jasmim Ibrahim Bacha in Nova Lima; the school was cleaned on 18 November and resumed on 19 November, while three additional suspected cases are being investigated. The Ministry notes scabies is not a public health emergency in Brazil but requires preventive measures, including treating close contacts, washing shared items in hot water, and avoiding sharing personal items. Transmission is mainly via prolonged skin-to-skin contact; investigations are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州27市町村で人間疥癬の症例が報告され、保健省が追跡調査に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は保健省自身が公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないと明言しており、重症度・国際拡大リスクも低いため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）は接触感染する皮膚疾患で、保健省も公衆衛生緊急事態ではないと明言。地域内の学校・コミュニティでの拡大はあるが重篤性・国際的懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Cases And Deaths Fall 80% In India Over 10 Years, But Climate Change Could Reverse Gains
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India declined nearly 80% in cases and deaths from 2015 to 2025, aided by improved diagnosis, treatment, vector-control campaigns, and public awareness. The burden shift is evident as districts with high malaria reduced from 155 to 33; between 2022 and 2025, as many as 160 districts reported no locally transmitted malaria. India targets malaria elimination by 2030, but climate change—rising temperatures, altered rainfall, and rapid urbanisation—could create favorable mosquito breeding conditions and threaten gains. Insecticide resistance may further hamper control efforts. Ongoing emphasis on early diagnosis, appropriate treatment, mosquito-control, surveillance, and community participation remains essential. Preventive actions include avoiding stagnant water, covering water containers, sleeping under mosquito nets, and seeking timely medical testing for fever rather than self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおけるマラリア症例・死亡数、過去10年で80%減少 ― しかし気候変動が成果を覆す恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドにおけるマラリア減少の成功事例と将来的な気候変動リスクに関する一般的な報告であり、現時点で異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の実績データと将来予測に基づく分析記事であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 菲律宾霍乱病例两周增加69% 卫生部吁保障饮水和食品安全
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera cases in the Philippines rise 69% in two weeks; Health Department urges safeguarding of drinking water and food safety.
article.articleSummary: Cholera cases in the Philippines rose 69% in two weeks; from Oct 11–24, 27 cases, up from 16, with as of Nov 7 cumulative 551 cases and a case fatality rate of 2.18%. Two regions are under heightened monitoring for cholera. Typhoid fever reached 1,141 cases (up 4% from the prior two weeks), totaling 16,432 cases by Nov 7, CFR 0.30%. Ten regions, 15 provinces and highly urbanized cities are monitored due to sustained increases in typhoid. Acute hemorrhagic diarrhea this year Jan 4–Nov 7 totals 8,601 cases (down 25% YoY). Influenza-like illness: 150,187 cases (down 15%). Dengue: 254,090 cases (down 9%). El Niño could affect safe drinking water and mosquito breeding. Public guidance urges safe water, thorough cooking of food, hygiene; seek care for persistent fever, severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, bloody stools, or marked fatigue; eliminate standing water to reduce dengue risk.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンでコレラ症例が2週間で69%増加、保健省が飲料水と食品の安全確保を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コレラとチフスの症例数が複数地域で継続的に増加し、致死率も確認されているため、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: コレラ(551例、CFR2.18%)とチフス(16,432例、CFR0.30%)が複数地域で監視対象。エルニーニョによる水衛生悪化が今後のリスク要因として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु के कुड्डालोर जिले में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप, केंद्रीय टीम ने किया निरीक्षण | Bird flu outbreak in TN?s Cuddalore district; Central team inspects affected poultry farms
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district; Central team conducted an inspection.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district, with mass deaths of broiler chickens in Nochikadu, Thammanampettai, Thimmanavuthankuppam, Kulanachavadi, Kurinjipadi and nearby areas around Diwali. Following widespread poultry deaths, affected farms culled and dead birds buried in pits to prevent spread. A three-month ban on poultry farming and restrictions on purchasing/raising new poultry were imposed locally. Samples from dead birds were sent to Namakkal and Chennai laboratories; lab confirmation of avian influenza was reported. A central medical team inspected affected farms and a Kadiyakuppam medical camp; the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) provided technical guidance to curb human transmission. Public advised to avoid areas where infected birds were buried; anyone with cough, cold, or other respiratory symptoms should seek medical care. Ongoing surveillance and preventive measures continue in the area.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州クッダロール県で鳥インフルエンザが発生、中央政府チームが視察
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での大量死を伴う鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクが確認され、中央政府（NCDC）が技術支援に乗り出すなど、動物衛生・公衆衛生両面での懸念があるためフルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 人への感染例の報告は記事中に明示されていないが、呼吸器症状がある場合の受診勧告やNCDCの関与から、ヒトへの感染拡大リスクへの警戒が示唆される。続報でヒト感染確認の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Cariacica registra queda de 75,6% nos casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cariacica records a 75.6% drop in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Cariacica recorded 2,146 dengue cases from January to mid-November 2026, down from 8,792 in the same period in 2025—a 75.6% decline, per the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semus) released on National Dengue Fight Day (Dia Nacional de Combate à Dengue) on 21 November. October 2026 saw 199 cases, down from 595 in 2025; November totals reach 73 so far. High-incidence neighborhoods receive targeted interventions by endemic disease agents, mass cleanups, and resident guidance, with fumacê (daily fogging) deployed as a supplementary vector control for Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. The city also offers vaccination and other preventive services during Super Dia D da Saúde at basic health units. Preventive advice emphasizes weekly checks for standing water, covering water tanks and reservoirs, keeping tires under cover, inverting empty bottles, cleaning gutters and roofs, and placing sand in plant saucers.

triage.headline_ja: カリアシカ、デング熱症例が75.6%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で大幅に減少しており、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。通常の予防活動の報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 症例数の減少を伝える平常時の保健当局発表であり、流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais registra 12,2 mil casos de Covid-19 em 2026, com maior concentração entre crianças e idosos - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records 12,200 cases of COVID-19 in 2026, with the highest concentration among children and the elderly - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, recorded 12,299 COVID-19 diagnoses from January through November 19, 2026. Highest concentrations are among children 1–9 years and adults over 80, per SES-MG's COVID-19 influenza-like illness panel. Despite rising notifications in parts of the Belo Horizonte metro area, cumulative cases remain below 2025 levels (about 38,500). Officials warn transmission could intensify with the respiratory season and El Niño, though current data show more mild to moderate cases and no rise in hospitalizations or deaths. Deaths remain concentrated among the elderly with comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic kidney disease, chronic pulmonary disease). Vaccination remains central; vulnerable groups should stay up to date. MG received ~300,000 vaccine doses on Nov 16, with ~290,000 more planned; over 768,000 doses administered Jan-Sep 2026. For ages 6 months–5 years: three doses; pregnant women once; >60 and immunocompromised every six months; annual boosters for Indigenous, quilombola, and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、2026年のCOVID-19症例が12,200件を記録、子どもと高齢者に集中
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性COVID-19報告であり、症例数は前年を下回り、入院・死亡の増加も見られないため、シグナルとしての異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体の定例的な疫学報告記事。軽症～中等症が中心で、死亡者数増加や医療逼迫の兆候はない。ワクチン接種体制も通常通り機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Perfil atribuído a presos relata casos de Covid-19, falta de água e superlotação no Ceresp Gameleira - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inmate profile reports cases of COVID-19, water shortages and overcrowding at Ceresp Gameleira - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak suspected at Ceresp Gameleira, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, after a 23-year-old detainee died and a social-media post attributed to inmates alleged a SARS-CoV-2 outbreak, water shortages and overcrowding. Isolation was ordered on 19 November 2026; entrances/exits suspended and male detainees redirected to Complexo Penitenciário Nelson Hungria in Contagem. Authorities planned testing for inmates in the same gallery as the deceased to detect respiratory infections. Ceresp Gameleira serves as the entry point for male detainees in the Belo Horizonte region and has a history of overcrowding; in March 2026, 1,690 inmates were held, more than double the 789-capacity. The authenticity of the social-media post could not be independently verified, and Sejusp-MG had not issued a formal response at the time of reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 受刑者とされる人物のプロフィールがCOVID-19症例、水不足、過密状態を報告 ― セレスピ・ガメレイラ（BH24Horas）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の刑務所施設内でCOVID-19集団発生が疑われているが、情報源はSNS投稿で真正性未確認、当局の正式な発表もまだなく、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響は現時点で確認できない。
triage.notes: SNS投稿の真正性が未確認であり、州保健・司法当局（Sejusp-MG）からの正式な発表も記事執筆時点でない。刑務所の過密状態（定員789人に対し最大1,690人収容歴あり）が感染拡大リスクを高める可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु के कुड्डालोर जिले में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप, केंद्रीय टीम ने किया निरीक्षण - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreak in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu; Central team conducted an inspection
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with a large number of broiler chickens dying in Nochikadu, Thammanampettai, Thimmarvuthankuppam, Kullanchavadi, Kurinjipadi and nearby areas after Diwali. Following deaths, poultry department conducted field visits; samples from the affected farms were sent to Namakkal and Chennai laboratories and were confirmed positive for avian influenza. To prevent spread, dead birds were buried in designated pits and remaining birds on affected farms were culled. A three-month ban on poultry farming in the affected areas, and prohibitions on purchasing or rearing new poultry, have been imposed. A central medical team visited a field camp at Kadiyakuppam and reviewed containment measures; the National Centre for Disease Control provided technical guidance to prevent transmission to humans. Local residents advised to avoid burial sites and seek medical care for cough, fever, or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州クッダロール県で鳥インフルエンザ発生、中央チームが現地調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ確認と防疫措置（殺処分・飼養禁止）が報告されているが、ヒト感染の確認はなく、国際的拡大リスクも低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ確認事例。中央保健当局（NCDC）がヒトへの感染防止のため技術指導を行っているが、現時点でヒト感染例の報告はない。地域的な家禽飼育禁止措置（3か月間）と殺処分が実施されており、国内の家禽産業への影響が主な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Serra abre laboratório para testagem de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serra opens a laboratory for COVID-19 testing.
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, November 21, 2026, the Serra Municipal Laboratory in the Boa Vista neighborhood will operate from 8:00 to 16:00 to perform COVID-19 RT-PCR testing. The service aims to expand diagnostic access amid a recent uptick in suspected COVID-19 cases and is exclusive to Serra residents who must present photo ID proving residency. Samples will be collected to identify the presence of the virus causing COVID-19. The Serra Health Department urges residents with respiratory symptoms to wear masks, wash hands frequently, and maintain distance from others, especially the elderly and high-risk individuals. Details: Date/time: Saturday, 21 November, 8:00–16:00; Location: Laboratório Central da Serra, Rua Anastácio Cassaro, 62, Boa Vista II; Eligibility: Serra residents with photo ID.

triage.headline_ja: セーハ市、COVID-19検査のための検査室を開設
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の疑い症例増加を受けた通常の検査体制拡充の案内であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域はRoraima州Boa Vistaとなっているが、記事内の『Boa Vista II』はセーハ市（エスピリトサント州）内の地区名であり、ロライマ州とは無関係と推測される。国としてはBrazilのみ確定的。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Compartments in Chickens Direct Distinct Pathways of H9N2 Avian
article.articleSummary: H9N2 avian influenza viruses circulating in domestic poultry show tissue-specific evolution in chickens: upper respiratory tract selects mutations increasing human-type α2,6 sialic acid receptor affinity, while lower respiratory tissues favor substitutions enabling antibody escape. Since 2010, two lineages dominate: B (77% of HA sequences in Asia) and G (15% across Africa and the Middle East), with ~15–20% divergence from ancestral strains. The HA bears 71 diversity hotspots, eight hypervariable sites (e.g., 160, 190), and historical isolates shifted from dual receptor usage before 2002 to human-like binding after 2005. A G57-lineage HA from A/chicken/Beijing/16/2013 was used to build a 20,496-mutant library (8,935 substitutions). In MDCK cells and eggs it replicated; in BALB/c mice it caused respiratory-limited infection with full survival. In chickens with naive, heterologous-vaccinated, homologous-vaccinated, or convalescent immunity, naive shed most; convalescents the least; homologous vaccination and prior infection blocked transmission, while heterologous reduced shedding but did not fully stop transmission. Sequencing showed bottlenecks and that pre-existing immunity constrains diversity.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏の呼吸器区画がH9N2鳥インフルエンザの異なる進化経路を方向付ける
triage.triage_reason: H9N2低病原性鳥インフルエンザの進化メカニズムに関する基礎研究であり、現在の流行事例ではなく実験室研究が主体。ただしヒト型α2,6シアル酸受容体親和性の増加傾向は長期的な監視価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2013年の北京分離株を用いた実験室研究のため、現在の実フィールド流行ではない。ただしH9N2がヒト感染型の受容体親和性を進化させている傾向は、長期的な公衆衛生上の潜在的リスクとして注視する価値がある。アフリカはBluedot APIの誤検出の可能性が高い。
