article.articleHeadline: बर्ड फ्लूवरील स्वदेशी लस बाजारात ! लसीची किंमत ऐकून व्हाल थक्क , अवघ्या...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indigenous bird flu vaccine hits the market! You'll be shocked to hear the price of the vaccine, as low as ....
article.articleSummary: India launches its first domestically produced H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry, priced at 1–2 rupees per dose, to shield farms from outbreaks and reduce losses. Central Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicated the vaccine in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The vaccine aims to benefit both large poultry enterprises and smaller producers by lowering control costs. Bird flu outbreaks have caused substantial poultry deaths: about 1 million in 2006, around 900,000 in 2021, and about 200,000 this year. H5N1 spreads via infected birds, their droppings and secretions, contaminated feed, water and equipment. Symptoms include lethargy, breathing difficulty, and reduced feed/water intake, with sudden death in severe cases. Farmers should isolate sick birds, avoid handling them, notify veterinary authorities, and restrict movement of birds, eggs, feed and equipment. A 300 crore modern laboratory in Bhopal will assist diagnosis and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの国産ワクチンが市場に登場！価格を聞いて驚くはず、わずか…
triage.triage_reason: 家禽向けH5N1ワクチンの発売に関する内容であり、ヒトへの感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態は報告されていないため、トリアージ対象としての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽産業向けの鳥インフルエンザワクチン発売というポジティブな政策ニュースであり、ヒト感染や新規アウトブレイクの報告はない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみで、公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Nova variante é mais contagiosa, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: A new variant is more contagious, Fiocruz says
article.articleSummary: COVID-19: a new SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 is spreading in Brazil and is classified by the World Health Organization as under monitoring. It arrived in late August 2026 and is circulating across multiple states, with Rio de Janeiro showing predominance per Fiocruz’s Laboratory of Respiratory Viruses at the Oswaldo Cruz Institute. Confirmed cases are also in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. The lineage carries mutations that increase binding affinity to cellular receptors, making the virus more transmissible, though not more dangerous than other circulating variants. Vaccines currently in use are believed to provide protection against this variant. People in vaccine-priority groups—including young children, older adults, pregnant individuals, and the immunocompromised—are encouraged to receive vaccination at local sites. Information from TV Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：新変異株はより感染力が強いとフィオクルスが指摘
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象とする新系統PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州で拡大しているが、重症度は他の変異株と同等でワクチンも有効とされており、現時点で緊急性は低いため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 新変異株PJ.2.1はWHOの監視下にあり感染力は高いが重症度の上昇は確認されていない。ワクチンの有効性が維持されているとされるため、現時点ではフルリスク評価の緊急対象ではないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội 'siết' phòng, chống bệnh đậu mùa khỉ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi tightens monkeypox prevention and control measures
article.articleSummary: Hanoi tightens monkeypox prevention and control amid risk of importation via international travel. Hanoi CDC is coordinating with Noi Bai International Airport and related agencies to strengthen airport surveillance to promptly identify suspected cases, especially from countries with ongoing transmission. The agency also works with district health posts to monitor gynecology, dermatology, ARV, and methadone clinics for suspected cases and with the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases to obtain samples for confirmation. Public-information campaigns are intensified to raise awareness per Ministry of Health guidance, and health facilities are urged to ensure medicines, supplies, staff, and funding for prompt treatment. Citizens should self-isolate if symptoms appear and seek medical testing; travelers from affected areas should declare to health authorities. Transmission occurs animal-to-human and human-to-human via direct contact with lesions, body fluids, droplets, contaminated objects, mother-to-child, and sexual contact. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, fatigue, and vesicular rash; disease usually resolves in 2–3 weeks and is more severe in children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、サル痘（Mpox）の予防・対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な新規症例の確認や発生拡大の報告はなく、ハノイ当局による水際対策・予防体制強化に関する行政的な記事であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイ市当局が国際空港での監視強化や医療機関への啓発を行う予防的対応に関する内容であり、実際の新規確認症例についての記載はない。Mpoxは既知の疾患でWHOの関心も継続しているが、本記事単体では新規シグナルというよりは既存の警戒態勢強化の報道と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Virgínia registra 1º morte, e total nos EUA sobe para 12 neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Virginia reports first death, and the total in the U.S. rises to 12 this year.
article.articleSummary: Virginia reports first measles-related death, lifting the U.S. toll to 12 this year. Virginia has 220 cases as of November 19, mostly among unvaccinated individuals and concentrated in central Virginia; Pennsylvania records eight deaths, Wisconsin two, New York one. The outbreak coincides with the Pan American Health Organization declaring the United States no longer measles-elimination status after more than 12 months of transmission; CDC reports 5,838 infections in 2026, the highest in three decades. Measles typically presents with fever, rash, cough, coryza, and red eyes; complications can include encephalitis and pneumonia, with about 1 in 1,000 infections resulting in death. Vaccination remains highly effective: two MMR doses confer roughly 97% protection. Virginia’s 2025-2026 school-year vaccination coverage is 93.6%, below the 95% herd-immunity threshold. In Brazil, the MMR vaccine is two-dose (12 and 15 months), with occasional dose-zero recommendations for infants 6–11 months in select areas.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：バージニア州で初の死亡者、米国内の年間死者数は12人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外）に該当し、米国の麻疹排除ステータス喪失という国際的に注目度の高い事象であるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。ただし対象国リストには該当地域がない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は米国（バージニア州、ペンシルベニア州、ウィスコンシン州、ニューヨーク州）における麻疹アウトブレイクであり、ブラジルへの言及はワクチン接種スケジュールの参考情報に過ぎず、ブラジル国内での発生事例ではないため除外した。対象国リストに米国が含まれないため verified_locations は空となるが、PAHOによる排除ステータス喪失宣言など国際的な公衆衛生上の重要性からPICKUPと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman la llegada a la Argentina de PJ.2.1, una nueva variante más contagiosa del Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They confirm the arrival in Argentina of PJ.2.1, a new, more contagious variant of COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a highly transmissible Omicron sublineage of SARS-CoV-2, has been detected in Argentina. Three sequenced cases from Buenos Aires Province—two infants (1 and 2 months) and a 58-year-old adult—confirmed PJ.2.1 at the UNLP Public Health Laboratory. The lineage, derived from JN.1, is under WHO surveillance and has global spread with detections in Canada and the United States and recent confirmations in Brazil across Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espirito Santo, Federal District, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. Symptoms resemble a cold/flu (fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose). Vaccines LP.8.1 and XFG (Frankenstein) neutralize PJ.2.1; severity data are inconclusive. Argentina offers a US mRNA vaccine free in public clinics and ARVAC, a recombinant subunit vaccine, in pharmacies. Formosa reports rising infections; maternal vaccination uptake remains low. Pediatric cases are mild; adults may be more severe. Booster guidance: >65 annually; immunosuppressed or severe disease every six months.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンでCOVID-19の新たな感染力の強い変異株PJ.2.1の到来が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 新規の高感染力変異株（PJ.2.1）がアルゼンチンで確認され、ブラジル含む複数国に既に拡大している点でIHR基準の『異常/予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』が該当するため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの検出だが、ブラジル（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ等）での最近の確認も明記されているため、対象国としてブラジルのみ抽出。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。重症度データは不確定で、現時点では軽症例が多いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A virus orchestrates ciliated cell fate and injury during the mucociliary damage repair cycle
article.articleSummary: Influenza A virus orchestrates ciliated cell fate and injury during the mucociliary damage repair cycle. Researchers from State Key Laboratory of Respiratory Disease and the Guangzhou Institute of Respiratory Health, Guangzhou Medical University, along with Guangzhou National Laboratory and other Guangdong institutions, study how influenza A virus affects airway ciliated cells during the mucociliary damage repair process. The work includes contributions from The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Guangdong Academy of Agricultural Sciences, with Lei Wang, Wenbao Qi, and Zuodong Ye as corresponding authors. Published 2026-11-21, the project is funded by multiple Chinese programs, including the Noncommunicable Chronic Diseases-National Science and Technology Major Project (2024ZD0528400), National Key Research and Development Plan (2024YFA1108900), and the National Natural Science Foundation of China (82270001, 82301945, 22HAA00617), among others. The article lists extensive affiliations across Guangdong and Hong Kong and emphasizes mucociliary repair dynamics in influenza A infection.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型ウイルスは粘膜線毛損傷修復サイクルにおいて線毛細胞の運命と損傷を制御する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Communications掲載の学術研究論文で、インフルエンザA感染時の気道線毛細胞の修復メカニズムを扱う基礎科学研究。実際の感染症発生事例ではないため地域検証も該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: "هانديكاب إنترناشونال": تحديات كبيرة تواجه احتواء إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Handicap International: Major challenges facing the containment of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Handicap International’s logistics chief Jérôme Bertrand says access to isolated areas is essential to tackling the largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s history, but three key challenges hinder containment. From Ituri in eastern DRC, he notes Ebola foci stretch hundreds of kilometers across dense forests, across eight provinces. Maintaining a continuous supply chain is vital, with about 500 new cases weekly. The WHO indicates two candidate vaccines for the outbreak strain will soon enter trials; if effective, large quantities must be moved in refrigerated trucks while preserving the cold chain to electricity-poor areas. WHO teams plan three advanced storage centers in Ituri. The second challenge is protecting health workers amid decades of conflict; since May, 80 security incidents have targeted health staff, with fatalities. Handicap International—present 30 years, employing 130+ staff—has contacts with all major armed groups except the Allied Democratic Forces (ISIS-linked), responsible for at least 110 civilian deaths since early November. The third challenge is community acceptance of control measures, including changes to funerary practices, as risk peaks at death.

triage.headline_ja: ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ封じ込めに立ちはだかる大きな課題
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で週500例の新規感染があり、8州に拡大、武装勢力による医療従事者への攻撃も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行、週500例の新規感染、8州に拡大、武装勢力(ADF)による民間人・医療従事者への攻撃が継続中。WHOはワクチン候補の試験開始を予定。国際的な人道支援団体（Handicap International）が対応にあたっている。

article.articleHeadline: 美麻疹疫情逼近6千例創數十年新高　全球醫衛要聞總覽 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. measles outbreak nears 6,000 cases, the highest in decades; global health and medical news roundup - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Measles in the United States is approaching 6,000 cases, with the CDC tally at 5,838 as of November 19, 2026—the highest reported since 1991; Virginia reports this year’s first pediatric measles death. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,500 deaths, with no approved vaccines or therapies available. These outbreaks underscore gaps in measles vaccination coverage in the U.S. and the lack of approved medical countermeasures for Bundibugyo Ebola, highlighting the ongoing global infectious-disease burden and need for strengthened surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の麻疹流行が6000例に迫り数十年ぶりの高水準に、世界保健医療ニュース総覧
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱が1万1000例・死者5500人を超え、承認されたワクチンや治療薬が存在しないため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすと判断した。
triage.notes: 米国の麻疹流行は対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外とした。DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）は大規模かつ治療法・ワクチンが未承認であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia: 2.156 élèves sensibilisés à la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia: 2,156 students sensitized to Ebola prevention - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, 2,156 students at Maendeleo school in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, were educated on Ebola prevention. Of these, 1,343 were girls and 813 boys. Training covered regular handwashing, recognizing Ebola symptoms, and actions for suspected cases, with emphasis on rapid reporting, countering rumors, and avoiding stigma toward affected individuals. The initiative aims to empower students as prevention ambassadors within families and communities to sustain vigilance amid the persistent Ebola outbreak in Ituri and South Kivu. The activity is part of the CREC project—risk communication, community-based surveillance, and continuity of health care in the Ebola response—implemented by the Observatoire des droits humains with UNICEF funding.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア:2,156人の生徒がエボラ予防について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のイツリ・南キブ州における持続的なエボラ流行に対する予防教育活動の報告であり、新規症例や急変を示す内容ではないが、流行継続状況を示すため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のエボラ流行（イツリ・南キブ州）に対するUNICEF資金によるコミュニティ啓発活動の報告。流行の継続状況を示す補足情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreaks of influenza A, mumps detected at schools in northern Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Two outbreaks of infectious diseases were detected in Hai Ninh Commune, Quang Ninh Province, northern Vietnam: influenza A with 50 cases at Ly Thuong Kiet High School and mumps with 19 cases at Hai Tien Elementary and Middle School, per the provincial CDC. To curb spread, authorities disinfected classrooms and surrounding areas with Chloramine B across more than 20,000 square meters and enhanced public awareness. Guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, well-ventilated classrooms, and limiting close contact; symptoms to watch for include fever, cough, sore throat, and, for mumps, swelling and pain around the jaw and ears. Infected students should report symptoms to schools and seek healthcare. The health station will reassess risks after one week of spraying, maintain monitoring, and carry out preventive measures to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム北部の学校でインフルエンザA型とおたふく風邪の集団発生が確認
triage.triage_reason: 学校内での季節性感染症（インフルエンザA、おたふく風邪）の集団発生であり、国際的拡大や重篤性の懸念は低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染が継続する可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方のCDCが対応しており、国レベルでの危機とは認識されていない。学校という閉鎖環境でのヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性はあるが、インフルエンザ・おたふく風邪ともに一般的な感染症であり特段の異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron en la argentina la nueva variante de Covid pj.2.1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They detected in Argentina the new COVID pj.2.1 variant.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Argentina has detected Omicron sublineage PJ.2.1, a highly transmissible COVID-19 variant, in Buenos Aires Province. First local cases were sequenced by the National University of La Plata from three hospitalized patients—two infants and a 58-year-old adult—confirming PJ.2.1. The lineage carries about 25 mutations relative to its predecessor JN.1 and is described as a saltational variant. WHO notes mutations may increase receptor affinity and transmission, though clinical data are insufficient to link PJ.2.1 to greater severity; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and nasal discharge. Outbreaks have been reported in Brazil, Canada, and the United States. In Argentina, cases are rising in the metropolitan area and Formosa, with PCR testing reintroduced and mask use advised for health workers. Vaccines with free mRNA doses and ARVAC neutralize PJ.2.1 and prevent severe disease; vaccination during pregnancy and boosters for older adults and high-risk groups are encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新型コロナの新変異株PJ.2.1を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「異常/予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2つが該当し、新規サブリネージュ（変異多数・感染力増大の可能性）がブラジル・カナダ・米国でも報告されているため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでのPJ.2.1検出だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ（他国で確認されたアウトブレイクとして言及）。重症度増加の臨床的裏付けは不十分とWHOが指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 se espalha pelo Brasil e entra em monitoramento da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant spreads across Brazil and is under WHO monitoring.
article.articleSummary: WHO is monitoring the SARS-CoV-2 COVID-19 PJ.2.1 variant in Brazil. The PJ.2.1 lineage arrived in late August 2026 and now circulates widely, with predominance in Rio de Janeiro city and confirmed cases in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and the Federal District. Genomic analyses from Fiocruz's Oswaldo Cruz Institute show PJ.2.1 carries mutations that increase binding to human cell receptors, boosting transmissibility versus other circulating lineages, but there is no evidence of increased severity or mortality. Current public vaccines remain protective against severe disease and hospitalisation. Health authorities urge priority groups—older adults, very young children, pregnant individuals, and the immunocompromised—to update their vaccination at a basic health unit to strengthen immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジル全土に拡大、WHOが監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象とする新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州で広がっており、伝播性増加が確認されているため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 重症度増加の証拠はないが、伝播性が高い変異株がWHO監視下にあり、複数州に拡大している点で続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 来得早，爬得快！流感季来袭，药店货架有哪些变化？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early arrival, rapid spread! The influenza season is here—what changes are on pharmacy shelves?
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in China has entered mid-season, with Shanghai pharmacies showing heightened home-preparedness and diversified antiviral options. China's CDC week 46 data indicate influenza-like illness accounts for 4.5% of ED visits; influenza viruses test positive in 22.5% of samples, with A(H1N1)pdm09 56.2%, A(H3N2) 15.5%, B(Victoria) 28.3%; northern provinces show higher activity than the south. Retail demand centers on oseltamivir and baloxavir-class drugs, plus traditional remedies, as families stockpile for younger children and older adults with comorbidities. Since the 11th national procurement, hospital use favors selected brands, while outpatient and e-commerce channels gain for domestic single-dose PA-subunit inhibitors: 玛舒拉沙韦, 玛硒洛沙韦, 玛帕西沙韦. 玛舒拉沙韦已入2025医保目录，其他两款于2026年纳入，2027才执行医保支付。 Oseltamivir remains the main therapy and prophylaxis; new agents provide alternatives but do not fully replace it.

triage.headline_ja: 来るのが早く、広がるのも速い！インフルエンザシーズン到来、薬局の棚にどんな変化が？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況と医薬品市場動向に関する記事であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCの通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスデータ（週46）と薬局・医薬品市場の動向を伝える記事。A(H1N1)pdm09が優勢だが、季節性の範囲内であり異常な重症度や国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Comprehensive policy, action plan needed to tackle rabies'
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention in Keralam centers on a comprehensive policy and action plan to achieve a rabies-free status by 2030, announced during a One Health seminar. Organized by the Kerala State branch of the Indian Medical Association (IMA) and the State committee of the Indian Veterinary Association (IVA), the event urged involvement of local self-governments for coordinated action. The seminar, held on November 21, featured the inaugural address by Kozhikode deputy mayor S. Jayasree, with IMA State president P. Gopikumar and IVA State general secretary A. Irshad among speakers. Expert sessions covered rabies prevention and control, One Health perspectives, human and animal health challenges, and steps needed to strengthen coordinated action against the infection.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病対策には包括的な政策と行動計画が必要
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病対策に関する啓発セミナーの報道であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はケララ州における狂犬病撲滅のための政策セミナー開催を報じるものであり、具体的な発生状況やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazilian and US researchers report Wolbachia-based (wMel) mosquito intervention reduces arboviral infections in Brazil
article.articleSummary: EVITA dengue trial in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, reports 68.6% overall efficacy in reducing arboviral infections (dengue, Zika, chikungunya) among schoolchildren. The four-year, school-based, cluster-randomized trial included 58 clusters (29 with Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti release plus standard vector control; 29 with standard vector control alone). Wolbachia (wMel)–infected mosquitoes were released January 2021–May 2022; the study ran 2020–2024, enrolling 5,757 children aged 6–11, with baseline blood samples in 2020 and annual follow-ups through 2024 testing for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya antibodies. Laboratory work processed tens of thousands of samples at FAMERP in São José do Rio Preto. Dengue efficacy was 68.5%, chikungunya 73.3%. The intervention, once established in local populations, offers a potentially scalable tool to prevent arboviral disease, relevant to Brazil and other regions including parts of the US; the trial involved UFMG, WMP, Fiocruz, FAMERP, and US institutions (Emory, Yale, Johns Hopkins, University of Florida).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルと米国の研究者、ウォルバキア（wMel）を用いた蚊媒介対策がブラジルでアルボウイルス感染を減少させたと報告
triage.triage_reason: 研究成果の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。介入効果の学術的報告であり、シグナルとしての異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング・ジカ・チクングニア感染低減を目的としたウォルバキア感染蚊を用いた介入試験（EVITA dengue trial）の成果報告であり、アウトブレイクや新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。米国への言及はあるが、実際の感染発生地ではなく研究協力機関としての記載のため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's Death Toll Tops 5,700. Can the Outbreak Be Contained?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,700 confirmed cases and 5,700 deaths as of Nov 19, the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and the second-deadliest worldwide. The outbreak reached 10,000 cases in 163 days, 51 days faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Beyond Congo, Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 case. France reported a June case in a doctor returning from Congo; in November a British doctor who tested positive in Congo recovered in London. Contributing factors include delayed detection (likely starting mid- to late February, with WHO emergency declaration mid-May), limited contact tracing due to mobility and restricted access, erosion of community surveillance, and healthcare worker shortages. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccines or targeted antivirals, though vaccine trials are underway.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数が5,700人を突破。アウトブレイクは封じ込め可能か？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行（11,700症例、5,700死亡）で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・英国へ拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・英国への感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。承認されたワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、WHOが緊急事態を宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil, neighborhoods with Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes saw about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections among more than 5,700 schoolchildren. In a four-year trial, areas receiving releases plus standard mosquito-control were compared with similar areas without releases. Blood tests for dengue, chikungunya and Zika showed reduced infection, though Zika cases were too few to quantify. The strategy uses Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia bacteria, which lowers transmission; both male and female mosquitoes were released to establish Wolbachia in the local population. Florida also faced a large dengue outbreak, with over 650 locally acquired cases as of Friday, about 75% in Hillsborough County (Tampa), the largest in the U.S. since the 1940s. The findings support combining Wolbachia with existing controls to further suppress dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者ら、特別に飼育された蚊がデング熱を防ぐという強力な新証拠を報告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルでのWolbachia蚊によるデング熱・チクングニア感染抑制の研究成果報告であり、新規の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示すものではない。フロリダの流行言及も対象国外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Polio camps to be held across Virudhunagar district on Sunday
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive to immunize 1.30 lakh children up to age 5 across Virudhunagar district on Sunday, via 1,144 Special National Pulse Polio camps. Camps operate 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. at government hospitals, PHCs, SHCs, anganwadis, schools, temples, and at crowded places including railway stations and bus stands. Even if children have polio drops in their routine schedule, they should receive the oral vaccine during Sunday camps; vaccination is permissible for children with cold, fever, cough, or diarrhea. About 4,555 workers—health workers, noon meal workers, SHG members, voluntary groups, and students—will support the drive. Twenty-one mobile booths will cover Sri Lankan Tamils Rehabilitation camps and nomadic settlements. Officials also aim to reach children visiting temples and those at marriage functions on Sunday.

triage.headline_ja: 日曜日にヴィルドゥナガル県全域でポリオキャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: これは通常の予防接種キャンペーン（National Pulse Polio）の案内記事であり、ポリオ症例の発生や異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tenkasi district takes precautionary measures to avert avian influenza outbreak
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, by NIHSAD, prompting precautionary measures in Tamil Nadu’s Tenkasi district due to the border shared with Kerala. To curb spread, 24/7 Animal Husbandry check-post personnel inspect and divert shipments: poultry products (chicken, broilers, ducks, eggs) and poultry feed headed into Tamil Nadu are sent back to Kerala; Tamil Nadu vehicles returning from Kerala after unloading poultry products are disinfected at the check-post. Similarly, cargo vehicles returning to Tamil Nadu after supplying fruits and vegetables to Kerala are disinfected. A veterinary inspector, an assistant, and two others conduct spraying at the round-the-clock post. All poultry farms in Tenkasi are advised to implement precautionary measures to avert transmission of avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: テンカシ県、鳥インフルエンザ発生を防ぐための予防措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生が確認され、隣接するタミル・ナードゥ州テンカシ県で予防的な移動制限措置が取られているが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく動物衛生対応の段階にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽（animals カテゴリ）における鳥インフルエンザ発生への対応であり、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。ケララ州での発生確認を受けたタミル・ナードゥ州側の越境防疫措置が主題。人への感染拡大の兆候があれば速やかにPICKUPへ格上げすべき。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西研究：特殊蚊子有效抵禦登革熱及屈公病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian study: Special mosquitoes effectively resist dengue fever and chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Brazilian study shows Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes substantially reduce dengue fever and chikungunya infections among children. In a four-year, cluster-randomized trial with more than 5,700 participants in Belo Horizonte and surrounding communities, about half the areas released Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes. Dengue and chikungunya infections in children fell by roughly 69% in release communities versus controls, with the effect persisting through Brazil’s 2024 dengue surge. The strategy uses Wolbachia bacteria transmitted from mothers to offspring, which lowers the vector’s ability to transmit viruses; releasing both male and female mosquitoes establishes the bacterium in the local population. Findings were presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting. Experts say integrating Wolbachia with existing vector control could lower dengue in many places, including Florida’s large outbreak (over 650 locally acquired cases, mostly in Hillsborough County, Tampa). World Mosquito Program has deployed this strategy elsewhere with encouraging results. Hong Kong reports 3 imported cases (2 dengue, 1 chikungunya) with travel histories.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル研究：特殊な蚊がデング熱及びチクングニア熱に有効に抵抗
triage.triage_reason: 研究成果・対策技術に関する記事であり、新規の疾病発生や異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はWolbachia感染蚊によるデング熱・チクングニア熱予防効果の研究結果が主題。米フロリダや香港の症例も言及されるが対象国リストに含まれず、ブラジルのみが対象国として該当。新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hostels face scrutiny after students report worms in food
article.articleSummary: Odisha's college and university hostels are under scrutiny after worms were found in meals, starting with Nagabali Girls' Hostel at Maa Manikeswari University in Bhawanipatna. Students protested after worms appeared in the mess on Friday; the university denies the allegations and promises an assessment. The case follows earlier incidents this year: Ravenshaw University in Cuttack saw Mahanadi Girls' Hostel students protest Oct 4 over worms; BPUT in Rourkela faced a meal boycott on Oct 11 after a video showing a worker kneading dough with feet; Utkal University reported a dead frog in a soybean dish at Girls' Hostel No. 7 in early Nov amid a Hepatitis A scare. Authorities cite the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 (FSSAI registrations/licences) and UGC hygiene norms; officials say compliance is uneven and some blame deliberate contamination by students, while many institutions follow norms.

triage.headline_ja: 寮の食事に虫が混入、学生寮が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 食品衛生上の問題（虫・異物混入）が主題であり、肝炎Aは一部の文脈で言及されるのみで具体的な感染拡大や症例数の情報がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示す根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は寮の食品衛生問題（虫混入・衛生基準違反）であり、Hepatitis Aは別施設での「懸念」として簡潔に触れられているのみで、具体的な感染者数や公衆衛生上の対応は記載されていない。感染症イベントとしての情報が乏しいためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Tömeges megbetegedés egy karibi luxushajón: 148 ember kapott el valamilyen fertőzést
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass outbreak on a Caribbean luxury cruise ship: 148 people contracted some kind of infection.
article.articleSummary: Caribbean Princess reports 148 illnesses among passengers and crew during a 12-day Caribbean cruise that departed November 11 from Fort Lauderdale, Florida. CDC tallies 134 passengers and 14 crew affected as of November 15; symptoms are predominantly vomiting and diarrhea, with most cases mild. The infection source remains unknown; authorities emphasize enhanced cleaning, disinfection, isolation of ill individuals, and ongoing monitoring. Stool samples have been collected, but results are not yet available. Norovirus is a common cruise-ship culprit, though confirmation can take time, and outbreaks often evolve gradually during voyages. A prior similar incident occurred in March on Holland America Westerdam on a February Asia itinerary, with 65 passengers and 11 crew ill and seven stool samples testing positive for norovirus; Hong Kong health workers assisted investigations, and ships subsequently increased cleaning and screening.

triage.headline_ja: カリブ海の豪華客船で集団感染:148人が何らかの感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 米国フロリダ発のクルーズ船における軽症主体の胃腸炎集団発生で、対象国（中国・香港含む）とは無関係であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域はフロリダ（米国）であり対象国リストに含まれない。香港・中国は過去の別事例（3月のWesterdam号、アジア航路）への言及であり、本件（Caribbean Princess号）の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron en la Argentina un nuevo linaje de Covid en tres muestras de pacientes internados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 lineage detected in Argentina in three samples from hospitalized patients.
article.articleSummary: Three samples from hospitalized patients in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, were sequenced as lineage PJ.2.1, an Omicron descendant of JN.1. Two were infants (1 and 2 months) and the third a 58-year-old adult. The World Health Organization lists PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring; the lineage carries 25 mutations and has been detected in Brazil and across the Americas. A WHO advisory virologist cites changes that may increase transmissibility by enhancing cell interaction; WHO notes insufficient clinical data to confirm greater severity. In vitro, sera from individuals vaccinated with variant-adapted formulations neutralize PJ.2.1. Symptoms resemble a cold/flu: fever, cough, sore throat, nasal discharge; experts warn of higher contagion and stress vaccination, especially for at‑risk groups. COVID-19 accounts for about one-third of detected respiratory viruses in infants under six months; in Formosa, authorities resumed PCR testing after a sharp rise and advised masking for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで入院患者3検体から新型COVID系統を検出
triage.triage_reason: WHOがVariant Under Monitoringに指定した新系統PJ.2.1がアルゼンチンで検出され、ブラジルなど米州各地にも拡大しているため、異常性と国際的拡大の2基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新系統検出であり、ブラジルは「検出地域の一例」として言及されているのみで主題ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。台湾も発生地域に含まれていたが本文中に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Morte De Criança Na Virgínia Marca Avanço Do Sarampo Nos EUA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a Child in Virginia Marks a Measles Surge in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Virginia records its first measles death in 2026, a child aged 0–4, amid a surge that coincides with the United States losing measles elimination status. Nationally, the CDC data show 5,838 measles cases across at least 47 jurisdictions in 2026, led by Pennsylvania with 1,589 cases. Officially, six measles deaths are recorded by the CDC, but state tallies reach 11 (Virginia 1, Pennsylvania 8, Wisconsin 2, New York 1) due to a methodological shift toward consolidated health statistics. PAHO/WHO revoked elimination certification for the US, Mexico, and Bolivia after endemic transmission was documented for 12 months. About 96% of infections occurred in unvaccinated individuals; kindergarten coverage is 92% versus the 95% target. A US emergency package of $100 million funds vaccination and outbreak response. The Americas have 58,200+ cases and 82 deaths in 2026; Brazil reports 65 imported cases, urging travelers to update the two-dose MMR.

triage.headline_ja: バージニア州での子どもの死亡、米国における麻疹の拡大を象徴
triage.triage_reason: 米国での麻疹排除認定喪失、複数州での死亡例増加、地域全体（南北アメリカ）での大規模流行とブラジルへの輸入例報告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 主な発生地は米国（非対象国）だが、ブラジルで65件の輸入症例が明記されており、対象国として含めた。メキシコ・ボリビアも排除認定喪失国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo aponta redução de 68,5% nas infecções por dengue com uso da Wolbachia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study shows a 68.5% reduction in dengue infections with the use of Wolbachia.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian clinical trial in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, involving 5,757 children aged 6–11 across 58 neighborhoods, found that releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti reduced arboviral infections by 68.6% overall, with dengue down 68.5% and chikungunya down 73.3%. The study ran 2020–2024 and was evaluated via blood samples analyzed at the Virology Research Laboratory of Famerp in Ribeirão Preto; results were presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene (ASTMH) congress in the United States. Protection persisted through 2024, including Brazil’s largest dengue epidemic on record. The work is preliminary, not yet peer-reviewed. Researchers from Brazilian and American institutions (including Famerp, Fiocruz, UFMG) contributed. Wolbachia bacteria, when introduced into Aedes aegypti, reduces transmission capacity; maternal inheritance ensures spread and maintenance in local mosquito populations, offering a sustainable supplementary dengue, Zika, and chikungunya prevention strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア活用によりデング熱感染が68.5%減少したとの研究結果
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウォルバキア媒介蚊による予防効果を示す研究発表であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はベロオリゾンテ（ミナスジェライス州）で実施された臨床試験の結果報告であり、流行拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。発生地域に米国が含まれるが、これは学会発表地であり実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия вируса в Казахстане-2026: симптомы у детей и взрослых, доберется ли до России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kazakhstan-2026 Virus Epidemic: Symptoms in Children and Adults, Will It Reach Russia?
article.articleSummary: More than 10,000 people in Kazakhstan have been infected with a virus nicknamed the 'knock-you-down' virus. The illness mainly affects children, with adults also reporting infections while queuing to see doctors. Symptoms include a fever above 40°C that is hard to break, chills, body aches, sore throat, and a severe cough; vomiting, diarrhea, and headaches can occur. Given the overlap with influenza A and other respiratory infections, distinguishing the virus by symptoms is difficult; nasal swabs can identify influenza A, and testing is typically performed for hospitalized patients. Recovery in mild cases may be swift, but influenza-like illness can last five to seven days or longer. Russian authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) would likely seek an official notification if cases cross borders, and air travel could enable spread to Moscow and St. Petersburg. The article also mentions ALTNV, a newly identified Asian longhorned-tick nairovirus discovered in China in September.

triage.headline_ja: カザフスタン-2026年ウイルス流行：子供と大人の症状、ロシアに波及するか
triage.triage_reason: カザフスタンで1万人超が感染するインフルエンザ様疾患が急拡大し、国境を越えてロシアに及ぶ可能性が指摘されており、社会的・当局（Rospotrebnadzor）の関心も高いため、続報確認を含めフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカザフスタンでのインフルエンザ様疾患の流行であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国は新規ウイルス(ALTNV)の発見地として言及されているのみで、本件の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ce nouveau variant d'Ebola se propage deux fois plus vite que celui à l'origine de la pire épidémie jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This new Ebola variant spreads twice as fast as the one that sparked the worst outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola variant is spreading at roughly twice the rate of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the May 2026 outbreak has affected eight provinces. As of 15 November 2026 (data through 14 November), 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths have been reported. No vaccine or treatment specifically approved for Bundibugyo exists. Symptoms include fever, vomiting and diarrhea; bleeding occurs in 5–10% of cases. Rapid tests for other Ebola variants do not detect Bundibugyo. Surveillance is hampered by conflict and a humanitarian crisis, with about 70% of deaths occurring in the community. Children under five show particularly high mortality: 1,207 confirmed cases and 844 deaths (~70%). Cases have been reported in Uganda, Kenya (9 confirmed, 2 deaths), and Nigeria; a Nigerian patient had travelled to Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland. Vaccines are entering clinical trials and antivirals are being evaluated in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ変異株、史上最悪の流行を引き起こした株の2倍の速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模なブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（11,376症例、5,568死亡）が複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスへの搬送例）に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイスでの症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。主要な発生地はDRCであり、既に広範な多国間拡散（複数国への二次的な症例波及）が確認されている点は重大なリスク要因。紛争や人道危機により監視体制が弱く、迅速診断キットも変異株を検出できないなど、管理が極めて困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: une structure sanitaire dotée d'un bâtiment pour lutter efficacement contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: a health facility with a building to effectively combat Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Published 21 November 2026: In Beni, North Kivu, East Congo, the Kasanga-Vingazi health center has been equipped with a new building and medical equipment funded by Star-RDC, with World Bank support, to fight Ebola. Dr. Michel Tosalisana, the zone medical chief, said the modern facility and internationally standardized equipment will help curb Ebola in the Beni health zone. The project comes as Beni coordinates the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a focus on community sensitization, encouraging patients to seek care at appropriate centers. In addition to the building, the Kasanga-Vingazi center received medical supplies, including an emphasis on the operating block, to improve case management and patient referral. The initiative reinforces frontline efforts to end the outbreak and restore normal life.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラ対策のための施設を備えた保健センター - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）への対応強化を伝える記事であり、新規発生や異常な拡大を示す情報ではないため、既存アウトブレイクの経過観察として扱う。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に対応するための医療施設整備（世界銀行支援）を報じるもので、新規発生や急激な悪化を示す情報は含まれない。継続中のアウトブレイク対応の一環として経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Iituri et Nord-Kivu: La riposte se concentre à la survie des patients et la protection des populations exposées au virus - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri and North Kivu: The response focuses on patient survival and protecting populations exposed to the virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, health authorities continue the six-month response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Efforts span patient care and the search for new therapeutic options, with interventions focusing on improving patient survival and protecting populations exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The report notes ongoing management and therapeutic development but provides no specific figures for case counts or deaths, laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or details on imported/exported cases. The emphasis remains on clinical management, infection prevention, and protective measures for communities in the affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州と北キブ州のエボラ出血熱:対応は患者の生存とウイルスに曝露した住民の保護に重点
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（6ヶ月継続）に関する続報であり、エボラは致死性が高くヒト-ヒト感染リスクもあるため、継続的なモニタリングとリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、イツリ州・北キブ州、6ヶ月継続中）の対応状況に関する続報。具体的な症例数・死亡者数等の数値データは記載なし。既存のアウトブレイクのフォローアップであり新規発生ではないが、エボラの重大性から引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue fever breakthrough as specially bred mosquitos help fend off disease
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes provide strong protection against dengue and chikungunya, with a Brazilian study in Belo Horizonte showing about a 69% reduction in infections among more than 5,700 children in neighborhoods released with Wolbachia-infected insects. The study also screened blood for dengue, chikungunya, or Zika, confirming reductions beyond clinically diagnosed cases. The field results relate to Florida's unusually large outbreak, where health officials reported more than 650 locally acquired cases—about 75% in Hillsborough County (Tampa)—as the biggest U.S. outbreak since the 1940s. The Wolbachia approach breeds Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to carry Wolbachia bacteria, transmitted to offspring, reducing their ability to transmit viruses. The bacteria are harmless to people; large-area releases, combined with traditional control, could lower dengue in many settings. Prior field trials in Indonesia and elsewhere support this strategy, per researchers including Dr Sri Edupuganti and Dr David Hamer.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策に光明：特別に繁殖させた蚊が感染症の拡大防止に貢献
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウォルバキア感染蚊によるデング熱等の予防効果に関する研究成果の紹介記事であり、対象国における新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国フロリダ州の大規模アウトブレイク（対象国外）を背景にした、ブラジル・ベロオリゾンテでのウォルバキア蚊研究の成果報告。インドネシアは過去の実証実験への言及のみで具体的な流行データなしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Detectan en Argentina la nueva variante de Covid PJ.2.1 y explican el aumento de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 PJ.2.1 variant detected in Argentina and they explain the increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Argentina confirms PJ.2.1, a descendant of Omicron, in Buenos Aires province. Three hospitalized patients were identified; lab confirmation coordinated by the Universidad Nacional de La Plata. The PJ.2.1 lineage carries multiple mutations increasing affinity for human receptors, contributing to higher transmissibility and rapid case growth. The World Health Organization lists PJ.2.1 as a variant under surveillance due to its global expansion, with recent circulation reported in North America and Brazil. Current clinical data do not indicate increased severity versus previous lineages. Vaccines remain protective, and staying up-to-date with COVID-19 immunization is emphasized as the key strategy to blunt the rebound.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株PJ.2.1を検出、症例増加の理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がWHOの監視対象変異株であり感染力増加の可能性があるが、重症度増加は認められず、対象国（ブラジル等）は主要発生国ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 主発生国はアルゼンチン（対象国リスト外）。ブラジルは北米と並び『最近の流行が報告されている』地域として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの検出事例であるため、ブラジルはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Дослідження в Бразилії пов'язало бактерію Wolbachia зі зниженням інфекцій на 69% -- The
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study in Brazil linked the Wolbachia bacterium to a 69% reduction in infections -- The.
article.articleSummary: In Belo Horizonte, Brazil, a study of more than 5,700 children found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in neighborhoods where Aedes aegypti carry Wolbachia, versus similar areas without the bacterium. The effect persisted during Brazil’s 2024 dengue surge. Lead researcher Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of an international team, presented the findings at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting. Wolbachia is a bacterium transmitted maternally in infected mosquitoes and lowers their ability to transmit viruses. Field trials in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown similar reductions. Besides diagnosed cases, researchers tested blood for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. David Hamer of Boston University called the results promising, especially when combined with other vector-control measures. Context: Florida’s ongoing dengue outbreak, with over 650 locally transmitted cases, about 75% in Hillsborough County (Tampa).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの研究で、ウォルバキア菌が感染症を69%減少させたことが判明 -- The Independent
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのウォルバキア菌によるデング・チクングニア感染低減効果に関する研究発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン・媒介生物対策研究（ウォルバキア菌）の成果報告が主題。フロリダのデング流行は背景情報として言及されているのみで、米国は対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアも『類似の試験結果』として一文触れられるのみで主題ではないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: ಹಕ್ಕಿಜ್ವರ: ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ತಂಡ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies: Central team arrives in Tamil Nadu.
article.articleSummary: As of November 21, 2026, a confirmed H5N1 avian influenza outbreak is centered in the Cuddalore district of Tamil Nadu, with lab confirmation on November 13. Authorities have culled about 100,000 chickens and other birds as a precaution and restricted public interaction around affected sites. A National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) medical team has arrived to review how suspected cases are managed, oversee local medical camps, and ensure testing for individuals with cough and fever, aiming to prevent human transmission. Affected areas include Kullanchavadi, Kattiankuppam, and coastal zones Nadakattu and Taigavalliggal, with a 1 km culling radius around 15 poultry units where infections occurred. In Thamanampatti village, poultry deaths were reported on October 30; samples confirmed H5N1. Across the 15 units, 35,600 birds died, and a three-month ban on poultry farming has been imposed.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：タミル・ナードゥ州に中央政府調査団が到着
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザがタミル・ナードゥ州で家禽に確認され、国家疾病管理センター(NCDC)が人への感染拡大を監視するため派遣されており、パンデミック potential を持つ病原体であるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点で人への感染確定例は報告されていないが、NCDC医療チームが疑い症例の管理・検査体制を監督するために派遣されており、人獣共通感染症としての監視が必要。家禽の大量殺処分（約10万羽）と3か月間の養鶏禁止措置が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Zambia Starts Cholera Vaccine Plant; Eritrea Eliminates Trachoma
article.articleSummary: Zambia began Africa's cholera vaccine plant, ZAMVAX, designed to produce up to 20 million oral cholera vaccine doses annually; phase costs $24.1 million, with production start and antigen sourcing undisclosed. WHO-EDCTP signed an agreement to expand medical research in Africa, bolster regulation and clinical trials capacity, and support African Medicines Agency technical committees. Eritrea eliminated trachoma as a public health problem, 11th African Region country to do so, with ongoing surveillance to prevent resurgence. DRC Ebola outbreak: 11,600+ confirmed cases and 5,600+ deaths through November 17; outbreak declared May 15; Bundibugyo virus. Uganda outbreak declared over (20 cases, 2 deaths); Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths); Nigeria (1 imported case). Senegal's Institut Pasteur de Dakar outlines priorities through 2030 to expand vaccine production and diagnostics; Kenya campaigns distribute 10.8 million insecticide-treated nets across 18 counties (99 subcounties), including dual-ingredient nets in resistance areas. AU calls for closer health policy coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 週次ヘルスアップデート：ザンビアがコレラワクチン工場を稼働開始、エリトリアがトラコーマを制圧
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが11,600例以上・死者5,600人超と史上最大級の規模に達しており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大も確認されているため、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は週次アップデートで複数トピックを含む複合記事。ザンビアのコレラワクチン工場稼働は対応策のニュースであり発生事例ではない。DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）は既存アウトブレイクの継続報告だが、規模が極めて大きく深刻度が高いため改めてピックアップが妥当。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・エリトリア・セネガルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "هانديكاب إنترناشونال": 3 تحديات كبيرة تواجه احتواء إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Handicap International: 3 Major Challenges in Containing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is driving the largest outbreak in the country’s history, with small pockets spread along hundreds of kilometers of dense forest across eight provinces, centered in Ituri Province in the east. Handicap International (HI) logistic chief Jérôme Bertran notes that reaching isolated areas is essential but blocked by three main challenges: access, cold-chain logistics, and security plus community resistance to measures. The outbreak is sustaining about 500 new Ebola cases per week. The World Health Organization has announced two vaccine candidates against the circulating strain entering early trials in the epicenter; if effective, large quantities must be shipped via refrigerated trucks while preserving the cold chain to electricity-poor areas. WHO teams have been deployed to assess access ahead of three advanced storage centers in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル：エボラ対応を阻む3つの大きな課題
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、週あたり約500人の新規症例が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州を中心とする8州に広がる大規模エボラ流行について、アクセス・コールドチェーン・住民の抵抗という3つの課題を指摘。WHOはワクチン候補の早期臨床試験開始を発表しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Campina Grande registra redução de 19,2% nas notificações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Campina Grande records a 19.2% reduction in notifications.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campina Grande, Brazil, is under watch as the city marks National Dengue Combat Day. The Prefeitura de Campina Grande, through the Health Secretariat, reports a 19.2% drop in dengue notifications from last year, but epidemiological monitoring and surveillance continue due to ongoing transmission risk. In 2026, the municipality has recorded two confirmed dengue deaths and remains in red alert given indicators and environmental conditions favorable to Aedes aegypti proliferation. Integrated actions across epidemiological and environmental surveillance with primary care continue, including case monitoring, priority-area targeting, vector control. Prevention starts at home: weekly yard checks, eliminating water-holding containers, sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, and proper waste disposal. Symptoms such as fever, body pains, headache, retro-orbital pain, or rash warrant medical attention; severe abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, dizziness, or fainting require immediate care. The observance falls on the penultimate Saturday of November, per Law 12.235/2010, and control requires year-round participation.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：カンピーナ・グランデ市、報告数が19.2%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の届出数は前年比で減少しており、通常の季節的サーベイランス活動の一環で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的な啓発活動・サーベイランス報告であり、流行拡大の兆候はない。デング熱は当地域の風土病であり特段の異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Thai Hospital Study Identifies Shifting Carbapenem Resistance and
article.articleSummary: Three-year surveillance at Suddhavej Hospital, Mahasarakham University, in northeastern Thailand analyzed 2,190 Enterobacterales isolates from 4,147 records (1,638 deduplicated from 1,320 patients) to assess carbapenem resistance (2023–2025). Urinary specimens dominated (54.4% in 2023 to 65.3% in 2025). Escherichia coli rose from 48.7% to 57.1% of isolates; Klebsiella pneumoniae fell from 33.9% to 23.1%. Carbapenem resistance among recovered isolates declined from 8.4% (2023) to 6.3% (2024) to 2.7% (2025); overall carbapenem nonsusceptibility fell from 12.6% to 5.4%. Cefotaxime resistance remained stable (27.7–30.3%). In 2025, ertapenem-nonsusceptible isolates numbered 25, with nine retaining susceptibility to both meropenem and imipenem (ertapenem-discordant). These nine included Klebsiella pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, Enterobacter cloacae complex, Citrobacter koseri from urine (5), respiratory (2), deep tissue (1), bloodstream (1). Authors note confirmatory carbapenemase testing/genomic sequencing is required to elucidate resistance mechanisms.

triage.headline_ja: タイの病院研究、カルバペネム耐性の変化と不一致なエンテロバクター表現型を特定
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院での薬剤耐性サーベイランス研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の急性イベントではなく、国際拡大や渡航制限等のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: カルバペネム耐性率はむしろ減少傾向を示しており、アウトブレイクや急性公衆衛生イベントを示唆する内容ではない。学術的サーベイランス報告。

article.articleHeadline: تحديات تعرقل احتواء فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Challenges impeding the containment of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists amid logistical, security, and social barriers. In the eastern province of Ituri, outbreaks are scattered across vast forested areas, with roughly 500 new cases weekly across eight provinces. Handicap International reports that ensuring continuous supplies and accessing isolated sites is essential for outbreak control, prompting plans to establish three advanced vaccine-storage depots in Ituri. The cold chain will require refrigerated trucks, but electricity shortages complicate logistics. Ongoing armed conflict in the east heightens risks to humanitarian workers, with about 80 security incidents targeting health personnel since May, including fatalities. Local communities also hinder prevention measures due to traditional funeral rites involving washing and staying with the deceased, elevating transmission risk, especially at death. The situation reflects a convergence of geographic inaccessibility, insecurity, and socio-cultural practices challenging containment. As of 21 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス封じ込めを阻む課題
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で週約500件の新規エボラ症例が8州にわたり発生しており、治安悪化・物流困難・社会文化的要因により封じ込めが困難化している深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州など東部の森林地帯に拡散しており、武装紛争による保健従事者への攻撃（5月以降約80件の治安インシデント、死亡含む）や伝統的葬儀慣習による感染リスク増大が封じ込めを困難にしている。国際NGO（Handicap International）が物流支援に関与しており、国際的な支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: بعوض معدل ببكتيريا وولباكيا يخفض الإصابات بحمى الضنك وشيكونجونيا بنسبة 69% في البرازيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Wolbachia-infected mosquito reduces dengue and chikungunya infections by 69% in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers report that children living in dengue-endemic neighborhoods where Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes circulate experienced a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections compared with similar neighborhoods without Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes. The large study included more than 5,700 schoolchildren in one of the world’s areas with the highest dengue prevalence, and the protective effect endured through Brazil’s 2024 dengue surge. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes cannot transmit dengue or chikungunya, offering a vector-control strategy beyond pesticides. The findings were presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Public Health meeting. Experts not involved, like Dr. David Hamer of Boston University, called the results promising. Expanding Wolbachia use alongside existing control measures could substantially reduce dengue incidence in many regions. The report notes Florida is currently facing an unusually large virus outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア感染蚊がブラジルでデング熱とチクングニア熱の感染を69%削減
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン・蚊制御研究の成果報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はウォルバキア感染蚊によるデング熱・チクングニア熱予防効果に関する学術研究報告。フロリダの異常なウイルス流行についても触れられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com mpox no Ceará faz alerta após sintomas e lesões na pele: "Não queiram passar por isso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with mpox in Ceará, Brazil, issues warning after symptoms and skin lesions: "Don't want to go through this."
article.articleSummary: Mpox (MPXV) diagnosed in November in Ceará, Brazil, with 30-year-old Fortaleza videomaker Vanderson Pires reporting fever, body and throat pain before skin lesions. He initially sought care at a local UPA but perceived staff lacked mpox knowledge, then turned to Hospital São José in Fortaleza. Ceará shows a notable November surge: 151 confirmed mpox cases in 2026 up to November 18 (175 total for the year), with Fortaleza accounting for 145; October cases were under six, while early November saw 4–19 new confirmations (2025 period had four by the corresponding date). Mpox is an Orthopoxvirus infection; common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle and body pains, and skin lesions that may involve mucous membranes, usually mild to moderate and lasting 2–4 weeks, though immunosuppressed individuals may have more severe disease. Transmission occurs mainly by close contact with an infected person’s lesions or secretions or contaminated objects, with possible animal-to-human spread via wild rodents; the report underscored caution in social settings to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州でmpoxに感染した患者が症状と皮膚病変について警告：「こんな思いはしてほしくない」
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州（フォルタレザ）で10月の6例未満から11月に151例へと急増しており、異常な増加パターンかつヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: セアラ州フォルタレザで11月に症例が急増（10月は6例未満→11月に151例）。患者個人の体験談がメディアで取り上げられ社会的関心が示唆されるが、政府対応や国際支援の必要性については記事に記載なし。地域集中型の急増であり、続報での感染経路・対策状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue
article.articleSummary: Brazilian neighborhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito saw children far less likely to catch dengue or chikungunya. In a major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world’s dengue hot spots, researchers report that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy, rather than relying solely on pesticides and biting avoidance. The AP report from Washington notes the findings were released on Saturday, with the 2026-11-21 publication date. The results suggest a practical public-health approach in tropical regions where dengue is endemic, focusing on vector-control to reduce infections in children. The article does not provide exact case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者ら、特殊繁殖させた蚊がデング熱を防ぐという強力な新証拠を報告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルでのデング・チクングニア対策研究（ワクチン様蚊の有効性に関する学術報告）であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介病対策（ウォルバキア感染蚊によるデング予防効果）に関する研究成果報告であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron en la Argentina una nueva variante de Covid en tres muestras de pacientes internados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant detected in Argentina in three samples from hospitalized patients.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, three samples of the SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 were detected in hospitalized patients in Argentina, with the WHO listing PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring. The lineage carries about 25 mutations relative to its predecessor and detections have increased in the Americas, including Brazil. WHO notes no conclusive evidence of greater severity; laboratory data show sera from vaccines updated for earlier variants neutralize PJ.2.1. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and nasal discharge. Transmission appears higher, prompting calls to maintain up-to-date vaccination, especially for pregnant women, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. Case signals show rising circulation; in infants under six months, Covid represented approximately one-third of detected respiratory viruses, with hospitalizations of babies coinfected with RSV. Argentina offers mRNA vaccines in the public system and ARVAC in pharmacies. Experts caution this does not signal a pandemic resurgence; continued vaccination and precautions are advised.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで入院患者3検体から新型コロナウイルスの新変異株を検出
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株PJ.2.1がアルゼンチンで検出され伝播性の高さが示唆されるが、重症度増加の決定的証拠はなく専門家もパンデミック再燃を否定しており、現時点ではフルRRAに進む緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新変異株検出であり、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは『Americas地域での検出増加』の一環として言及されるのみで、具体的な確認事例の記述がないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: புதுச்சேரியில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சலால் 1,300 பேர் பாதிப்பு; இளைஞர் உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Puducherry, 1,300 people affected by dengue fever; a youth dies.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Puducherry, India, has affected about 1,300 people from January to present, rising from under 1,000 last year. A 22-year-old man, Mohammed Irban, from Anitha Nagar in Kathirkamam, Puducherry, died after four days of treatment at Kathirkamam Government Medical College Hospital and subsequent care at JIPMER. The death underscores a growing dengue trend in the union territory, with authorities noting ongoing transmission linked to El Niño conditions. Public health teams across departments are coordinating vector-control efforts, identifying and destroying mosquito breeding sites and removing stagnant water from containers in homes to curb transmission. The incident highlights the need for sustained, intensified mosquito-control measures to prevent further infections and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでデング熱により1,300人が感染、青年が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのプドゥチェリーでデング熱症例が増加し死亡例も出ているが、既知の流行病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、現地当局により媒介対策が進行中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年流行する媒介性感染症であり、今回の報告は季節的増加と死亡例の一例。地域内で既に対策が進行中であり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Curb flu spread, DoH presses public
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) and other respiratory infections spread mainly through respiratory droplets from coughs, sneezes, or speech, and via contact with contaminated objects; weather does not directly cause flu. In the Philippines, the Department of Health (DoH) warns that crowded and poorly ventilated spaces—homes, schools, and offices—heighten transmission, especially as people shelter from the rain. Precautions include wearing masks, washing hands regularly, avoiding poorly ventilated areas, practicing cough etiquette, and staying home when sick. Seek medical attention for symptoms or if conditions worsen. DoH encourages using PhilHealth YAKAP clinics for checkups and laboratory tests, and accredited PhilHealth GAMOT facilities for prescribed medicines. Prompt protection and timely medical consultation can help prevent flu from spreading in households and communities.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ拡大を抑制せよ、保健省が国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに対する一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生影響、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザ予防に関する保健省の注意喚起記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: بعوض يحمل بكتيريا "وولباكيا" يخفض إصابات حمى الضنك بنسبة 69 % في البرازيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Wolbachia-carrying mosquito reduces dengue fever infections by 69% in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian neighborhood study involving more than 5,700 children found that releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes reduced dengue and chikungunya infections by about 69% among schoolchildren, compared with similar areas without Wolbachia releases. The Wolbachia bacterium, harmless to humans and common in many insects, lowers the mosquitoes’ ability to transmit dengue virus and other pathogens. Infected females pass Wolbachia to their offspring, enabling the bacterium to spread gradually through the local mosquito population after releases. Importantly, the protective effect persisted during Brazil’s severe dengue outbreak in 2024. The research, conducted by an international team including Dr. Sree Idobuganti of Emory University, with commentary from Dr. David Hamer of Boston University, suggests expanding Wolbachia releases alongside traditional vector control could substantially reduce dengue incidence in many settings. Context: Florida faced an unusually large viral outbreak—the biggest in the United States since the 1940s.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア菌を保有する蚊がブラジルでデング熱感染を69%減少させる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン・媒介蚊対策研究の成果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はウォルバキア菌利用の蚊媒介感染症対策研究の成果を報告する内容で、米国フロリダ州の文脈は比較参照として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに米国は含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Estudio evalúa mosquitos con Wolbachia contra el dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study evaluates Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Four-year Belo Horizonte, Brazil study compared mosquito-control methods with and without releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti. More than 5,700 schoolchildren in dengue-endemic neighborhoods were enrolled; those in zones with Wolbachia releases experienced about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections versus controls, an effect that persisted through Brazil’s severe 2024 dengue outbreak. Wolbachia bacteria, harmless to humans and common in many insects, reduces mosquitoes’ ability to transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika; released males and females pass the bacteria to offspring, establishing it locally. Blood testing for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika confirmed infections, though Zika cases were too few for assessment. Findings were presented at ASTMH; Dr. Sri Edupuganti (Emory) noted sustained impact through 2024, and Dr. David Hamer (Boston) called the approach promising. The World Mosquito Program has pioneered this strategy globally. In Florida, more than 650 locally transmitted dengue cases were reported, primarily in Hillsborough County.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア感染蚊によるデング熱対策を評価する研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルでのウォルバキア蚊によるデング熱等の予防効果に関する研究成果の報告であり、新規の異常な流行や緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 米国フロリダ州の症例数にも言及があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題は研究成果報告であり、流行拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode reverter a queda de 93% da dengue no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could reverse the 93% drop in dengue cases in Paraná.
article.articleSummary: As of the 44th epidemiological week of 2026, Paraná, Brazil reports 6,380 dengue cases, a 93% drop from the same period in 2025, with deaths down from 114 to 6 (~95% reduction). The Aedes aegypti vector remains the key threat; higher temperatures, humidity, and heavy rains associated with El Niño could boost mosquito reproduction and transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, potentially reversing gains. Nationally, Fiocruz projects about 866,000 probable dengue cases in 2027 under a strong El Niño, with an uncertainty range of roughly 560,000 to 1.6 million, and about 80% confidence the final total falls within that band. In Paraná, vigilance must continue to eliminate standing water to prevent new breeding sites, since outbreaks depend on virus circulation, population susceptibility, and surveillance quality. El Niño could contribute but is not the sole driver; prior surges occurred during 2023–2024.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがパラナ州のデング熱症例93%減少を覆す可能性
triage.triage_reason: 現状はデング熱症例・死亡者数が大幅減少しており緊急性は低いが、エルニーニョによる将来的な媒介蚊増加とデング・ジカ・チクングニア再流行のリスクが予測されているため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は現状の改善傾向（症例93%減、死亡95%減）と、エルニーニョによる将来的なリスク増大の予測（Fiocruzによる2027年推計866,000例）を扱った分析・予測記事であり、現時点で実際の異常発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Malawi tightens border screening, imposes quarantine rules to prevent Ebola
article.articleSummary: Malawi tightens border screening and imposes 21-day self-isolation with daily monitoring to prevent importation of Ebola virus disease from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ministry of Health and Sanitation requires all travelers to submit an online Traveler Health Declaration Form before or on arrival and to undergo health screening at all entry points. Travelers arriving from or transiting through the DRC must complete a mandatory 21-day self-isolation with daily health professional monitoring. Those from or transiting through Uganda, Kenya, or Nigeria face 21 days of daily professional monitoring. The move comes as the DRC outbreak, which began in May 2026, reports 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths per Africa CDC; Malawi has not recorded any Ebola cases to date. The advisory calls for strict infection prevention, port health adherence, and cooperation from transport operators and border stakeholders.

triage.headline_ja: マラウイ、エボラ出血熱の流入防止のため国境検疫を強化し隔離規則を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイク（11,613症例、5,678死亡）を受け、近隣国が国境検疫・隔離措置を強化しており、IHR基準4項目全て該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事はマラウイの国境対策強化を主題としているが、実際のエボラ発生国はDRCであり、2026年5月以降の大規模アウトブレイクが継続中。マラウイ・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。致死率約48.9%と非常に高く、国際的な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Una nueva variante del COVID llegó a la Argentina y tiene mayor capacidad de contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant has arrived in Argentina and has higher transmissibility.
article.articleSummary: Argentina’s Buenos Aires Province detected the SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1, confirmed by UNLP’s Public Health Laboratory. Three hospitalized patients tested positive: two infants (1 and 2 months) and a 58-year-old adult. PJ.2.1, a descendant of Omicron (JN.1 lineage), carries 25 mutations and is designated by WHO as a variant under surveillance. Global activity shows rising detections in the United States and Canada, with Brazil also reporting cases. The lineage is linked to higher transmissibility due to mutations increasing receptor affinity. In Argentina, COVID now accounts for about one-third of viruses in infants under six months; symptoms resemble cold/flu (fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose). Vaccines available: US mRNA vaccine free at public sites; ARVAC recombinant subunit vaccine sold in pharmacies. Authorities warn of low vaccination coverage, especially among pregnant women, and occasional pediatric coinfections with RSV.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がアルゼンチンに到達、感染力が高い
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株(PJ.2.1)の検出であり伝播性増加が示唆されるが、重症度や国際的拡大の実態は不明なため続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le Nord-Kivu concentre 61,1 % de nouveaux cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: North Kivu accounts for 61.1% of new cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with North Kivu now the focal transmission area. As of 17 November 2026, North Kivu accounts for 71 of 109 new cases (61.1%), while Ituri remains the main reservoir with 68.4% of cumulative confirmed infections. The Beni health zone reports 30 new cases and 14 deaths. Across 68 health zones, five have 21–42 days without new notifications, and 15 have had no new confirmed cases for more than 42 days. On 17 November 2026, 48 deaths were recorded (34 in the community, 14 in Ebola Treatment Centers). Since onset, 3,148 recoveries and 1,743 individuals are currently in isolation in treatment centers. The contact-tracing rate is 82.6%. Active provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Nord-Ubangi. Government confirms strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, community outreach, and frontline support, with interventions still concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：北キブ州が新規症例の61.1％を占める
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、複数州にまたがる感染拡大と高い死亡者数が報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の既知のアウトブレイクの続報。北キブ州・イトゥリ州を中心に感染が継続し、致死率・接触者追跡率等の詳細データが報告されている。周辺国への越境拡大リスクについては本文に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Violência dificulta combate a surto de ebola na RD Congo, diz ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence hampers the fight against an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, says the UN.
article.articleSummary: Six months into Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo, UN reports progress tempered by violence. The epidemic has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths. Children account for more than a quarter of infections and about one-third of deaths, with under-5 fatality around 70%. Transmission has slowed in original epicenters but the virus is spreading across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with 400–500 new weekly cases. Contact tracing remains below target; two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, suggesting delayed analyses. Imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria signal risk. Insecurity—over 80 attacks on health services, including Cantine-Aloya where 66 civilians were killed—disrupts monitoring of thousands of contacts and caused patient disappearances. Diagnostics rose from two to over 24 labs; about 2,000 treatment beds in 104 centers; about 3,000 recoveries, with a quarter in survivor follow-up. Prevention emphasizes ceasefire, protection of health workers, rapid funding, and integrated community actions.

triage.headline_ja: 暴力がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応を困難にしている、と国連が発表

article.articleHeadline: Gramado tem redução de 78,8% nos casos de dengue até novembro de 2026; calor acende alerta para cuidados | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gramado records a 78.8% reduction in dengue cases through November 2026; heat triggers warning to take precautions.
article.articleSummary: Gramado, Brazil, reports a 78.8% drop in lab-confirmed dengue cases through November 16, 2026, with 7 confirmed infections (3 autochthonous, 4 imported) among 67 notifications; 5 cases remain under investigation. In 2025, 33 cases were confirmed, with 26 locally transmitted, and local transmission fell about 88.5% year over year. Field teams conducted 23,102 inspections in infestation areas, engaging residents with badges and guidance to curb Aedes aegypti proliferation. Health authorities are pursuing innovations, including an interior-wall coating designed to kill mosquitoes when applied up to body height, and a biological trap to interrupt egg development, with pilot deployment planned in homes, schools, and health posts. Authorities urge the community to report standing water and support vector-control efforts as heat and rainfall continue, signaling heightened dengue risk ahead of summer.

triage.headline_ja: グラマードで2026年11月までのデング熱症例が78.8%減少；気温上昇が注意喚起を促す
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が大幅減少しており、通常の季節的注意喚起にとどまる。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常事態は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: دراسة برازيلية: البعوض الحامل لبكتيريا وولباكيا يقلص إصابات حمى الضنك بنسبة 69%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian study: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce dengue cases by 69%
article.articleSummary: Brazilian study involving over 5,700 children in dengue-endemic neighborhoods shows 69% reduction in dengue cases where Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes were released, also associated with fewer chikungunya infections. The trial compared schoolchildren in intervention neighborhoods with counterparts in similar areas without Wolbachia releases. Wolbachia bacterium, non-pathogenic to humans and transmitted from mothers to offspring, reduces mosquitoes' capacity to harbor and transmit dengue and chikungunya viruses. The protective effect persisted through Brazil's 2024 dengue surge. Presented at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Public Health meeting, the findings support biocontrol as a sustainable alternative to insecticides, potentially scalable to other dengue-endemic regions, including parts of Florida experiencing high vector activity. Ongoing genetic and environmental monitoring is planned to ensure long-term efficacy.
