article.articleHeadline: RDC enfrenta grandes desafios para conter epidemia de ebola, diz ONG Handicap International
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC faces major challenges to contain the Ebola epidemic, says Handicap International NGO.
article.articleSummary: DRC faces the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, declared in May as the 17th epidemic, with small foci across eight provinces and Ituri as a key epicenter. Health workers report about 500 new cases per week and a case-fatality rate near 50%. Handicap International, a logistics NGO operating for three decades in eastern DRC, identifies geography, insecurity, and community distrust as major barriers to access. The WHO has begun testing two new vaccines; if effective, large refrigerated shipments are needed to reach electricity-poor areas, with convoys taking two to four weeks due to muddy roads and destroyed bridges, and final deliveries via smaller vehicles. Since May, there have been 80 security incidents against health workers, including fatalities, and the ADF militia has killed at least 110 civilians in Ituri since early November. Emphasis on PPE distribution to families and supervised, safe funerals is critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行の抑制に大きな課題に直面と国際NGOハンディキャップ・インターナショナルが指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最も致死率の高いエボラ流行（週500例新規、致死率約50%）が8州に拡大し、治安悪化・物流困難により封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に宣言された第17次エボラ流行で、DRC史上最悪とされる。治安悪化（ADF民兵による民間人殺害、保健従事者への攻撃80件）、地理的困難、コミュニティの不信が対応の障壁。WHOによる新規ワクチン2種の試験が進行中で、効果があれば大規模な冷蔵輸送体制の構築が必要とされ、国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cristina Lustemberg instó a ministros de Salud a prevenir enfermedades transmisibles en la región
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cristina Lustemberg Urged Health Ministers to Prevent Transmissible Diseases in the Region
article.articleSummary: Mercosur health ministers, led by Uruguay’s Cristina Lustemberg, closed Uruguay’s pro tempore presidency with signed health agreements and work plans. Attendees included Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, and Bolivia. Lustemberg noted 2026 saw a decline in dengue transmission, but chikungunya outbreaks persist in Bolivia and northern Argentina. On measles, the region has eliminated the disease but remains under pressure due to imported cases; the critical gap is the second vaccine dose, though first-dose coverage is strong across most countries. She urged reaffirming vaccination schedules. The meeting underscored regional vigilance and collaboration to prevent infectious disease spread, emphasizing vaccination and coordinated outbreak responses in the Mercosur area.

triage.headline_ja: クリスティナ・ルステンベルグ氏、保健相らに地域内の感染性疾患予防を要請
triage.triage_reason: Mercosur保健相会合に関する一般的な政策・協調強化の報道であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。デング減少、チクングニア流行は限定的、麻疹は排除維持中で輸入例への警戒のみ。
triage.notes: 記事はMercosur保健相会合の総括報道。ボリビア・アルゼンチン北部でチクングニア流行継続、麻疹は輸入例によるリスクのみと言及。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため記載したが、ブラジル固有の発生状況への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Enhanced 3D ResNet Model Classifies Active Pulmonary Tuberculosis on Chest
article.articleSummary: Active versus inactive pulmonary tuberculosis differentiation on chest CT achieved with 3D MSGC-ResNet50, a deep-learning classifier built from 3D ResUNet lung segmentation. Retrospective data from 500 patients at Guiyang Public Health Treatment Center, Guiyang City, Guizhou Province (250 active TB, 250 inactive TB) yielded internal metrics: precision 94.87%, recall 91.60%, F1-score 93.19%, AUC 96.68%, with the MSGC-ResNet50 outperforming baseline 3D ResNet50 by about 3–5 percentage points across metrics. External validation on 40 cases from a separate hospital achieved 90.00% accuracy (36 correct, 4 misclassified), indicating preliminary cross-institutional generalizability. The pipeline segments lung parenchyma via 3D ResUNet, then classifies with MSGC enhancements—multi-scale attention and grouped convolution with channel shuffle—to better capture lesion features. The approach aims to assist clinicians in timely TB management and transmission prevention, leveraging cross-institutional data for broader applicability.

article.articleHeadline: mutirão de combate à dengue em Cruzília - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Control Campaign in Cruzília - Panorama Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Between Oct 8 and Nov 19, 2026, Cruzília’s Health Surveillance conducted a dengue-control campaign across multiple neighborhoods to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Coordinated by the Municipal Health Secretariat with Endemic Disease Control Agents (ACE), Community Health Agents (ACS), and the Urban Cleaning team, the mutirões collected waste, removed water-holding materials, and educated residents on prevention. October districts included Recanto das Rosas and Kennedy de Baixo; Kennedy de Cima, São Sebastião, and Centro; Santa Bárbara, Juscelino Kubitschek (JK), João do Justo, and Brejinho de Baixo; Sete de Setembro, Juscelino Kubitschek (JK), João do Justo, and Brejinho. November rounds covered Ventania, Vila Augusto, Vila Vicentina; Novo Horizonte and Olaria; and Vila Magalhães. The effort underscores year-round prevention and strong community participation to reduce Aedes aegypti populations and transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல்: தமிழக- கேரள எல்லையில் கண்காணிப்பு தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu: Intensified Surveillance on the Tamil Nadu–Kerala Border
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) surveillance has been intensified along the Tamil Nadu–Kerala border after confirmed poultry outbreaks in Kerala’s Alappuzha district. Tamil Nadu’s district collector Monika Rana stated that, since November 20, Puliyarrai checkpost is under strict veterinary and health monitoring to curb spread. Vehicles carrying poultry, ducks, eggs, poultry waste, and carcasses are being turned back, while empty returning vehicles are disinfected. Trucks transporting vegetables and other goods are halted for inspection, with chlorine dioxide disinfectant sprayed inside compartments and on tires. A dedicated team—one veterinary scientist, one veterinary aide, and two disinfection operators—has been formed into two shifts for 24-hour coverage, continuing for 90 days. Authorities urge public awareness and cooperation with safety measures to prevent avian influenza transmission at the border.

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory infections empty classrooms benches, fill Hospital beds
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Chennai hospitals report respiratory infections driving full wards and ICUs, keeping children home from school. Infants under one year are most affected by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), with severe RSV cases requiring pediatric ICU care; several infants are very ill. Older children in ICUs test positive for influenza A (H1N1) or influenza B; many cases feature runny nose, itchy throat, high fever, cough. While most outpatient cases are viral infections and influenza, dengue also appears among pediatric patients. A preventive option against severe RSV is nirsevimab, given within birth or before the first RSV season; a single dose lasts at least five months and costs ₹30,000-₹40,000. Roughly the price of one day in intensive care. Household transmission is common; testing is prioritized for severely ill or those with comorbidities. Vaccination reduces severity; some high-risk children may need a second dose before the next RSV season.

article.articleHeadline: TimeMixer Model Reduced Nine-Month Tuberculosis Forecasting Errors in
article.articleSummary: TB forecasting in Kashgar Prefecture, Xinjiang, China, using monthly reported pulmonary TB incidence across twelve counties (2011–2025) with holdout test Jan–Sep 2025. Evaluated models include naive persistence, seasonal naive, SARIMA, iTransformer, TimeMixer, and BiRNN across 3-, 6-, and 9-month horizons. For 3 months, naive persistence yields MAE 2.193 per 100,000; TimeMixer performs worse at 4.804. For 6 months, naive persistence MAE is 3.217, again outperforming TimeMixer. At 9 months, TimeMixer shows strongest accuracy (RMSE 15.960 per 100,000; MAE 6.580 per 100,000; R^2=0.039) vs naive persistence MAE 7.430. Historical mean incidence (2016–2020) is 32.05 per 100,000; seasonal strength is low (0.090). Three 2025 outliers were flagged; excluding them lowers errors but leaves the ranking unchanged. Multimodel forecasts offer supplementary surveillance value; resource decisions should rely on broader epidemiological assessments, with transferability needing further evaluation.

article.articleHeadline: Mosquitos com bactéria Wolbachia reduzem em 68% infecções por arboviroses como dengue, zika e chikungunya - Catanduva Na Net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce arboviral infections by 68%, such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya - Catanduva Na Net.
article.articleSummary: In Belo Horizonte, Brazil, a cluster-randomized trial (Evita) enrolled 5,757 schoolchildren aged 6–11 to test whether releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti reduces arboviral infections. The city was split into 58 areas around schools; 29 received Wolbachia mosquitoes plus standard vector-control measures, 29 continued with standard controls only. From 2020 to 2024, blood samples were collected annually to detect antibodies against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes were released Jan 2021–May 2022; Wolbachia persists in the local mosquito population via maternal transmission. Overall arboviral infections dropped 68.6% in intervention areas; dengue infections fell 68.5%, chikungunya by 73.3%. Notably, the study ran through Brazil's largest dengue epidemic on record in 2024. Results, presented Nov 21, 2026 at the ASTMH meeting in National Harbor, MD, are preliminary and awaiting peer review. Institutions involved include UFMG, Famerp, Fiocruz, World Mosquito Program, Emory, Yale, Johns Hopkins, and University of Florida.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキア感染蚊がデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱などのアルボウイルス感染症を68%削減 - カタンドゥヴァナネット
triage.triage_reason: これは予防研究（Wolbachia蚊による感染症予防効果に関する臨床試験結果）の発表であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクイベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はBelo Horizonte（ブラジル）で実施されたWolbachia感染蚊を用いた介入試験（Evita試験）の学会発表結果であり、新規感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態ではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事の主題は研究成果報告であり、感染症アウトブレイク事案ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: CMO flags off polio awareness rally
article.articleSummary: Polio awareness rally flags off in Kanpur Nagar ahead of the Pulse Polio campaign starting on November 22, 2026. The Chief Medical Officer flagged off the event to ensure its successful execution and wide publicity. The rally began at Kashiram Hospital, proceeded via Ramadevi Square to Manoj International, and returned to Kashiram Hospital. Officials urged residents to ensure all children aged zero to five receive the polio vaccine during the Pulse Polio drive, a crucial measure to protect them against polio. The campaign is a district-wide effort to maximize vaccination coverage, with the rally serving to mobilize the public and highlight accessible vaccination sites for the immunization of young children.

triage.headline_ja: CMOがポリオ啓発ラリーを開始
triage.triage_reason: パルスポリオキャンペーンに先立つ通常の啓発活動・ワクチン接種推進であり、実際の症例報告や公衆衛生上の緊急性は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なポリオ予防接種啓発キャンペーンの告知であり、ポリオ症例の発生報告ではない。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルではないため、対象国が主題として該当してもverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les organisations locales sollicitées pour renforcer la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Local Organizations Urged to Strengthen Ebola Prevention - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, specifically in Djugu's Bahema Nord chiefdom, with confirmed cases reported at Drodro General Referral Hospital. Local civil society organizations are urged to intensify community awareness campaigns in affected areas to promote Ebola prevention and protect households. Charité Banza, president of the Bahema Nord civil society umbrella, notes that humanitarian organizations usually operate on time-bound projects and depart, potentially leaving communities without sustained sensitization and support. He calls for capacity-building of competent local groups to maintain prevention activities, address gender-based violence, and resolve land and parcel disputes. Partners should identify and train local structures to ensure post-departure continuity. Strengthened collaboration between humanitarian actors and local organizations could reinforce community prevention mechanisms and sustain Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱：地元団体に予防強化が要請される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の確定症例が継続して報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的関心が高い疾患であり、確定症例の存在と人道支援団体の活動継続性への懸念が示されている。継続的な地域コミュニティへの予防活動支援が課題とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS maintient l'urgence sanitaire internationale face à la transmission persistante - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern in the face of persistent transmission - ACP
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 21 November 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, was declared on May 15, 2026 and is the second Bundibugyo outbreak documented in the DRC, and the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country across all species. Transmission remains active in 48 health zones across eight provinces, with particular concern in Ituri and North Kivu. Despite a slight decrease in cases in some areas, community deaths—especially among young children—reflect challenges in early detection and timely access to care. The next response phase should emphasize quality and reach of interventions, community trust, sustained funding, coordination, and safety of teams. Cross-border surveillance, entry-point controls, and coordinated preparedness in neighboring countries are essential to prevent regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：持続する感染拡大を受けWHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を維持
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持しているDRCでの大規模エボラ流行であり、複数州にわたる持続的感染と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを維持していることが明記されており、DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoウイルス、48保健地区・8州に拡大）。越境監視と近隣国の備えの必要性も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Investigadores platenses hallan una nueva variante de Covid en la Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Plata researchers have found a new COVID-19 variant in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 PJ.2.1 variant identified in Argentina by researchers at the National University of La Plata (UNLP). Three confirmed cases in Buenos Aires province: two infants aged 1 and 2 months and a 58-year-old adult, all hospitalized. Genomic sequencing by the Public Health Laboratory’s Area Genómica y Molecular linked the three cases to PJ.2.1, a descendant of Omicron lineage JN.1. OMS monitoring indicates PJ.2.1 detections rising globally, notably in Canada and the United States, with confirmed presence in Brazil; lab studies show higher binding affinity to the ACE2 receptor. OMS assesses global health risk as low with low certainty; clinical data on severity are insufficient. In Argentina, nationwide surveillance through November 17 shows low overall respiratory virus circulation; SARS-CoV-2 detected in 10 ambulatory cases in weeks 43–44. Argentina health authorities urge up-to-date boosters, especially for 50+, immunocompromised from six months of age, and pregnant individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ラプラタの研究者がアルゼンチンで新たなCOVID-19変異株を発見
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1の出現が複数国で確認され、IHR基準の『異常性』『国際的拡大リスク』の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新変異株PJ.2.1の発見。ブラジル・カナダ・米国での検出は言及されるが、これらは対象国リストの主題国ではないため verified_locations には含めない（アルゼンチン・カナダ・米国は対象国リスト外）。WHOはグローバルリスクを低と評価しているが不確実性が高いとしている。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூா் மாவட்டத்தில் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதித்த கிராமங்களில் மத்திய மருத்துவக் குழு ஆய்வு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central medical team surveys avian influenza-affected villages in Cuddalore district!
article.articleSummary: On 21 November 2026, a central–state medical team led by the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) surveyed avian influenza-affected villages in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, focusing on Kattianguppam. The investigators reviewed poultry-farm disease-control measures, including disinfection, biosecurity, and culling, noting over 50,000 bird deaths and more than 20,000 birds culled to contain spread. They examined sanitation, live-bird containment, and health-monitoring activities, and spoke with residents about symptoms such as fever, cough, sore throat, and breathing problems. The team, led by NCDC joint director Niti and including NCDC advisor Vinita, a Puducherry JIPMER pulmonology expert Manju, and state animal-husbandry expert Raghavan, then evaluated facilities at Kullanjavadi Government Primary Health Centre for medicines and preventive campaigns. As of now, officials report no human cases and ongoing preventive measures in the village.

triage.headline_ja: カッダロール県の鳥インフルエンザ被害村落を中央医療チームが調査
triage.triage_reason: 大規模な家禽の斃死・殺処分を受け、NCDC主導の中央・州合同医療チームが現地調査し住民の症状（発熱・咳・喉の痛み・呼吸困難）を確認するなど、ヒトへの波及リスクを監視する公的対応が行われているため。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例は報告されていないが、5万羽超の鳥死亡・2万羽超の殺処分という大規模な家禽アウトブレイクに対し、NCDC主導の中央政府チームが住民の症状調査や保健所体制評価を実施しており、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: புதுச்சேரியில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சலால் இளைஞா் உயிரிழப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Youth dies of dengue fever in Puducherry!
article.articleSummary: As of 21 November 2026, Puducherry has reported 1,300 dengue fever cases this year, up from under 1,000 last year, with one death. The deceased is a 22-year-old Mohammed Iban, a resident of Anitha Nagar, Puducherry, who died after four days of treatment at Kathirkamam Government Medical College Hospital and subsequent transfer to JIPMER. The case underscores ongoing transmission despite multi-agency efforts. NVBDCP Deputy Director Murugan said El Niño-induced climate variation is contributing to higher dengue activity, and the central health department has issued alerts to all states. While integrated interdepartmental coordination has helped keep dengue under partial control, the fatal outcome shows the disease remains a public health risk in Puducherry.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでデング熱により青年死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドの風土病で例年発生するものだが、昨年より症例数が増加傾向にあり死亡例も出ているため、季節的な動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり、プドゥチェリー州では症例数が昨年比で増加（1,300例、死亡1例）しているが、多機関連携による対策は継続中で、中央保健省も全州に警告を発している段階。重大な異常事態とまでは言えないが、気候変動（エルニーニョ）による媒介蚊活動増加の指摘があり、継続的なモニタリングが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: La llegada de una nueva variante de Covid ya registra casos en la Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The arrival of a new Covid variant has already registered cases in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 Omicron-descendant sublineage, has been detected in Argentina with three hospitalized cases in Buenos Aires Province and the City of Buenos Aires. The variant is also circulating in the United States, Canada, and Brazil, where a Fiocruz survey found PJ.2.1 in 96 of 167 genomes (58%) in Rio de Janeiro. The World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring and assessed its potential for spread and vaccine response in an assessment published on November 19; the global health risk is considered low with limited confidence. Lab studies show antibodies from vaccines adapted to LP.8.1 and XFG neutralize PJ.2.1, but neutralization data do not by themselves determine efficacy against infection or severe disease. No distinguishing clinical symptoms; typical COVID-19 symptoms persist. Measures: ventilation, hand hygiene, masking in high-risk settings, updated vaccination, and ongoing genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株、アルゼンチンで既に症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1の検出事例だが、WHOは世界的リスクを低いと評価しており、重症化や急速な拡大の明確な兆候はない。継続的な監視が妥当。
triage.notes: アルゼンチン・米国・カナダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはPJ.2.1を監視下の変異株(VUM)とし、世界的リスクは限定的確信度で低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital de Especialidades Sullana consolida alta recuperación de pacientes con dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sullana Specialty Hospital Consolidates a High Recovery Rate Among Dengue Patients.
article.articleSummary: Peru's Sullana Specialty Hospital (MINSA) reports a high dengue recovery rate amid the Aedes aegypti–driven outbreak. Since the contingency began, 777 dengue patients have been discharged from specialized care. Official data show 1,087 emergency consultations for suspected dengue, with 641 laboratory-confirmed cases, 136 probable, and 310 discarded; four deaths occurred from severe complications. In the Santa Rosa site, the Clinical Surveillance Unit (UVICLIN) achieved 582 discharges of 588 treated (98.9% effectiveness). Overall, 321 additional discharges occurred in hospitalization and observation services, and 171 children recovered in the pediatric ward. Patients without alarm signs at triage were referred back to their local health centers for ambulatory management. Authorities urge reinforced vector-control measures: eliminate mosquito breeding sites, use repellent, and seek immediate care for high fever, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding, avoiding self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: スジャナ専門病院、デング熱患者の高い回復率を確立
triage.triage_reason: ペルーにおけるデング熱の地域的な医療対応の報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー・スジャナ地域におけるデング熱対応の医療機関報告。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事本文はペルーのみに言及しており対象国リストに該当する国の発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Com quase 8 mil notificações, Uberaba chega ao Dia de Combate à Dengue sob alerta para reinfecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With nearly 8,000 notifications, Uberaba marks Dengue Fight Day under alert for reinfection.
article.articleSummary: Uberaba, Brazil, marked Dengue Fight Day as Aedes aegypti infestation rose to 6.9% of properties in early November (LIRAa), nearly double the 3.5% a year earlier. In Uberaba, 7,984 dengue-symptom notifications were recorded with 207 laboratory-confirmed cases and no deaths this year. Experts warn that reinfection with a different serotype can trigger severe disease via antibody-dependent enhancement; DENV-3 is rising, now about 30% of analyzed cases in 2026, up from 14% in 2025. Brazil reported over 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths from January to October. The Qdenga vaccine (4–60 years) protects against all four serotypes and is given in two doses three months apart; in the public system, priority is given to 10–14-year-olds. Warning signs—severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, hypotension, reduced urine, altered consciousness—can appear as fever declines. Emphasize vector control and eliminating standing water.

triage.headline_ja: ほぼ8000件の報告、ウベラバ市はデング熱対策の日を迎え再感染への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ウベラバ市でデング熱の蚊媒介指数上昇とDENV-3血清型の増加が報告されているが、これは既知の季節性流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、フルRRAには進まず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ウベラバ市における季節性デング熱の地域啓発記事であり、血清型DENV-3の増加と蚊の生息密度上昇が指摘されているが、死亡例はなく国全体の流行状況の一環として報告されている。新規の異常な公衆衛生事象とは言い難く、国際的な懸念材料も乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 5'000 morts et aucun vaccin disponible
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 5,000 deaths and no vaccine available.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists six months in eight provinces, with over 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths—about 500 new cases weekly. A third of victims are children. Response efforts have expanded: laboratories tenfold, roughly 2,000 hospital beds, and more than 3,000 recoveries, yet transmission continues in remote eastern zones. Hard-to-reach forested areas and flooded routes force convoys to take two to four weeks to reach communities. Since May, 80 security incidents targeting health workers have been recorded, including assaults at funerals; rumours and conspiracy theories hinder outreach. No vaccine exists for this new Ebola strain; an October trial with Ervebo has begun but is not yet approved for this variant. In late October, a Swiss patient was treated in Geneva, illustrating international containment links.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者5,000人超、ワクチンは依然として利用不可
triage.triage_reason: 新規エボラ株による大規模アウトブレイクが6ヶ月間継続し、8州で11,000例超・死者5,000例超を記録。国際的な患者移送（スイスでの治療例）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスイス（ジュネーブ）も含まれるが、これは国際搬送された患者の治療地であり、アウトブレイクの発生国はDRCのみ。スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。新規株に対するワクチン未承認（Ervebo治験中）、治安悪化（医療従事者への攻撃80件）等、管理可能性・流行しやすさの観点で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Human Bocavirus Peaked in Young Children Across Eastern China Hospitals
article.articleSummary: In eastern China, 12,630 hospitalized children with acute respiratory infections were tested from January 2025 to March 2026 using a 13-target multiplex RT-PCR panel (SureX 13 Respiratory Pathogen Multiplex Kit, Ningbo Health Gene Technologies). Human bocavirus (HBoV) was detected in 3.2% overall, with no sex difference (p=0.99) but higher positivity in ages 1–3 years (7.7%). Co-infections occurred frequently, with human rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, and human parainfluenza viruses most common alongside HBoV. Mono-infections numbered 230; double-infections 154; triple-infections 26. Hospital length of stay did not differ significantly by co-infection pattern or infection multiplicity (mono 5.9 days; double 6.1; triple 6.7; p=0.700), though Mycoplasma pneumoniae co-infection lengthened stays (8.3 days) and Chlamydia co-infection shortened them (4.0 days; p=0.279). Clinical scores followed similar non-significant trends. A SARIMA model forecasts HBoV peaks in August–September 2026 to guide seasonal resource planning.

triage.headline_ja: 中国東部の病院における乳幼児でのヒトボカウイルス感染のピーク
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国東部での呼吸器病原体サーベイランス研究の報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性呼吸器病原体（ヒトボカウイルス等）の疫学的サーベイランス研究であり、通常の季節性パターンの分析結果を報告するもの。アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Wolbachia Mosquitoes Cut Dengue and Chikungunya Infections About 69% in Randomized Blood-Test Trial
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil, hosted the four-year EVITA Dengue cluster-randomized trial, reporting about 69% fewer dengue and chikungunya infections in neighborhoods releasing Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti, vs controls. Infections were detected by blood antibody tests (sero-incidence of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya) in 5,757 children aged 6–11 across 58 school catchment clusters (29 intervention, 29 control), reflecting added protection atop standard pesticide measures. Wolbachia intro into Ae. aegypti may reduce transmission via boosted immunity and cholesterol competition, with maternal transmission enabling population replacement. Temperature can reduce Wolbachia density and transmission. Comparisons with other trials (Yogyakarta, N Indonesia; Niterói, Brazil) use different outcomes and designs, so direct comparisons are limited. In the U.S., regulatory notes describe Wolbachia male releases as pesticide products (WB1 Males) under EPA oversight.

triage.headline_ja: ランダム化血液検査試験でウォルバキア蚊がデング熱とチクングニア熱の感染を約69%減少
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウォルバキア蚊を用いた感染予防介入の研究成果報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の発生を示すものではないため、緊急シグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・ベロオリゾンテで実施されたEVITA Dengue試験の結果報告であり、既存の病原体の流行状況や新規アウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。インドネシア（ジョグジャカルタ）は比較対象として言及されているのみ。米国はEPAの規制枠組みに関する言及のみで、感染症発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 美麻疹疫情逼近6千例創新高　全球公衛多項進展一次看 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US measles outbreak nears 6,000 cases, setting a new high; global public health advances at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the United States nears 6,000 cases, with 5,838 reported as of November 19, 2026, per the CDC, marking the first time since 1991 the U.S. surpassed 5,000 cases and resulting in the loss of measles elimination status after 26 years; Virginia reports this year’s first measles death in a child under 4. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease continues, with more than 11,000 cumulative cases and about 5,500 deaths over six months; the outbreak’s transmission pace has been twice that of past West Africa Ebola epidemics, prompting intensified international research and response efforts. The report underscores ongoing global public health challenges from measles vaccination gaps in the United States and emergent Ebola transmission dynamics in central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米麻疹の流行が6000例に迫り過去最高を更新　世界の公衆衛生動向を一挙解説
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が6ヶ月で1万1千例超・死者約5500人に達し、過去の西アフリカ流行の2倍の速さで拡大しているとされ、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の麻疹流行とDRCのエボラ流行の2件を扱うが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国・バージニア州は対象国外のためverified_locationsから除外。アンゴラも言及されているが詳細記述がなく対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 淺水灣泳灘遊客餵飼野鴿並捉拿拍照 網民憂慮公共衛生風險 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At Repulse Bay Beach, beachgoers feed wild pigeons and catch them to take photos; netizens worry about public health risks - Sing Tao Daily
article.articleSummary: Video from Repulse Bay Beach, Hong Kong, shows visitors feeding wild pigeons and a roughly 10-year-old boy catching a white pigeon for photos, prompting public health and wildlife-welfare concerns. Netizens warn such actions could raise avian influenza and other infection risks and reflect hygiene issues. A pink-shirted woman feeds pigeons; a red-jacket boy seizes a pigeon, photographed before release, feathers shedding during the process. The incident underscores penalties under the 2024 Wild Animals Protection (Amendment) Ordinance: illegal feeding of wild animals can incur up to HK$100,000 in fines and up to 1 year imprisonment, with an added HK$5,000 fixed-penalty mechanism to strengthen deterrence. Authorities and the public are urged to respect wildlife laws to protect animal welfare and public health.

triage.headline_ja: 淺水灣泳灘で観光客が野生のハトに餌をやり捕まえて写真撮影、ネットユーザーが公衆衛生リスクを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、野生のハトへの餌付け行為に対するネット上の懸念・野生動物保護条例に関する記事であり、疫学的シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザの実際の発生ではなく、野生動物への餌付け行為に対する懸念とそれに関連する法規制（野生動物保護条例）についての報道。感染症事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas alertam para risco de reinfecção da dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the risk of dengue reinfection in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil: experts warn that prior infection does not guarantee protection against severe disease upon reinfection with a different dengue serotype due to Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE). Dengue has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); infection with one provides lasting protection against that type but leaves individuals susceptible to others. From January to October 2026, Brazil registered over 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths (ITPS). In 2025, dengue with warning signs or severe dengue totaled 35,749; 2024 saw 6,270 dengue deaths. Serotype DENV-3, previously less common, rose from ~14% of cases in 2025 to ~30% in 2026, increasing reinfection concerns. Qdenga, a tetravalent dengue vaccine, is approved for ages 4–60, two doses 3 months apart; available in private networks and through the SUS, with prioritization for 10–14-year-olds. Severe dengue features include hemorrhage, plasma leakage, hypotension, and organ damage; early IV fluids and monitoring are critical; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs; paracetamol and dipyrone are preferred for fever/pain.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、ブラジルにおけるデング熱再感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年に37万人超の症例と371人の死亡が報告されており、血清型DENV-3の増加による再感染・重症化リスクが専門家から警告されている。公衆衛生上の負荷が大きく、ワクチン接種プログラムなど政府の関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾患だが、血清型DENV-3の急増とADEによる重症化リスクの高まりが新たな懸念点。ワクチン接種（Qdenga）の普及状況も含め、今後の症例・死亡動向の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Geography, violence, distrust hitting DR Congo Ebola fight: Handicap International
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri and spreading to eight provinces, has killed more than 5,500 people and records about 500 new cases weekly. WHO is trialling two Bundibugyo vaccines behind the latest epidemic; delivery to frontline will take weeks, requiring refrigerated transport and cold chain in electricity-poor areas, with convoys taking 2–4 weeks amid crevasses, bogs, and collapsed bridges. Insecurity hampers response: since May, 80 security incidents targeting health workers have caused deaths; Allied Democratic Forces killed at least 110 civilians in Ituri since early November. Mistrust and conspiracy theories complicate outreach, including safe funeral practices since Ebola is most contagious after death. Handicap International, with 130+ local staff, coordinates logistics but will not be armed and negotiates through armed-group checkpoints, excluding the ADF.

triage.headline_ja: 地理的障壁、暴力、不信感がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策を阻害：ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,500人以上が死亡し週500例の新規症例が発生、8州に拡大する大規模エボラ流行であり、治安悪化によりWHOワクチン配布等の対応が著しく困難化している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確であり、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Ituri州を中心に8州へ拡大中。治安悪化（ADFによる民間人殺害、医療従事者への攻撃）がワクチン輸送・対応を妨げており、長期化・拡大のリスクが高い。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: la sécurité, un élément important dans la lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Security, an important element in the fight against Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola response emphasizes security as a pillar. Police and the army protect response teams, help restore public order, and aid in community sensitization of troops and dependents, according to Dr. Jérémie Muhindo Katsavara, medical director at Beni's hospital. The security pillar also guards health facilities and ensures dignified, secure burials. Commissioner Superior Jonathan Molangi of the National Police, head of the mitigation pillar in the Ebola response, described the role as a bridge between response coordination and security services to ensure field activities run smoothly. The pillar features at least four sub-branches, including public awareness of preventive measures, escorts for response actors, and protection of health facilities from vandalism. He urged residents to cooperate with uniformed personnel, stressing that security presence accompanies rather than frightens communities. The outbreak response remains multisectoral, including surveillance, patient care, barrier measures, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ対策における治安維持の重要性 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で重篤性・異常性の2項目に該当し、治安維持や地域社会との協力が必要な継続的な流行対応であることから、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニ地域における既存のエボラ対応の治安面を扱った続報であり、新規発生の兆候ではなく既知アウトブレイクの管理状況に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூரில் பறவைக்காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்பு; ஒன்றிய மருத்துவ குழுவினர் ஆய்வு: மக்களுக்கு நோய் தொற்று உள்ளதா என விசாரணை - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore; Union medical teams conduct investigation to determine whether people are infected.
article.articleSummary: Vadalur, Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, reports an avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak confirmed in the Kattianguppam area of Krishnankuppam panchayat. A joint investigation team led by Dr Niti, Deputy Director of the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), including union and state medical officials, visited the affected locality. The delegation featured NCDC advisor Dr Vinita, state veterinary medical advisor Dr Raghavan, and Dr Manju, a pulmonology specialist from JIPMER, Puducherry. They first inspected poultry farms and surrounding areas to assess transmission-control measures. Subsequently, they met residents to screen for symptoms such as fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties. The team also reviewed health department preventive actions and medical surveillance arrangements in place to prevent human infection.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールで鳥インフルエンザ感染発生；中央医療チームが調査、住民への感染有無を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生に対し当局が人への感染有無を調査中だが、現時点でヒト感染の確定例は報告されておらず、続報を要する。
triage.notes: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生を受け、NCDC主導の合同調査チームが養鶏場と住民の症状スクリーニングを実施中。ヒト感染確定例の報告は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Estudio en Brasil revela que mosquitos modificados pueden frenar el dengue y chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study in Brazil reveals that modified mosquitoes can curb dengue and Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: In Belo Horizonte, Brazil, a four-year randomized study with over 5,700 children found that neighborhoods with Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes had about 69% fewer dengue and chikungunya infections compared with similar areas not releasing Wolbachia mosquitoes. Blood tests showed reductions in dengue and chikungunya incidence among schoolchildren. Wolbachia, harmless to humans, reduces mosquitoes’ ability to transmit these viruses and spreads through the local population after release. The World Mosquito Program conducts such releases; prior field trials in Indonesia and other places have shown dengue reductions. The study’s results persisted during Brazil’s 2024 dengue outbreak. Zika infections were too rare to draw conclusions. The four-year trial randomly assigned areas to release vs. control, suggesting Wolbachia releases could complement existing vector control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでの研究で、改変された蚊がデング熱とチクングニア熱を抑制できることが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン・媒介蚊対策（Wolbachia）に関する研究成果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は介入研究（Wolbachia蚊によるデング・チクングニア抑制効果）の科学的報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではない。ブラジル・インドネシアは対象国だが、イベントとしての発生報告ではなく研究成果のため、発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh tăng cường phòng, chống dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh Province strengthens prevention and control of African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, remains a major concern as of 22 November 2026. The disease has spread to 45 hamlets across 19 communes/wards, affecting over 600 pigs that are currently infected, dead, or culled. In Thiên Cầm commune, ASF is largely controlled in November with only 2 households infected, down from October; since 20 October, Đồng Lộc commune reported re-emergence in 4 hamlets affecting 9 households. The province faces ongoing risk due to seasonal movement of pigs and potential cross-border incursions from Laos, where ASF activity could enter via unregulated trade and border crossings. Authorities emphasize strict biosecurity, surveillance, market checks, and rapid reporting; directives issued on 23 Oct (MARD Document 12237/BNNMT-CNTY) and 29 Oct (11226/UBND-NL5) bolster control. Mitraco (about 6,500 sows and ~150,000 pigs/year) and other farms reinforce hygiene and disinfection to maintain meat supply for year-end and Tet 2027, and farmers are urged to source clean stock, vaccinate fully, and report signs promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省、アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の予防・防除を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは家畜（豚）のみに影響する動物疾病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響はない。既存の防除体制下での継続的な発生であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも限定的。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上のリスク評価対象としての優先度は低い。農業・経済・食料供給への影響としては継続監視の価値はあるが、EBSのヒト感染症シグナルとしてはDISMISS相当。ラオスとの国境地帯での越境リスクが言及されているが、ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため記載せず。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : 67 soignants décédés, le professeur Éric Mafuta insiste sur la détection précoce des épidémies | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: 67 healthcare workers have died, Professor Éric Mafuta insists on early detection of epidemics
article.articleSummary: During the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, frontline clinicians are emphasized as critical alerting agents in the response. Professor Éric Mafuta, director of the School of Public Health at the University of Kinshasa (UNIKIN), told a Médecins Promotion 2003 conference series that clinicians must recognize events or clinical pictures signaling an epidemic and must notify authorities promptly. Africa CDC data reported as of early November 2026 show 427 healthcare workers infected since the outbreak was declared on 15 May 2026, with 67 deaths among them. Mafuta links the toll to lapses in infection prevention and control, urging clinicians to listen to their communities and maintain precautions in practice. The report underscores ongoing Ebola transmission in the DRC and the essential role of early detection and surveillance in mitigating casualties.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：医療従事者67人が死亡、エリック・マフタ教授が疫病の早期発見を強調
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行において、医療従事者427人感染・67人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRC第17次エボラ流行が継続中。Africa CDCデータによると11月初旬時点で医療従事者427人感染、67人死亡。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Stay alert despite end of Ebola contact monitoring, virologists tell Nigerians
article.articleSummary: Imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) in Oct 2026 after travel to Uganda; Nigeria the fifth country to detect Ebola since the DRC outbreak began May 15, 2026. Index patient evacuated to Switzerland Oct 26, discharged Nov 11. The Nigeria CDC activated incident management; 62 high-risk contacts completed 21-day monitoring by Nov 13; last contact discharged; no one developed illness, indicating no transmission from the index case. WHO records Bundibugyo virus disease fatality around 32.8%; Ebola CFR historically ~50%. Despite end of monitoring, experts warn against relaxing surveillance due to active Ebola in DRC and cross-border movement. Urge stronger border screening, enhanced lab capacity, and public awareness, especially at international entry points and for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and Kenya. Vigilance remains essential through subsequent observation periods.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ接触者監視終了後も警戒を怠らないようにとウイルス学者がナイジェリア国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが既に5か国に拡大しており、ナイジェリアでの輸入症例自体は封じ込めに成功したものの、国境を越えた感染リスクが依然として存在するため、フルリスク評価による継続監視が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はナイジェリアでの輸入症例（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）に関する接触者監視終了の報告であり、二次感染は確認されていない。しかしDRCでの原発アウトブレイクは継続中であり、既に5か国で症例が検出されている点から、国際的拡大リスクは依然として高い。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Farmácias registram alta demanda por testes de Covid-19 após aumento de casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pharmacies report high demand for COVID-19 tests after an increase in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases surge in Brazil per a Fiocruz bulletin, prompting high demand for tests and pharmacy shortages. By November 2026, nearly 119,000 new COVID-19 cases and over 177,000 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG)-related events have been recorded, with increases concentrated in the Centro-Sul region, Bahia, and the Federal District. In São Paulo, health posts see heavy vaccination drive for prioritised groups (pregnant persons, elderly, immunocompromised), while pharmacies report virtually exhausted test stocks. Although authorities do not deem the rise alarming for healthy individuals, protection of vulnerable populations through ongoing vaccination at primary care units remains the focus. To bolster response, the Health Ministry will distribute additional vaccine doses to the most affected states: São Paulo 500,000; Rio de Janeiro 350,000; Minas Gerais 290,000; plus seven other states.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの感染者数増加を受け、薬局で検査キットの需要が急増
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19症例が急増し、SRAG関連事例も多数報告されており、政府がワクチン追加配布を行うなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているためスクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり国際的な異常事象ではないが、ブラジル国内での症例急増・検査キット不足・政府によるワクチン追加配布など、国内の公衆衛生対応強化が進んでいる点から継続的な動向把握が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 正值流感季，今年毒株有何特點？能自行服用抗生素嗎？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's flu season. What characteristics do this year's influenza strains have? Can you self-medicate with antibiotics?
article.articleSummary: National influenza activity in China is at a moderate level, with northern regions showing a rising influenza positivity rate while the south remains fluctuating. This season features concurrent circulation of three main strains—Influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and Influenza B Victoria lineage—with proportions shifting from October to November: A(H3N2) predominated in October, A(H1N1) rising to become dominant in November, and A(H3N2) dropping below 20% while B Victoria remains stable. Coexistence and rapid strain turnover challenge protection; cross-strain immunity is weak. The trivalent vaccine remains protective against all three. Children 5–14 currently have the highest positivity; emphasis on early recognition and reducing gatherings in schools and childcare settings. In the elderly (65+), focus on preventing severe disease; vaccination and prompt care are advised; post-exposure oseltamivir prophylaxis can be used for high-risk elders. Antiviral drugs reduce viral replication but are not instant cures; best when started within 48 hours. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics; seek testing for possible bacterial co-infection if symptoms persist.

triage.headline_ja: 正値流感季、今年の毒株にはどんな特徴があるか？抗生物質を自己判断で服用してもよいか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、通常の流行状況の範囲内で異常性や深刻な公衆衛生影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年の季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な解説・予防啓発記事。複数株の同時流行は例年見られる現象であり、重症例急増や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 1.4L kids to get polio drops in Fazilka from November 22 to 24
article.articleSummary: Polio drive launched in Fazilka district, Punjab, India, with a three-day Pulse Polio campaign from November 22–24 to vaccinate about 141,732 children aged 0–5 years. The Health Department will administer polio drops across Fazilka through 565 vaccination booths, with 113 supervisors monitoring fieldwork. Public awareness will be boosted by rickshaws mounted with loudspeakers delivering announcements in urban areas, encouraging guardians to bring their children for vaccination. Special focus will be on migrant populations, slums, remote locations, brick kilns, rice shellers and factories to ensure no eligible child is missed. The district counts 110 brick kilns and 74 identified high-risk areas prioritized by health teams. Health officials emphasized that immunisation should proceed even if children have minor illnesses or diarrhoea, to ensure timely protection against poliovirus.

triage.headline_ja: ファジルカ県で11月22日から24日までポリオワクチン投与、14万人の子供が対象
triage.triage_reason: これは定例のポリオ予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio）に関する報道であり、実際の症例発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、ポリオ症例の発生を報告するものではないため、対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de covid é puxada por variange XFG - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases driven by XFG variant - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: XFG, a SARS-CoV-2 Omicron subvariant, is driving the current rise in COVID-19 cases globally. First detected January 2025; by June 2025 it surpassed B.1.8.1 to become the dominant global lineage, and the October 4 update showed XFG at 52% of sequences. In Brazil, it was officially confirmed in July 2025 and has since been the main circulating variant, at times nearly 100% of sequenced samples; this year XFG accounts for about 90% of 2,199 analyzed Brazilian cases. The WHO states there is no evidence of greater severity than other Omicron descendants, and vaccines plus prior infection continue to protect against severe disease. The subvariant carries spike mutations with potential immune escape and higher transmissibility. Through November 4, 2026, Brazil reported 118,851 COVID-19–related respiratory illness cases, with rising activity across multiple states (Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, São Paulo); ITPS positivity rose from 6.62% to 16.66% last week. In 2025 mid-Oct, 367,640 cases were reported; this year 115,626 (−68.5%).

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染者数の増加、XFG変異株が牽引 - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: 既に世界的に優勢となっているXFG変異株（オミクロン系統）に関する定例サーベイランス報告であり、WHOも重症度の増加は認めていないため、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: XFG変異株は2025年初頭から世界的に検出され、既に優勢株となっている既知の変異株。ブラジルでの症例数・陽性率の上昇が報告されているが、WHOは重症度増加の証拠はないとしており、ワクチン・既感染による防御も維持されている。定例の疫学モニタリング情報と判断。
